scenario: 一个小站点刚从单机变成几万用户，Web 请求和数据库查询互相抢 CPU、内存和连接数。
scenario_en: A small site has outgrown one machine, and web requests now compete with database queries for CPU, memory, and connections.
q: 第一步应该拆出哪一层？
q_en: Which layer should you split out first?
options: 把 Web 层和数据库层拆到不同机器
先把所有数据搬到 CDN
把每个请求都放进消息队列
把所有表立即分片
options_en: Move the web tier and database tier onto separate machines
Move all data to a CDN first
Put every request through a message queue
Shard every table immediately
why: 我会先拆 Web 和数据库，因为两层的瓶颈不同，拆开后才能分别扩容和排障。代价是多一次网络访问，也要开始管理跨机器连接。
why_en: I would split web and database first because they hit different bottlenecks and need to scale independently.
whenOtherWins: 如果瓶颈只是图片、JS、CSS 下载慢，CDN 会先赢；如果数据库单表已经放不下，分片才提前出现。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Web[Web tier]
Web --> DB[(Database tier)]

termDefinitions.meaning: 处理 HTTP 请求、业务逻辑和 API 响应的一层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The web tier handles HTTP requests, business logic, and API responses.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责持久化读写数据的一层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The database tier persists and serves application data.

termDefinitions.meaning: CDN 是把静态内容缓存到边缘节点的分发网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN is an edge network that caches and serves static content.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息队列保存待处理消息，让生产者和消费者异步解耦。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A message queue stores work items so producers and consumers can run asynchronously.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分片把数据按 key 拆到多个存储节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding partitions data by key across multiple storage nodes.

optionMeanings: Web/DB 拆层是把请求处理和持久化资源隔离。
CDN 缓存静态资源，不承载数据库查询。
消息队列适合异步任务，不适合包住每个同步读请求。
分片把表按 key 拆开，是更晚的容量手段。
optionDirectness: 单机上 Web 和 DB 争 CPU、连接时先做。
图片、JS、CSS 下载慢或源站带宽贵时更合适。
照片处理、发通知这类可延迟任务更合适。
单表容量或写入吞吐已经到顶时才上。
optionScenarioImpacts: 两层可以分别扩容和排障，但多一次网络访问。
不会解决数据库和 Web 进程互抢资源。
会增加同步请求延迟，还没拆掉资源竞争。
过早引入跨片查询、迁移和路由复杂度。
tradeoff: 按层独立扩容 vs 跨机器网络和连接管理
optionMeanings_en: Move the web tier and database tier onto separate machines.
Move all data to a CDN first.
Put every request through a message queue.
Shard every table immediately.
optionDirectness_en: Use when they hit different bottlenecks and need to scale independently.
Only fits when this statement is true: move all data to a CDN first.

scenario: 订单系统需要事务、表之间关联查询、报表 join，数据模型比较稳定。
scenario_en: An order system needs transactions, relational joins, reporting queries, and a fairly stable data model.
q: 这个场景优先选哪类数据库？
q_en: Which database family fits this scenario first?
options: 关系型数据库
文档数据库
图数据库
纯对象存储
options_en: Relational database
Document database
Graph database
Object storage only
why: 我会先选关系型数据库，因为事务和 join 是它的主场。NoSQL 可以后补到日志、画像或超大规模非关系数据上。
why_en: A relational database is the first fit because this workload depends on transactions and joins.
tradeoff: 事务和 join vs schema 弹性和横向扩展
whenOtherWins: 如果数据主要是无固定结构的 JSON 文档，且查询不依赖跨表 join，文档数据库会更顺。

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构化查询语言，用来查询和修改关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQL is the language used to query and modify relational databases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 泛指非传统关系模型的数据存储，如键值、文档、列族、图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NoSQL describes non-relational stores such as key-value, document, column-family, and graph databases.

scenario: 两个 Web 服务器都能处理同一类无状态请求。你希望一台挂掉时，用户还能访问服务。
scenario_en: Two web servers can handle the same stateless requests, and users should still reach the service if one server fails.
q: 入口层应该加什么？
q_en: What should you add at the entry point?
options: 负载均衡器
只加更大的数据库
客户端手动选择服务器
给每个用户固定一个独立域名
options_en: A load balancer
Only a larger database
Let clients pick servers manually
Give each user a dedicated domain
why: 负载均衡器把客户端从具体 Web 机器上解耦，健康检查失败后可以把流量切到其他机器。但它自己也要做冗余，否则入口会变成新单点。
why_en: A load balancer decouples clients from individual web servers and can route around unhealthy ones.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一个用户和一台实验机，直接访问服务器更简单；一旦要容灾或扩容，负载均衡就该出现。
diagram:
flowchart LR
U[Users] --> LB[Load balancer]
LB --> W1[Web 1]
LB --> W2[Web 2]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把入口请求分发到一组后端实例的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A load balancer distributes incoming requests across backend instances.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负载均衡器定期探测后端是否可用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A health check probes whether a backend is still usable.

tradeoff: 入口解耦和故障切换 vs 负载均衡层冗余成本
optionMeanings: 负载均衡器在入口按健康度和策略分发请求。
更大的数据库只扩了持久层资源。
客户端选服务器把路由和故障处理推给用户端。
独立域名是租户隔离或品牌需求，不是入口容灾。
optionDirectness: 多台无状态 Web 实例提供同一能力时更合适。
数据库 CPU、连接数或存储已经是瓶颈时才考虑。
极小内网工具或调试环境才可能临时接受。
多租户自定义域名或白标产品时才相关。
optionScenarioImpacts: 一台 Web 挂掉后可以切到健康实例。
Web 机器故障仍会让用户打到坏实例。
客户端要感知后端拓扑，故障切换不可控。
增加域名管理成本，却没有健康检查和分流。
optionMeanings_en: A load balancer.
Only a larger database.
Let clients pick servers manually.
Give each user a dedicated domain.
optionDirectness_en: Use when a load balancer decouples clients from individual web servers and can route around unhealthy ones.
Only fits when this statement is true: only a larger database.
Only fits when the goal is to let clients pick servers manually.
Only fits when this statement is true: give each user a dedicated domain.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It commits the design to this path: A load balancer.
It commits the design to this assumption: Only a larger database.
It commits the design to this assumption: Let clients pick servers manually.
It commits the design to this assumption: Give each user a dedicated domain.

scenario: 一个读多写少的应用使用主从复制：写入走主库，读取优先走从库。
scenario_en: A read-heavy app uses primary-replica replication: writes go to the primary, reads usually go to replicas.
q: 主从复制主要解决哪些问题？
q_en: What problems does primary-replica replication mainly address?
options: 把读请求分散到多个副本
主库故障时可提升副本接管
自动消除所有数据延迟
让跨分片 join 变简单
options_en: Spread reads across replicas
Promote a replica if the primary fails
Remove all replication lag automatically
Make cross-shard joins simple
why: 主从复制主要给读扩展和故障接管留路。它不保证副本永远最新，主库故障后的补数据和提升流程仍然要设计。
why_en: Primary-replica replication helps with read scaling and failover, but replicas can still lag behind.

termDefinitions.meaning: 接收写入并作为复制源的数据库节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The primary database accepts writes and serves as the replication source.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从主库复制数据、常用于读流量的数据库节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A replica copies data from the primary and often serves reads.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副本落后主库的时间或数据差距。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Replication lag is the delay or data gap between primary and replica.

scenario: 用户资料页每秒被读很多次，但资料修改很少。数据库 CPU 主要花在重复查同一批数据。
scenario_en: Profile pages are read many times per second but updated rarely, and the database spends CPU on repeated reads of the same data.
q: 这里最适合加哪一层？
q_en: Which layer fits best here?
options: 内存缓存层
跨地域强同步写入
把会话放回 Web 服务器
每次读都全表扫描
options_en: An in-memory cache layer
Cross-region synchronous writes
Move sessions back into web servers
Run a full table scan on every read
why: 缓存适合读多写少的数据，因为一次数据库结果可以服务很多次读取。代价是要处理过期、失效和数据库与缓存不一致。
why_en: An in-memory cache fits read-heavy, rarely updated data because one database result can serve many reads.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据每次都必须读到最新写入，或者缓存丢失就会丢业务数据，应该优先读持久存储。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Web --> Cache{Cache hit?}
Cache -- yes --> Client[Return]
Cache -- no --> DB[(DB)]
DB --> Cache

termDefinitions.meaning: 把常用或昂贵结果临时放在更快介质里的存储层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cache stores frequent or expensive results in a faster temporary layer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存项保留多久后过期的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the time a cached item remains valid before expiring.

optionMeanings: 内存缓存把热资料页结果放在低延迟存储里。
跨地域强同步写入追求多区域写后强一致。
把 session 放回 Web 机器会让实例重新有状态。
全表扫描每次重新读完整表。
optionDirectness: 读多写少且允许失效策略时更合适。
金融余额这类跨区写入也必须强一致时才考虑。
单机 demo 或固定小流量内部工具才可能接受。
小表后台任务或一次性运维查询才可能用。
optionScenarioImpacts: 重复读取先打缓存，数据库 CPU 压力下降。
会增加写延迟，仍不解决重复资料读取。
自动扩缩容和故障替换会更难。
会把已经高的数据库 CPU 继续打高。
tradeoff: 读延迟和数据库减压 vs 缓存失效和旧数据风险
optionMeanings_en: An in-memory cache layer.
Cross-region synchronous writes.
Move sessions back into web servers.
Run a full table scan on every read.
optionDirectness_en: Use when one database result can serve many reads.
Only fits when this statement is true: cross-region synchronous writes.
Only fits when this statement is true: move sessions back into web servers.
Only fits when the goal is to run a full table scan on every read.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It creates this risk here: An in-memory cache layer.
It creates this risk here: Cross-region synchronous writes.
It commits the design to this assumption: Move sessions back into web servers.
It commits the design to this assumption: Run a full table scan on every read.

scenario: 商品价格缓存设置为 24 小时，但价格一天内会被运营多次调整。
scenario_en: Product prices are cached for 24 hours, but operations can change prices several times a day.
q: 这个 TTL 最大的风险是什么？
q_en: What is the main risk of this TTL?
options: 用户可能长期看到旧价格
数据库读压力一定变为零
缓存会自动持久化全部数据
负载均衡器无法工作
options_en: Users may see stale prices for a long time
Database read load becomes exactly zero
The cache automatically persists all data
The load balancer stops working
why: TTL 太长会把旧数据留在缓存里，价格这种敏感字段尤其危险。更稳的做法是缩短 TTL，并在价格变更时主动失效对应 key。
why_en: A long TTL can keep stale price data in cache, so sensitive fields need shorter TTLs or explicit invalidation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 已经不是最新状态但仍被系统返回的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stale data is data that is no longer current but is still returned.

termDefinitions.meaning: 主动删除或标记缓存项失效的动作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Invalidation explicitly removes or marks a cached item as no longer valid.

scenario: 全球用户都在下载同一批图片、CSS 和 JavaScript。源站带宽贵，欧洲用户访问美国源站很慢。
scenario_en: Global users download the same images, CSS, and JavaScript; origin bandwidth is expensive and Europe is slow against a U.S. origin.
q: 静态资源应该放到哪里？
q_en: Where should static assets be served from?
options: CDN 边缘节点
主数据库从库
每台应用服务器本地磁盘
消息队列
options_en: CDN edge nodes
Database replicas
Local disks on every app server
A message queue
why: CDN 把静态资源放到离用户更近的边缘节点，减少源站带宽和跨洲往返时间。但低命中、频繁变化的资源可能不值得缓存。
why_en: A CDN serves static assets near users, reducing origin bandwidth and long-distance latency.
whenOtherWins: 如果资源只被后台少量用户访问，或者每次都带用户私有内容，直接走源站更省事。

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式边缘服务器网络，用来缓存并分发静态内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN is a distributed edge network that caches and serves static content.

termDefinitions.meaning: CDN 未命中时回源读取内容的源服务器或对象存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The origin is the source server or object store used when the CDN misses.

tradeoff: 边缘低延迟和省源站带宽 vs CDN 成本和失效复杂度

scenario: Web 集群要自动扩缩容，但用户登录 session 存在各自 Web 机器内存里。
scenario_en: A web cluster needs autoscaling, but login sessions are stored in each web server's memory.
q: 要先改成什么架构？
q_en: What architecture change should come first?
options: 把 session 移到共享存储，让 Web 层无状态
强制所有用户使用固定 Web 机器
把数据库和 Web 合回一台机器
只增加 CDN 节点
options_en: Move sessions to shared storage and make web servers stateless
Force every user to a fixed web server
Merge database and web back onto one machine
Only add CDN nodes
why: 无状态 Web 层让任意请求都能落到任意实例，扩缩容和故障替换才简单。共享 session 存储会多一次读取，所以要选低延迟、可扩展的存储。
why_en: Moving sessions to shared storage makes any web instance interchangeable, which enables autoscaling and failover.
whenOtherWins: 很小的内部工具可以先用 sticky session；用户多、机器常增删时，它会拖慢扩容和故障恢复。

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务实例本身不保存跨请求必须依赖的用户状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stateless service instance does not keep required user state across requests.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负载均衡器把同一客户端持续路由到同一后端实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sticky sessions route the same client to the same backend instance.

tradeoff: 实例可替换和自动扩缩容 vs 共享状态读取成本

scenario: 服务有北美和亚洲用户。单个美国机房正常时亚洲延迟高，机房故障时全站不可用。
scenario_en: A service has North American and Asian users; one U.S. data center causes high Asia latency and total outage risk.
q: 多机房入口怎么路由？
q_en: How should traffic be routed across data centers?
options: 用 GeoDNS 把用户导到就近健康机房
让用户手动输入机房 IP
所有请求先写主机房再返回
每小时随机切换机房
options_en: Use GeoDNS to route users to a nearby healthy data center
Ask users to type a data-center IP
Write every request to the primary data center first
Randomly switch data centers every hour
why: GeoDNS 可以按用户位置和机房健康度分流，正常时降延迟，故障时切走流量。难点会转到跨机房数据复制、部署一致性和演练。
why_en: GeoDNS can route users to a nearby healthy data center, trading lower latency for harder replication and operations.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务只服务一个城市，单区域加好备份和灾备演练可能先够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 按用户地理位置或策略返回不同服务 IP 的 DNS 能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GeoDNS returns different service IPs based on user location or routing policy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 主路径故障后把流量或角色切到健康备用路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Failover moves traffic or roles to a healthy backup path after a failure.

tradeoff: 就近访问和机房容灾 vs 跨机房数据同步复杂度

scenario: 用户上传照片后要裁剪、锐化和生成缩略图。处理要几秒钟，但上传接口不能一直阻塞。
scenario_en: After photo upload, the system must crop, sharpen, and create thumbnails; processing takes seconds but the upload API should not block.
q: 这里该加什么解耦组件？
q_en: What component should decouple this workflow?
options: 消息队列加后台 worker
同步在上传请求里做完所有处理
把图片存在 DNS
只扩大负载均衡器
options_en: A message queue with background workers
Do all processing synchronously in the upload request
Store images in DNS
Only scale the load balancer
why: 队列让上传接口快速确认任务，耗时处理交给 worker 慢慢消费。代价是结果变成异步可见，还要处理重试和幂等。
why_en: A queue lets the upload API accept work quickly while workers process slow photo jobs asynchronously.
whenOtherWins: 如果操作必须在响应前完成，比如付款授权，同步路径或短超时调用更合适。
diagram:
flowchart LR
API[Upload API] --> Q[(Queue)]
Q --> W1[Worker]
Q --> W2[Worker]
W1 --> Store[(Image store)]

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存待处理消息并让生产者和消费者异步通信的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A message queue stores work items and lets producers and consumers communicate asynchronously.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一任务重复执行不会造成额外业务副作用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotent operation can run more than once without extra business side effects.

tradeoff: 上传接口快返回 vs 后台异步和幂等复杂度

scenario: 服务已经有几十台机器，线上偶发超时和错误码上涨，单机 SSH 看日志已经追不动。
scenario_en: The service runs on dozens of machines with intermittent timeouts and rising error codes; SSHing into each box no longer works.
q: 哪些能力应该补上？
q_en: Which capabilities should be added?
options: 集中日志搜索
主机和服务级指标
自动化构建测试部署
删除所有业务指标
options_en: Centralized log search
Host and service-level metrics
Automated build, test, and deploy
Delete all business metrics
why: 规模上来后，日志帮你找具体错误，指标帮你看系统趋势，自动化减少人为发布失误。业务指标也要留，因为技术健康不等于产品健康。
why_en: At scale, centralized logs, metrics, and automation make failures observable and deployments repeatable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按时间采样的数值信号，比如 CPU、错误率、延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A metric is a time-series signal such as CPU, error rate, or latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持续集成，每次代码变更后自动构建和测试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Continuous Integration automatically builds and tests each code change.

scenario: 用户表已经超过单机容量，查询基本都带 user_id，目标是把数据均匀分到多台数据库。
scenario_en: The user table is beyond one machine, queries usually include user_id, and data should spread evenly across database servers.
q: 分片键优先选什么？
q_en: What should be the first candidate shard key?
options: 高基数且常在查询里的 user_id
用户昵称首字母
注册当天日期
最后登录城市
options_en: High-cardinality user_id that appears in queries
First letter of the username
Signup date
Last login city
why: 好的分片键要让路由明确，也要尽量均匀分布，user_id 通常满足这两点。代价是跨用户 join 和热点用户要额外处理。
why_en: A good shard key routes queries directly and spreads data evenly; user_id often does both.
whenOtherWins: 如果核心查询按租户隔离，且每个租户数据量接近，tenant_id 可能比 user_id 更符合访问模式。

termDefinitions.meaning: 决定一行数据落到哪个分片的字段或字段组合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shard key is the field or fields that decide which shard stores a row.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个 key 或分片承受远高于平均值的访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hotspot is a key or shard receiving much more traffic than average.

tradeoff: 负载均匀和查询局部性 vs 分片迁移复杂度

q: 浏览器访问 api.example.com 的基本请求链路是什么？
q_en: What is the basic request path when a browser visits api.example.com?
steps: 浏览器拿到 IP 后向服务入口发 HTTP 请求。
DNS 把域名解析成可连接的 IP 地址。
入口 Web 服务处理请求并返回 HTML 或 JSON。
用户先输入或点击域名，而不是直接记服务器 IP。
why: 这条链路把命名、寻址、传输和应用响应分开看。排查慢请求时，我会先确认 DNS、网络入口、Web 服务各自有没有问题。
why_en: The request path separates naming, addressing, transport, and application handling, which helps isolate latency or failure.
diagram:
flowchart LR
User[User] --> DNS[DNS lookup]
DNS --> IP[Service IP]
IP --> Web[Web/API server]
Web --> Resp[HTML or JSON]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把域名解析成 IP 地址的系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DNS maps domain names to IP addresses.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端和 Web 服务交换请求与响应的应用层协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP is the application protocol for web requests and responses.

scenario: 同一个后端同时服务浏览器和手机 App。浏览器要页面渲染，手机 App 更常拿结构化 API 数据。
scenario_en: The same backend serves browsers and mobile apps; browsers render pages, while mobile apps usually fetch structured API data.
q: 后端响应格式应怎么分层？
q_en: How should response formats be separated?
options: Web 返回页面，App 返回 JSON
所有端都下载数据库快照
App 解析整页 HTML 当 API
浏览器和手机直连数据库
options_en: Web returns pages while apps receive JSON
Every client downloads database snapshots
Apps parse full HTML pages as the API
Browsers and phones connect to the database
why: 浏览器和移动端的展示方式不同，但都应该通过受控 HTTP API 访问后端。JSON 适合移动端传结构化数据，数据库不能暴露给客户端。
why_en: Browsers and mobile apps can share HTTP backends, but mobile clients usually consume structured JSON rather than direct database access.
tradeoff: 展示耦合度 vs API 可复用性

termDefinitions.meaning: 轻量文本数据格式，常用于 API 响应。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: JSON is a lightweight text format commonly used for API responses.

scenario: 团队说“用 NoSQL”，但候选方案包括键值、文档、列族和图数据库。
scenario_en: The team says “use NoSQL,” but candidates include key-value, document, column-family, and graph databases.
q: 哪些属于常见 NoSQL 类别？
q_en: Which are common NoSQL categories?
options: 键值存储
文档存储
图存储
浏览器 CSS
options_en: Key-value store
Document store
Graph store
Browser CSS
why: NoSQL 不是一种数据库，而是一组非关系模型。面试里要继续追问访问模式，否则“用 NoSQL”信息太少。
why_en: NoSQL is a family of non-relational models, so the access pattern matters more than the label.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按 key 直接读写 value 的存储，适合简单高速查找。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A key-value store reads and writes values directly by key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存 JSON 类文档并按字段查询的存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A document store saves JSON-like documents and can query fields.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把实体和关系作为一等对象，适合关系遍历。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A graph store treats entities and relationships as first-class data for traversals.

scenario: 单台应用服务器 CPU 长期 85%，内存接近上限，升级机器还能撑一阵，但业务增长很快。
scenario_en: One app server sits at 85% CPU and near memory limit; a bigger machine can help briefly, but traffic is growing fast.
q: 为什么不能只靠 scale-up？
q_en: Why not rely only on scale-up?
options: 单机硬件有上限，且故障时没有冗余
scale-up 会自动跨机房容灾
scale-up 天然让请求并行到多台机器
scale-up 会消除数据库延迟
options_en: One machine has hardware limits and no redundancy on failure
Scale-up automatically gives multi-data-center recovery
Scale-up naturally spreads requests across many machines
Scale-up removes database latency
why: scale-up 简单，但容量和可用性都卡在一台机器上。大流量系统通常要转向 scale-out，用多实例分摊负载和故障。
why_en: Scale-up is simple, but one machine still has hard capacity limits and remains a failure domain.
tradeoff: 简单运维 vs 容量上限和冗余

termDefinitions.meaning: 给单台机器增加 CPU、内存或磁盘。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scale-up adds CPU, memory, or disk to one machine.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过增加更多机器扩容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scale-out adds more machines to increase capacity.

scenario: 负载均衡器有公网 IP，后端 Web 服务器只需要被负载均衡器访问。
scenario_en: The load balancer has a public IP, and backend web servers only need to be reached by the load balancer.
q: 后端服务器 IP 应如何暴露？
q_en: How should backend server IPs be exposed?
options: 后端只用私有 IP，对公网不可直连
每台后端都开放公网 SSH 和 HTTP
把数据库公网 IP 写进客户端
让用户绕过负载均衡器
options_en: Use private IPs for backends and block direct public access
Expose public SSH and HTTP on every backend
Put the database public IP in clients
Let users bypass the load balancer
why: 后端只接收来自内部网络或负载均衡器的流量，攻击面更小。入口策略、TLS 和健康检查也能集中在负载均衡层。
why_en: Private backend IPs reduce exposure and keep public ingress policy at the load balancer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只在私有网络内可达的地址，通常不能被公网直接访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A private IP is reachable inside a private network but not directly from the public internet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护网络连接机密性和完整性的协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TLS protects confidentiality and integrity for network connections.

scenario: 系统只有一个读副本。它宕机后，读请求不能长时间失败，但主库仍然健康。
scenario_en: The system has one read replica. It fails, reads should not fail for long, and the primary is still healthy.
q: 临时读流量该怎么处理？
q_en: How should read traffic be handled temporarily?
options: 短时读主库，并尽快补新副本
立即提升坏掉的副本为主库
丢弃所有读请求直到明天
让客户端轮询数据库文件
options_en: Temporarily read from the primary and add a new replica soon
Promote the failed replica to primary
Drop all reads until tomorrow
Have clients poll database files
why: 只有读副本挂了时，主库可以短时兜底读流量。代价是主库压力上升，所以要尽快恢复副本，避免写路径也被拖慢。
why_en: If the only read replica fails, the primary can serve reads briefly, but replica capacity should be restored quickly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 主要承担读请求的数据库副本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica is a database copy mainly used to serve reads.

scenario: 主库宕机，但一个副本还活着。副本可能落后主库几秒钟。
scenario_en: The primary database fails, but one replica is alive; the replica may be a few seconds behind.
q: 提升副本前最该注意什么？
q_en: What matters most before promoting the replica?
options: 确认复制落后和缺失写入的恢复方案
直接假设副本永远最新
删除所有未读数据
把 Web 服务器变成数据库
options_en: Check replication lag and plan recovery for missing writes
Assume the replica is always current
Delete all unread data
Turn web servers into databases
why: 副本提升能恢复写入口，但落后的写入可能丢或乱序。生产切主通常要结合日志、恢复脚本和客户端重试语义。
why_en: Promoting a replica restores writes, but replication lag means missing writes must be understood and recovered.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把副本切换成新的主库角色。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Promotion changes a replica into the new primary.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副本复制进度落后主库的差距。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Replication lag is how far a replica is behind the primary.

scenario: 用户刚更新昵称，下一秒刷新个人页却从读副本读到旧昵称。产品要求用户至少能读到自己的最新修改。
scenario_en: A user updates a display name, then refreshes and reads the old value from a replica; the product requires users to see their own latest writes.
q: 怎么缓解读后写不一致？
q_en: How can you reduce read-after-write inconsistency?
options: 写后短时间读主库或带版本路由
让所有读永远随机打副本
把 TTL 调到一年
关闭写入确认
options_en: Read from primary briefly after writes or route by version
Always send reads to random replicas
Set TTL to one year
Disable write acknowledgment
why: 读后写一致性要求会改变读路由：刚写完的用户读主库，或等副本追上指定版本再读。代价是主库读压力和路由复杂度上升。
why_en: Read-after-write consistency can require primary reads or version-aware routing until replicas catch up.
whenOtherWins: 如果页面允许几秒旧数据，比如公开计数，继续读副本更省主库。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户写入成功后，后续读取能看到这次写入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Read-after-write consistency means a user can read their own successful write.

tradeoff: 读到最新写 vs 读扩展和副本延迟

scenario: 缓存内存满了，新热点数据还在进入。目标是尽量保留最近被访问的数据。
scenario_en: Cache memory is full while new hot data keeps arriving; the goal is to keep recently accessed data.
q: 淘汰策略优先选什么？
q_en: Which eviction policy fits first?
options: LRU
FIFO
随机删除数据库
永不过期
options_en: LRU
FIFO
Randomly delete database rows
Never expire anything
why: LRU 会优先淘汰最久没被访问的 key，适合最近访问能预测未来访问的缓存。代价是维护访问顺序有开销，扫描型流量可能污染缓存。
why_en: LRU keeps recently accessed keys and evicts old ones, which fits caches with temporal locality.
whenOtherWins: 如果访问频次比最近访问更能预测热度，LFU 可能更合适。

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用淘汰，优先移除最久没访问的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU evicts the item that has not been accessed for the longest time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最不经常使用淘汰，优先移除访问次数少的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LFU evicts items with the lowest access frequency.

tradeoff: 热点命中率 vs 淘汰成本和策略复杂度

scenario: logo.png 已经被 CDN 缓存 7 天，但今天发布了新 logo，用户需要尽快看到新文件。
scenario_en: logo.png is cached by the CDN for 7 days, but a new logo was released today and users should see it soon.
q: 更新静态资源常用做法是什么？
q_en: What is a common way to update static assets?
options: 版本化 URL 或 CDN 失效
等所有用户手动清缓存
把图片塞进主库事务
关闭 DNS 让缓存消失
options_en: Use versioned URLs or CDN invalidation
Wait for users to clear caches manually
Put images inside primary DB transactions
Disable DNS so caches disappear
why: 版本化 URL 会让新资源变成新对象，invalidation 则主动让旧对象失效。两者都避免用户长期拿到旧静态文件。
why_en: Versioned URLs or CDN invalidation let clients fetch fresh static assets before the old TTL naturally expires.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通知 CDN 删除或标记某个缓存对象失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDN invalidation tells the CDN to remove or expire a cached object.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在资源路径或查询参数中加入版本号，让新旧资源有不同缓存 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A versioned URL adds a version to the path or query so new and old assets have different cache keys.

scenario: 所有读请求都依赖一台缓存服务器；这台机器重启时，应用读路径大面积超时。
scenario_en: All read requests depend on one cache server; when it restarts, the application read path times out broadly.
q: 缓存层怎么避免单点？
q_en: How should the cache layer avoid a single point of failure?
options: 多缓存节点并允许回源降级
把唯一缓存机器换成更贵机器
让缓存保存唯一业务数据
删除数据库
options_en: Use multiple cache nodes and allow fallback to origin
Replace the one cache box with a more expensive box
Store the only business copy in cache
Delete the database
why: 缓存应该是加速层，不该是唯一真相来源。多节点降低单点风险，回源降级让缓存故障时服务还能慢一点运行。
why_en: A cache should accelerate reads, not be the only source of truth; multiple nodes and origin fallback reduce blast radius.
whenOtherWins: 如果是一次性实验脚本，单缓存可以接受；线上核心路径不该这样赌。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个组件故障就会让整个系统不可用的单点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A single point of failure is one component whose failure can take down the system.

tradeoff: 缓存高可用和回源降级 vs 更多节点和容量成本

scenario: 登录态从 Web 服务器内存移走后，团队要选共享 session 存储，访问频繁且要求低延迟。
scenario_en: After moving sessions out of web server memory, the team needs a shared session store with frequent low-latency access.
q: session 存储优先选什么？
q_en: What should be the first session store choice?
options: Redis 或可扩展 NoSQL 这类共享低延迟存储
每台 Web 机器本地文件
用户浏览器随便改的明文 cookie
CDN 静态目录
options_en: Shared low-latency storage such as Redis or scalable NoSQL
Local files on each web server
Plain cookies that users can edit freely
A CDN static directory
why: 共享低延迟存储让任意 Web 实例都能校验登录态。要注意过期、加密或签名，以及存储故障时的登录体验。
why_en: A shared low-latency store lets any web instance validate session state while preserving stateless web servers.
whenOtherWins: 如果 session 很小且只需防篡改，签名 cookie 可以减少服务端读取。

termDefinitions.meaning: 带服务器签名的 cookie，客户端可携带但不能伪造内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signed cookie is carried by the client but protected from tampering by a server signature.

tradeoff: 无状态 Web 扩容 vs session 存储延迟和故障处理

scenario: 照片处理 worker 处理速度跟不上上传速度，队列长度持续上涨。
scenario_en: Photo-processing workers cannot keep up with uploads, and the queue length keeps growing.
q: 队列长度上涨说明什么？
q_en: What does rising queue length indicate?
options: 入流大于消费，要扩 worker 或限流
生产者已经全部停止发送任务
数据库一定没有任何瓶颈
可以删掉队列监控面板
options_en: Arrival rate exceeds processing; scale workers or throttle
Producers have completely stopped sending work
The database is guaranteed to have no bottleneck
The queue monitoring dashboard can be removed
why: 队列是缓冲，也是一种背压信号。长度持续上涨说明进入速度大于消费速度，要扩消费者、优化处理或限制入口。
why_en: A growing queue is a backpressure signal that arrivals exceed processing capacity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时向上游传递压力或限制入口的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure signals upstream producers to slow down when downstream cannot keep up.

scenario: 一个大型站点要建立基础监控面板，用来同时看机器健康、服务层瓶颈和业务变化。
scenario_en: A large site needs basic dashboards for machine health, service bottlenecks, and business movement.
q: 哪些指标层级应该覆盖？
q_en: Which metric levels should be covered?
options: 主机 CPU、内存、磁盘 I/O
数据库层和缓存层整体延迟/错误
DAU、留存、收入等业务指标
只统计代码行数
options_en: Host CPU, memory, and disk I/O
Database and cache tier latency/errors
Business metrics such as DAU, retention, and revenue
Only count lines of code
why: 主机指标看资源，聚合层指标看系统瓶颈，业务指标看用户影响。只看其中一层，很容易误判线上问题。
why_en: Host, tier-level, and business metrics together connect resource health to user impact.

termDefinitions.meaning: 磁盘读写操作和吞吐情况。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Disk I/O describes disk read and write operations and throughput.

scenario: 按 user_id % 4 分片后，用户增长很快，某个分片快满了，继续扩到 8 个分片会移动大量数据。
scenario_en: After sharding by user_id % 4, users grow quickly; one shard is almost full, and moving to 8 shards would relocate lots of data.
q: 扩分片时应考虑什么？
q_en: What should you consider when expanding shards?
options: 规划 resharding 和迁移窗口
只改分片函数不搬数据
把快满的分片直接关掉
让客户端猜数据位置
options_en: Plan resharding and a migration window
Change the shard function without moving data
Turn off the nearly full shard
Let clients guess where data lives
why: 分片函数变化会改变 key 到分片的映射，所以必须计划数据迁移和双写/回填窗口。一致性哈希能减少扩容时受影响的 key 范围。
why_en: Changing the shard mapping requires planned data movement, and consistent hashing can reduce how many keys move.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据量还很小，离线停机迁移可能比复杂在线迁移更便宜。

termDefinitions.meaning: 改变分片数量或映射，并把数据迁移到新分片布局。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Resharding changes shard count or mapping and moves data into the new layout.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种哈希映射方法，增删节点时只移动部分 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps keys so adding or removing nodes moves only part of the keyspace.

tradeoff: 扩容灵活性 vs 数据迁移和路由复杂度

scenario: 订单和用户表按不同 key 分到多台数据库。一个报表需要频繁 join 用户属性和订单明细。
scenario_en: Orders and users are sharded by different keys across databases, while a report frequently joins user attributes with order details.
q: 跨分片 join 会带来什么后果？
q_en: What is the consequence of cross-shard joins?
options: 查询要跨多分片协调，常需要反范式或离线报表
join 会自动比单库更快
所有事务都变成本地事务
缓存 TTL 自动变短
options_en: Queries coordinate across shards, often requiring denormalization or offline reporting
Joins automatically become faster than single-database joins
All transactions become local transactions
Cache TTLs automatically shorten
why: 分片后数据不在同一台库里，join 会变成跨节点网络和聚合问题。常见解法是按查询反范式、预聚合，或走离线分析链路。
why_en: After sharding, joins across nodes become distributed queries, so denormalization or offline aggregation is often needed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为了读性能把冗余字段写进同一张表或同一份文档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Denormalization stores redundant fields together to make reads faster.

scenario: 社交应用按 user_id 分片，但几个超大 V 的主页读取量远高于普通用户，单个分片被打爆。
scenario_en: A social app shards by user_id, but a few celebrity profiles receive far more reads than normal users and overload one shard.
q: 热点用户怎么处理？
q_en: How should celebrity hot keys be handled?
options: 给热点 key 单独拆分、缓存或复制读副本
继续把所有热点放同一分片
删除热门用户数据
只增加客户端动画
options_en: Split, cache, or replicate hot keys separately
Keep every hot key on the same shard
Delete celebrity data
Only add client animations
why: 均匀分片不等于均匀流量，热点 key 需要单独隔离或复制读能力。代价是路由规则和一致性处理更复杂。
why_en: Evenly sharded data can still have uneven traffic, so hot keys may need isolation, caching, or read replication.
whenOtherWins: 如果热点只是短暂活动峰值，短 TTL 缓存和限流可能比重分片更快落地。
tradeoff: 热点隔离 vs 额外缓存/复制成本

scenario: GeoDNS 已把欧洲用户导到欧洲机房，但用户资料只写在美国数据库。美国机房故障时欧洲读不到完整资料。
scenario_en: GeoDNS routes European users to an EU data center, but profiles are only written in a U.S. database; during a U.S. outage, Europe cannot read full profiles.
q: 多机房还必须补什么？
q_en: What else is required for multi-data-center design?
options: 跨机房数据复制和故障演练
只改 DNS 名字
把所有缓存 TTL 设为无限
删除欧洲入口
options_en: Cross-data-center replication and failover drills
Only rename DNS records
Set every cache TTL to infinite
Delete the European entry point
why: 流量能切过去不代表数据也在那边。多机房设计要一起考虑复制延迟、冲突策略、部署一致性和定期演练。
why_en: Traffic routing alone is not enough; multi-data-center systems need replicated data and tested failover behavior.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是静态官网，CDN 加单源站备份可能先够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据复制到多个地理位置的机房。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-data-center replication copies data across geographically separate data centers.

tradeoff: 流量可切换 vs 数据可用和复制冲突处理

q: 存储估算里 byte 和 bit 怎么换算？
q_en: How do bytes and bits convert in storage estimates?
text: 1 byte = {{8 bits}}；ASCII 字符粗估可以按 {{1 byte}} 算。这个换算会影响消息大小、对象大小和带宽估算。
text_en: 1 byte = {{8 bits}}, and an ASCII character is roughly {{1 byte}}; this feeds message size, object size, and bandwidth estimates.
why: 我会先把单位写清楚，因为 5MB 和 5Mb 差 8 倍。后续算存储、网络带宽、缓存容量都靠这个基数。
why_en: Write units first because MB and Mb differ by 8x, and that changes storage, bandwidth, and cache sizing.

termDefinitions.fullName: American Standard Code for Information Interchange
termDefinitions.meaning: 常见英文字符编码，粗估时一个字符约 1 byte。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ASCII is a character encoding where a simple English character is roughly one byte.

scenario: 你要估 API 响应大小、缓存容量和网络带宽，字段大小有的用 byte，有的用 bit。
scenario_en: You need to estimate API payload size, cache capacity, and network bandwidth, and some fields use bytes while others use bits.

scenario: 一个社交产品有 300M 月活，50% 每天使用，每个日活平均每天发 2 条内容。
scenario_en: A social product has 300M monthly users, 50% use it daily, and each daily user posts 2 items per day.
q: 这个写入量级会怎样影响设计？
q_en: How should this write volume influence the design?
options: 按几千 QPS 先规划写库、队列和限流容量
按亿级 QPS 直接设计全球强一致写入
忽略写路径，只优化图片 CDN
把月活数直接当成每秒写入数
options_en: Plan write DB, queue, and limiter capacity around a few thousand QPS
Design for hundreds of millions of globally consistent writes per second
Ignore the write path and only optimize image CDN
Treat monthly active users as writes per second
why: 公式是 300M × 50% × 2 / 86400 ≈ 3.5K QPS，QPS 是 Queries Per Second。它会喂给写入数据库、队列和限流容量的初始估算。
why_en: 300M times 50% times 2 divided by 86,400 is about 3.5K QPS, which seeds write-path capacity planning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒请求或查询数，常用来估算服务吞吐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS means Queries Per Second and is used to estimate service throughput.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日活跃用户数，一天内使用产品的用户数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU means Daily Active Users, the number of users active in a day.

scenario: 你已经估出平均写入约 3.5K QPS。面试里没有更细的流量曲线，只需要先做粗容量规划。
scenario_en: You estimated about 3.5K average write QPS and have no detailed traffic curve, only rough capacity planning.
q: 峰值 QPS 可以先怎么估？
q_en: How can you first estimate peak QPS?
options: 用平均值乘一个简单峰值系数，比如 2 倍
假设峰值等于 0
把月活直接当每秒请求
只看数据库磁盘大小
options_en: Multiply average QPS by a simple peak factor such as 2x
Assume peak is zero
Treat monthly users as requests per second
Only look at database disk size
why: 粗估时可以先用 peak QPS ≈ 2 × average QPS = 7K QPS，并说明这是临时假设。这个数会决定限流阈值、队列缓冲和横向扩容起点。
why_en: A simple 2x peak factor gives about 7K QPS and should be stated as an assumption for capacity planning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 流量高峰时每秒请求数，通常高于全天平均值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Peak QPS is the requests per second during high traffic periods.

scenario: 150M 日活每天发 2 条内容，10% 带 1MB 媒体，媒体保留 5 年。
scenario_en: 150M daily users post 2 items per day, 10% include 1MB media, and media is retained for 5 years.
q: 这个媒体量级会把设计推向哪里？
q_en: Where does this media volume push the design?
options: 对象存储、生命周期归档和 CDN 分发
单机磁盘长期保存所有媒体
把媒体塞进关系库行字段
只靠浏览器缓存当持久层
options_en: Object storage, lifecycle archival, and CDN delivery
One local disk keeping all media forever
Put media blobs inside relational table rows
Use browser cache as the persistence layer
why: 公式是 150M × 2 × 10% × 1MB ≈ 30TB/day；5 年约 30TB × 365 × 5 ≈ 55PB。这个量级会把设计推向对象存储、生命周期策略和 CDN，而不是单机磁盘。
why_en: The estimate is about 30TB per day and 55PB over five years, which points to object storage and lifecycle policies.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拍字节，约等于 1024TB，粗估时也常按 1000TB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A petabyte is roughly 1,024 terabytes, often rounded to 1,000 terabytes in estimates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按对象保存大文件和元数据的存储服务，常用于图片、视频、备份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Object storage stores files and metadata as objects, often for images, videos, and backups.

scenario: 一个请求路径既可以走内存缓存，也可以每次做磁盘随机读取。目标是低延迟。
scenario_en: A request path can either hit an in-memory cache or perform random disk reads, and the goal is low latency.
q: 粗估时应该偏向哪条路径？
q_en: Which path should the rough design prefer?
options: 内存缓存路径
磁盘随机 seek 路径
跨洲同步读路径
先压缩再本地内存读
options_en: The in-memory cache path
The random disk seek path
The cross-continent synchronous read path
Compress before local memory read
why: 内存访问通常是纳秒到微秒级，磁盘随机 seek 常慢几个数量级。低延迟读路径先用缓存挡住热数据，磁盘更适合冷数据和持久化。
why_en: Memory is orders of magnitude faster than random disk access, so hot low-latency reads should hit cache first.
tradeoff: 低延迟热读 vs 持久化和容量

termDefinitions.meaning: 磁盘定位到目标数据位置的动作，随机访问时很耗时。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A disk seek is the operation of moving to the target data location, which is slow for random access.

scenario: 服务要跨公网传大量文本 JSON，CPU 还有余量，公网带宽和传输时间是主要瓶颈。
scenario_en: A service sends large text JSON payloads over the public internet; CPU has spare capacity and bandwidth is the bottleneck.
q: 发送前可以先做什么？
q_en: What can you do before sending?
options: 用轻量压缩减少字节数
把 JSON 拆成更多小请求
强制走磁盘临时文件
关闭所有缓存
options_en: Use lightweight compression to reduce bytes
Split JSON into more tiny requests
Force temporary disk files
Disable all caches
why: 文本压缩通常比跨公网多传字节便宜，尤其是重复字段多的 JSON。代价是两端多一点 CPU，所以 CPU 已经打满时要重新算。
why_en: Lightweight compression can trade a little CPU for fewer network bytes, which helps when bandwidth dominates latency.
whenOtherWins: 如果 payload 很小或已经是压缩图片、视频，再压缩收益会很低。

termDefinitions.meaning: 常见文本数据交换格式，字段名重复时通常可压缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: JSON is a text data format whose repeated field names often compress well.

tradeoff: 先降重复请求 vs 增加客户端和缓存逻辑

scenario: 一个付费 API 对客户承诺 99.9% uptime。你要把这个承诺转成工程上的停机预算。
scenario_en: A paid API promises 99.9% uptime, and you need to translate that into an engineering downtime budget.
q: 这个 SLA 对工程设计意味着什么？
q_en: What does this SLA mean for engineering design?
options: 需要冗余、监控告警和发布回滚来守住小时级预算
可以接受每月多天停机
只要单机够大就不需要备份
不用记录故障时间
options_en: Use redundancy, alerts, and rollback to protect an hours-level budget
Accept multiple days of outage per month
A large single machine removes the need for backups
Do not track incident duration
why: 99.9% 表示不可用 0.1%，一年 8760 小时 × 0.001 ≈ 8.8 小时。这个预算会影响冗余、发布策略、监控告警和灾备演练。
why_en: 99.9% uptime leaves about 8.8 hours of downtime per year, which drives redundancy and operations planning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务提供方对客户正式承诺的可用性或性能目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLA is a formal service commitment such as uptime or performance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务可正常工作的时间比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Uptime is the percentage of time a service is operational.

q: 面试中做粗估的顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the right order for a back-of-the-envelope estimate in an interview?
steps: 把算出的 QPS、存储或服务器数连到设计选择。
先写清假设，比如用户数、活跃比例、对象大小、保留时间。
用圆整数字计算，并在每一步标单位。
和面试官确认哪些结果需要继续细化。
why: 粗估考的是推理过程，不是心算表演。假设、单位和设计含义讲清楚，结果有一点误差也能继续讨论。
why_en: Back-of-the-envelope estimation is about assumptions, units, and design consequences, not exact arithmetic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用简单假设和常识数字快速估系统容量或性能需求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Back-of-the-envelope estimation uses simple assumptions and known anchors to estimate capacity or performance.

scenario: 你估算图片存储，平均对象 2MB，每天 5M 张。面试官允许粗估。
scenario_en: You estimate image storage with 2MB average objects and 5M images per day; rough math is acceptable.
q: 这个日增量会怎样影响存储方案？
q_en: How should this daily growth affect storage design?
options: 按 TB/天规划对象存储、分层归档和成本控制
按 MB/天放在应用服务器本地盘
忽略保留周期，只看当天容量
把图片全部放进 DNS 记录
options_en: Plan object storage, tiered archival, and cost control around TB per day
Store it on app-server local disks as if it were MB per day
Ignore retention and only size for one day
Put every image inside DNS records
why: 公式是 2MB × 5M = 10M MB，粗估按 1TB ≈ 1M MB，所以约 10TB/天。这个数会决定对象存储、生命周期归档和 CDN 成本。
why_en: 2MB times 5M is about 10TB per day, which drives object storage, retention, and CDN cost planning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 太字节，粗估时常按约 1000GB 或约 1,000,000MB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A terabyte is roughly 1,000GB or about 1,000,000MB for rough estimates.

scenario: 一个图片服务峰值 2K QPS，每个响应平均 500KB，主要瓶颈是出口带宽。
scenario_en: An image service peaks at 2K QPS, each response averages 500KB, and egress bandwidth is the bottleneck.
q: 这个出口量级会怎样影响架构？
q_en: How should this egress volume affect architecture?
options: 需要 CDN、带宽预算和网卡容量一起规划
只扩大数据库连接池
把响应拆成更多公网往返
关闭压缩和缓存
options_en: Plan CDN, bandwidth budget, and NIC capacity together
Only enlarge the database connection pool
Split responses into more public-network round trips
Disable compression and caching
why: 公式是 2000 × 500KB = 1,000,000KB/s ≈ 1GB/s；网络常用 bit，所以乘 8 约 8Gbps。这个数会决定 CDN、网卡和跨区链路容量。
why_en: 2K times 500KB is about 1GB per second, or 8Gbps, which drives CDN and network capacity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒十亿 bit，常用于网络带宽。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gbps means gigabits per second and is commonly used for network bandwidth.

scenario: 首页有 1M 个热门对象，平均序列化后 2KB。你想把它们都放进内存缓存，并预留 30% overhead。
scenario_en: The home page has 1M hot objects, each about 2KB serialized; you want them in memory cache with 30% overhead.
q: 这个缓存量级会怎样指导节点规划？
q_en: How should this cache size guide node planning?
options: 选缓存节点规格，并判断是否需要分片和预留空间
把所有热对象留在数据库冷读
只按原始对象数忽略元数据开销
用 CDN 代替服务端缓存计数
options_en: Choose cache node size and decide whether sharding and headroom are needed
Leave all hot objects as cold database reads
Count only raw objects and ignore metadata overhead
Use CDN as a replacement for server-side cache sizing
why: 公式是 1M × 2KB ≈ 2GB，再乘 1.3 overhead 约 2.6GB。这个数用来决定缓存节点规格和是否需要分片。
why_en: 1M times 2KB is about 2GB, and 30% overhead gives roughly 2.6GB for cache sizing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 除真实数据外，索引、元数据、对象头等额外资源开销。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overhead is extra resource cost beyond the raw data, such as metadata and indexes.

scenario: 直播服务有 50M DAU，高峰时 10% 用户同时在线，每个在线用户保持 1 条长连接。
scenario_en: A live service has 50M DAU, 10% are online at peak, and each online user holds one long-lived connection.
q: 这个并发量级会怎样影响长连接设计？
q_en: How should this concurrency affect long-connection design?
options: 按百万级连接规划网关、内存和心跳流量
只按每日发帖数规划连接服务器
把并发连接当成存储 PB 数
让所有连接落到一台机器
options_en: Plan gateways, memory, and heartbeat traffic around millions of connections
Size connection servers only by daily post count
Treat concurrent connections as petabytes of storage
Put all connections on one machine
why: 公式是 50M × 10% = 5M concurrent connections；这里单位是连接数，不是 QPS。它会决定长连接网关数量、内存和心跳流量。
why_en: 50M times 10% gives about 5M concurrent connections, which sizes connection gateways and heartbeat load.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一时刻保持打开的网络连接数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concurrent connections are network connections open at the same time.

scenario: API 平均延迟 80ms，但部分用户仍抱怨很慢。你要决定看哪个指标定位尾部体验。
scenario_en: An API has 80ms average latency, but some users still complain; you need a metric for tail experience.
q: 应该补看什么延迟？
q_en: Which latency metric should you add?
options: p95 或 p99 延迟
只看最小延迟
只看请求总数
只看代码行数
options_en: p95 or p99 latency
Only minimum latency
Only total request count
Only lines of code
why: 平均值会掩盖少数慢请求，p95 表示 95% 请求不超过这个延迟。尾延迟会影响超时、重试、缓存和拆分慢依赖的设计。
why_en: Percentile latency exposes tail behavior that averages can hide, which matters for timeouts and retries.
tradeoff: 平均体验 vs 尾部体验

termDefinitions.meaning: 95% 样本小于等于该值，剩下 5% 更慢或更大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The 95th percentile is the value at or below which 95% of samples fall.

scenario: 一个核心支付服务承诺 99.99% uptime。你要估一年停机预算。
scenario_en: A core payment service promises 99.99% uptime, and you need the annual downtime budget.
q: 这个更高 SLA 会怎样改变设计？
q_en: How should this higher SLA change the design?
options: 需要更强冗余、自动故障切换和谨慎发布
可以减少监控，因为可用性目标更高
允许用单点数据库承接所有流量
不需要记录发布失败
options_en: Use stronger redundancy, automatic failover, and safer rollouts
Reduce monitoring because the target is higher
Use a single database as the only traffic path
Stop recording failed deployments
why: 99.99% 表示不可用 0.01%，8760 小时 × 0.0001 ≈ 0.876 小时，也就是约 52 分钟。这个预算会推动多副本、自动故障切换和谨慎发布。
why_en: 99.99% uptime leaves roughly 52 minutes of downtime per year, pushing stronger redundancy and rollout controls.

scenario: 候选人在白板上估容量，写了很多数字，但没有说明假设，也没有单位。
scenario_en: A candidate estimates capacity on the whiteboard with many numbers but no assumptions and no units.
q: 哪些做法会让估算更可靠？
q_en: Which practices make the estimate more reliable?
options: 写清用户数、活跃率、对象大小等假设
每一步标单位
把复杂数字圆整后口算
隐藏所有中间过程
options_en: Write assumptions such as user count, activity ratio, and object size
Label units at every step
Round complex numbers for mental math
Hide all intermediate work
why: 估算要让面试官能跟着改假设。单位和过程公开后，错一位也容易修正；隐藏过程只会降低信号。
why_en: Good estimates expose assumptions, units, and rounded math so the interviewer can adjust them with you.

scenario: 产品经理给了 10M DAU。你要估 WebSocket 服务器数量，但 DAU 不是同时在线人数。
scenario_en: A PM gives 10M DAU. You need to size WebSocket servers, but DAU is not concurrent online users.
q: 下一步应该补哪个假设？
q_en: What assumption should you add next?
options: 峰值同时在线比例
公司成立年份
页面主题色
数据库表名长度
options_en: Peak concurrent online ratio
Company founding year
Page theme color
Database table-name length
why: 长连接容量看并发，不直接看 DAU。公式是 concurrent users = DAU × peak online ratio，再用它估连接服务器、内存和心跳 QPS。
why_en: Connection capacity depends on concurrent users, so multiply DAU by a peak online ratio before sizing servers.
whenOtherWins: 如果估的是每天写入总量，DAU 和人均操作次数会比并发比例更关键。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种在客户端和服务器之间保持双向长连接的协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WebSocket is a protocol for a persistent bidirectional client-server connection.

tradeoff: 日活规模估算 vs 峰值并发容量估算

scenario: 面试官给出“设计新闻 feed”这种开放题，真实系统很复杂，45 分钟内不可能完整复刻。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks an open prompt like designing a news feed; the real system is too complex to recreate in 45 minutes.
q: 候选人最该展示什么？
q_en: What should the candidate mainly demonstrate?
options: 澄清约束、做取舍、根据反馈调整设计
背出某公司内部架构
一开始就画完整终态
拒绝讨论替代方案
options_en: Clarify constraints, make tradeoffs, and adapt to feedback
Recite one company's internal architecture
Draw the final complete architecture immediately
Refuse to discuss alternatives
why: 系统设计面试看的是协作解题信号，不是还原线上系统。你要让面试官看到约束如何改变架构选择。
why_en: The interview evaluates collaborative problem solving, so show how constraints drive architecture tradeoffs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为了满足一个约束而接受另一个成本或风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tradeoff is accepting one cost or risk to satisfy another constraint.

scenario: 你被要求设计一个社交产品的 feed，但题目没有说平台、核心功能、排序方式或规模。
scenario_en: You are asked to design a social feed, but the prompt does not specify platform, core features, ranking, or scale.
q: 哪些澄清会改变架构？
q_en: Which clarifications can change the architecture?
options: 移动端、Web 端还是两者都要
feed 按时间倒序还是个性化排序
日活和好友上限是多少
候选人喜欢哪种字体
options_en: Mobile, web, or both
Reverse chronological feed or personalized ranking
Daily active users and friend-count limit
The candidate's favorite font
why: 平台影响 API 和客户端缓存，排序影响读写路径，规模影响 fanout、缓存和存储。无关偏好不该占用面试时间。
why_en: Platform, ranking, and scale change APIs, feed generation, caching, and storage decisions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次写入被分发到多个接收者或队列的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout is distributing one write or event to many recipients or queues.

q: 系统设计面试四步法的顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the order of the four-step system design interview framework?
steps: 深入关键组件和瓶颈。
收尾：复盘、风险、运维、下一阶段扩展。
澄清问题、范围和假设。
提出高层设计并和面试官对齐。
why: 先定目标，再画蓝图，然后深挖最有信号的部分，最后讲风险和下一步。顺序错了，很容易在错误范围里精雕细琢。
why_en: Clarify scope, align on a blueprint, dive into the highest-signal components, and then wrap with risks and next steps.
diagram:
flowchart LR
A[Clarify scope] --> B[High-level design]
B --> C[Deep dive]
C --> D[Wrap up]

scenario: 澄清后，面试官同意先做支持发帖和看 feed 的 MVP，规模是 10M DAU。
scenario_en: After clarification, the interviewer agrees on an MVP for posting and reading feeds at 10M DAU.
q: 下一步最合适怎么做？
q_en: What is the best next step?
options: 画客户端、API、服务、存储、缓存和队列的高层图
立刻优化 feed 排名算法细节
只写数据库索引语法
跳过估算直接宣布完成
options_en: Draw a high-level diagram with clients, APIs, services, storage, cache, and queues
Immediately optimize feed-ranking internals
Only write database index syntax
Skip estimation and declare the design done
why: 高层图先让双方确认主路径和组件边界，再决定哪里值得深挖。太早进入算法或索引，会丢掉整体取舍。
why_en: A high-level diagram aligns the main paths and component boundaries before choosing what to deep dive.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目明确是某个组件，比如短链 hash 生成，较早进入算法细节会更合理。

termDefinitions.meaning: 最小可用产品范围，只包含验证目标所需的核心能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An MVP is the minimum product scope needed to satisfy the core goal.

tradeoff: 先框架化推进 vs 过早深挖细节

scenario: 你的高层图里有 feed 写入、feed 读取和媒体存储。面试官给了 DAU、好友上限和媒体比例。
scenario_en: Your high-level design has feed writes, feed reads, and media storage; the interviewer gave DAU, friend limit, and media ratio.
q: 粗估应该服务于什么？
q_en: What should the estimate be used for?
options: 判断 fanout、缓存、队列和存储是否够量级
只证明心算结果精确到个位数
跳过需求澄清直接定架构
用页面颜色决定服务器数量
options_en: Check whether fanout, cache, queues, and storage fit the scale
Prove mental math is exact to the last digit
Skip requirement clarification and lock the architecture
Use page colors to decide server count
why: 估算的价值是暴露容量和瓶颈，不是追求精确心算。结果要能反推组件大小、读写路径和扩容策略。
why_en: Estimates are useful when they expose capacity and bottlenecks that affect component choices.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官明确说先不看规模，可以先画功能路径，再回来补容量。
optionMeanings: 把数字接回组件容量。
把估算误解成算术考试。
没有范围就开始定方案。
用无关信息替代容量输入。
optionDirectness: 规模约束明确时适合。
几乎不适合作为设计目标。
题目范围已完全给定时才少问。
不适合系统设计判断。
optionScenarioImpacts: 能发现写入、缓存或队列瓶颈。
会浪费时间且不改架构。
可能设计错系统。
不会帮助容量规划。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次事件被分发到多个接收者或队列的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout distributes one event to many recipients or queues.

tradeoff: 容量估算服务架构选择 vs 纯算术细节
optionMeanings_en: Check whether fanout, cache, queues, and storage fit the scale.
Prove mental math is exact to the last digit.
Skip requirement clarification and lock the architecture.
Use page colors to decide server count.
optionDirectness_en: This matches the scenario constraint.
This matches the scenario constraint.
Only fits when this statement is true: skip requirement clarification and lock the architecture.
This matches the scenario constraint.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It commits the design to this path: Check whether fanout, cache, queues, and storage fit the scale.
It creates this risk here: Prove mental math is exact to the last digit.
It creates this risk here: Skip requirement clarification and lock the architecture.
It commits the design to this assumption: Use page colors to decide server count.

scenario: 高层设计已对齐。剩余 20 分钟，系统有 URL 短链生成、统计报表和管理后台三个模块。
scenario_en: The high-level design is aligned. With 20 minutes left, the system has short-code generation, analytics, and an admin console.
q: 应该优先深挖哪部分？
q_en: Which area should you deep dive first?
options: 最影响正确性或扩展性的短链生成
管理后台按钮布局
所有模块平均讲 2 分钟
继续重复高层图
options_en: The short-code generation path that drives correctness or scale
The admin button layout
Spend two minutes equally on every module
Repeat the high-level diagram
why: 深挖要挑最能展示系统能力的瓶颈或不变量，比如唯一性、冲突、容量和延迟。边角 UI 细节通常信号很弱。
why_en: Deep dive where correctness or scale is at stake, such as uniqueness, conflicts, capacity, or latency.
whenOtherWins: 如果岗位是前端架构或题目专门问后台权限，管理后台才可能变成重点。

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在任何情况下都必须保持成立的约束，比如不能重复短码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a condition the system must always preserve, such as no duplicate short codes.

tradeoff: 高信号核心风险 vs 低信号边角细节

scenario: 你已经讲完核心架构，面试还剩 5 分钟。设计能跑，但还没有讨论生产风险。
scenario_en: You finished the core architecture with five minutes left; the design can work, but production risks have not been discussed.
q: 收尾应该主动补哪些点？
q_en: What should you proactively cover in the wrap-up?
options: 瓶颈和下一步优化
故障模式和降级
监控、日志、发布
声称设计已经完美
options_en: Bottlenecks and next optimizations
Failure modes and degradation
Monitoring, logging, and rollout
Claim the design is perfect
why: 收尾要显示你知道系统上线后会坏在哪里，也知道怎么观察和演进。说完美反而是红旗。
why_en: A good wrap-up shows where the system may fail, how to observe it, and how it could evolve.

termDefinitions.meaning: 故障时保留核心能力、关闭或降低非核心能力的策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Degradation keeps core features working while reducing or disabling less critical features during failures.

scenario: 一场系统设计面试总共 45 分钟，题目比较宽，既要澄清又要画图和深挖。
scenario_en: A system design interview lasts 45 minutes and the prompt is broad, requiring clarification, diagrams, and a deep dive.
q: 时间分配应该怎么粗控？
q_en: How should you roughly budget the time?
options: 澄清几分钟，高层十几分钟，深挖留最多时间，最后收尾
澄清直接跳过，几乎全程只深挖一个点，最后一句收尾
全部时间写代码，不画组件边界，也不讨论容量
只聊天不画架构，也不确认需求、瓶颈和风险
options_en: Spend minutes clarifying, about a dozen on high level, most on deep dive, and leave wrap-up time
Skip clarification, spend almost all time on one detail, and wrap in one line
Spend all time coding without component boundaries or capacity discussion
Only chat without architecture, requirements, bottlenecks, or risks
why: 这是经验分配，不是硬公式；单位是分钟。它的用途是防止你过早陷进细节，最后没时间讲瓶颈、故障和取舍。
why_en: This minute budget is a rule of thumb that keeps you from spending the whole interview on low-level details.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经验值，不是严格定律，要随题目范围调整。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rule of thumb is a practical guideline, not a strict law.

scenario: 题目是“设计聊天系统”。你还不知道是一对一、群聊、已读回执、离线推送，还是端到端加密。
scenario_en: The prompt is “design chat,” but you do not know whether it needs one-to-one chat, groups, read receipts, offline push, or end-to-end encryption.
q: 第一步该问什么类型的问题？
q_en: What type of question should you ask first?
options: 功能范围和核心不变量
Redis 版本号
面试官手机型号
CSS 框架偏好
options_en: Feature scope and core invariants
Redis version number
The interviewer's phone model
CSS framework preference
why: 聊天系统的主路径会被功能范围改掉，比如群聊会影响 fanout，已读回执会影响写放大。先问不变量，后面才知道哪些组件必须设计。
why_en: Clarifying features and invariants first reveals which chat paths and components actually need design.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官已经给了完整 PRD，可以快速复述确认，然后进入高层设计。

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统必须一直满足的约束，比如消息不能重复显示成两条。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a condition the system must always preserve, such as avoiding duplicate message display.

tradeoff: 先澄清需求边界 vs 过早定技术方案

scenario: 设计新闻 feed 时，面试官说本轮只要求发帖、看好友 feed、按时间倒序，暂不做广告和机器学习排序。
scenario_en: For a news feed design, the interviewer says this round only needs posting, friend feeds, reverse chronological order, and no ads or ML ranking.
q: 这些非目标会带来哪些设计影响？
q_en: What design impact do these non-goals have?
options: 可以先不用设计广告竞价链路
可以先不用深挖推荐模型特征工程
仍要保留发帖和拉取 feed 的主路径
必须先训练排序模型
options_en: You can skip ad auction design for now
You can skip recommendation feature engineering for now
You still need posting and feed retrieval paths
You must train the ranking model first
why: 非目标不是闲聊，它帮你省掉不会被评分的子系统。省下的时间要投到本轮核心读写路径和扩展性上。
why_en: Non-goals remove subsystems from scope so you can spend time on the core read and write paths.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本轮明确不解决的需求，用来控制设计范围。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A non-goal is an explicitly excluded requirement that keeps scope under control.

scenario: 题目是多人扑克后端。核心动作包括入桌、下注、发牌和结算，正确性依赖状态流转。
scenario_en: The prompt is a multiplayer poker backend with join table, bet, deal, and settle actions; correctness depends on state transitions.
q: API 和数据模型要不要早讲？
q_en: Should APIs and data model be discussed early?
options: 要，核心状态机会决定服务边界和一致性
不要，任何题都只能画大框
只讲 CDN 就够了
等最后 10 秒再提
options_en: Yes, the core state machine drives service boundaries and consistency
No, every prompt should only use boxes
Only CDN matters
Mention it in the last 10 seconds
why: 有些题的难点就在对象和状态转换，API/数据模型早讲能暴露不变量。像搜索引擎这种超大题，API 细节则可以后移。
why_en: When correctness depends on state transitions, APIs and data model should appear early because they expose invariants.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目是设计 Google 搜索这类宏观系统，先讲爬取、索引和查询架构更有信号。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用状态和状态之间的合法转换描述业务流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine models a workflow as states and allowed transitions.

tradeoff: 状态正确性信号 vs 宏观架构时间

scenario: 你画完高层架构后马上开始深挖缓存一致性，但面试官其实想看写路径扩展。
scenario_en: After drawing the high-level architecture, you immediately dive into cache consistency, but the interviewer wanted write-path scaling.
q: 深挖前应该做什么？
q_en: What should you do before deep diving?
options: 先和面试官确认高层设计和深挖方向
假装没听到反馈
继续讲自己熟悉的缓存
删除白板
options_en: Confirm the high-level design and deep-dive direction with the interviewer
Ignore feedback
Keep talking about your favorite cache topic
Erase the whiteboard
why: buy-in 能避免你在低信号方向消耗时间。面试官的反馈本身就是范围和评分重点的提示。
why_en: Getting buy-in prevents you from spending the deep dive on the wrong signal area.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双方对当前方案、范围或下一步讨论方向达成一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Buy-in means both sides agree on the current approach, scope, or next discussion direction.

scenario: 你设计通知系统，估算后发现峰值发送 200K/s，而第三方推送 API 只能稳定处理 20K/s。
scenario_en: You design a notification system and estimate 200K sends per second at peak, while the third-party push API handles only 20K/s.
q: 这个估算应如何改变设计？
q_en: How should this estimate change the design?
options: 加入队列、worker 池、限速和重试
忽略第三方限制
让客户端自己发推送
把所有通知同步发完再响应
options_en: Add queues, worker pools, throttling, and retries
Ignore the third-party limit
Let clients send pushes themselves
Send everything synchronously before responding
why: 容量估算发现下游比入口慢一个数量级，设计就要吸收峰值并按下游速率释放。队列和 worker 池把突发和处理速度解耦。
why_en: When estimates show the downstream is much slower than the peak, queues and workers decouple bursts from processing rate.
whenOtherWins: 如果峰值远低于第三方容量，同步调用可以先保留，直到延迟或可靠性变成问题。
tradeoff: 入口峰值吸收 vs 下游稳定处理速率

scenario: 设计短链服务时，面试官追问“如果同一个短码被两个长 URL 生成怎么办？”
scenario_en: While designing a URL shortener, the interviewer asks what happens if two long URLs generate the same short code.
q: 深挖重点应该转向哪里？
q_en: Where should the deep dive move?
options: 短码生成、冲突检测和唯一性保证
按钮颜色
CDN 图片压缩
公司组织架构
options_en: Short-code generation, collision detection, and uniqueness guarantees
Button colors
CDN image compression
Company org structure
why: 面试官的追问通常指向高信号风险。短链的不变量是短码唯一映射，深挖冲突处理比泛泛讲组件更有价值。
why_en: The interviewer’s question points to the key invariant, so deep dive into collision handling and uniqueness.
whenOtherWins: 如果追问集中在读延迟，再转向缓存、地域和热点 key 更合适。

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个不同输入生成了同一个标识或哈希结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A collision happens when two different inputs produce the same identifier or hash.

tradeoff: 追问暴露的核心不变量 vs 泛泛讲完整组件图

scenario: 收尾时，面试官问“这个设计下一步会在哪里先坏？”系统包括 API、缓存、数据库、队列和 worker。
scenario_en: At wrap-up, the interviewer asks where this design will break next; it includes APIs, cache, database, queue, and workers.
q: 哪些是有信号的瓶颈讨论？
q_en: Which bottleneck discussions are useful?
options: 数据库写主库是否会成为上限
队列积压时 worker 如何扩容
缓存热点 key 如何隔离
只说不会有问题
options_en: Whether primary database writes become the limit
How workers scale when the queue backs up
How cache hot keys are isolated
Just say nothing will go wrong
why: 好的瓶颈讨论要落到具体组件和可观测信号。说不会有问题，等于放弃展示系统演进能力。
why_en: Good bottleneck discussion names concrete components and signals instead of claiming the design is perfect.

q: 收尾时讲取舍的自然顺序是什么？
q_en: What is a natural order for discussing tradeoffs in the wrap-up?
steps: 点名当前设计的主要代价，比如一致性、成本或运维复杂度。
先复述本轮需求和核心方案。
说明如果规模扩大 10 倍，优先改哪一层。
补充故障、监控和发布风险。
why: 收尾不是再画一遍图，而是把方案、代价、风险和演进路线讲完整。这样面试官能看到你知道设计上线后怎么活下去。
why_en: A strong wrap-up restates the design, names its tradeoffs, covers operational risks, and explains the next scale step.

scenario: 一个公开 API 被机器人和误用客户端打爆，下游数据库和付费第三方 API 都会被拖垮。
scenario_en: A public API is overloaded by bots and buggy clients, and both the database and paid third-party APIs are at risk.
q: 限流器主要保护什么？
q_en: What does a rate limiter mainly protect?
options: 资源、公平性和成本
数据库 schema 命名
前端颜色一致性
DNS 记录数量
options_en: Resources, fairness, and cost
Database schema naming
Frontend color consistency
The number of DNS records
why: 限流先挡住超过配额的请求，避免单个客户端耗尽共享资源或烧掉按次计费的调用。代价是要处理误伤和重试体验。
why_en: A rate limiter protects shared resources and per-call costs by rejecting traffic beyond a defined quota.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按用户、IP、设备或全局规则限制请求速率的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rate limiter caps request rates by user, IP, device, or global rule.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个窗口内允许使用的请求额度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quota is the allowed request budget within a time window.

scenario: API 客户端有移动端、Web 和第三方脚本，其中一些客户端不可信或不受你控制。
scenario_en: API clients include mobile, web, and third-party scripts, and some are untrusted or outside your control.
q: 限流应该在哪里强制执行？
q_en: Where should enforcement happen?
options: 服务端中间件或 API Gateway
只放在客户端 SDK
只写在产品文档里
只靠用户自觉
options_en: Server-side middleware or an API Gateway
Only in the client SDK
Only in product documentation
Only by asking users to behave
why: 不可信客户端可以伪造或绕过本地限制，所以强制执行要在你控制的服务端路径上。客户端可以做自我节流，但不能当唯一防线。
why_en: Enforcement must live on a server-controlled path because untrusted clients can bypass local limits.
whenOtherWins: 如果是单机内部批处理工具，客户端自我限速可以作为轻量保护，但公开 API 不能只靠它。

termDefinitions.meaning: 位于 API 前面的托管或自建入口层，常做认证、限流、TLS 终止和路由。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API Gateway sits in front of APIs and often handles auth, rate limiting, TLS termination, and routing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给客户端开发者使用的一组库、工具和示例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SDK is a set of libraries and tools used by client developers.

tradeoff: 可信服务端强制执行 vs 客户端自我节流体验

scenario: 公司已经有 API Gateway 做认证和 IP 白名单，限流规则比较常规，团队人手紧。
scenario_en: The company already uses an API Gateway for auth and IP allowlists, the rate rules are standard, and engineering time is limited.
q: 限流优先放哪里？
q_en: Where should rate limiting go first?
options: 复用 API Gateway 的限流能力
每个业务服务各写一套
只靠数据库触发器
把限流放到用户浏览器
options_en: Reuse the API Gateway's rate-limiting capability
Build a separate limiter in every service
Use only database triggers
Move rate limiting into the browser
why: 已有网关能少写一套入口能力，发布和运维也集中。代价是算法和规则表达可能受网关产品限制。
why_en: Reusing an existing gateway centralizes enforcement and saves engineering effort, at the cost of less algorithm control.
tradeoff: 落地速度和集中治理 vs 算法控制
whenOtherWins: 如果业务需要非常定制的多维规则，应用侧或独立限流服务会更灵活。

scenario: 支付 API 平均只允许每秒 100 次，但希望短时间促销峰值能吃掉少量突发流量。
scenario_en: A payment API averages 100 requests per second but should tolerate small short bursts during promotions.
q: 哪种算法最适合突发友好限流？
q_en: Which algorithm best supports short bursts?
options: Token bucket
Fixed window counter
Sliding window log
只用数据库行锁
options_en: Token bucket
Fixed window counter
Sliding window log
Only database row locks
why: Token bucket 用 refill rate 控制长期平均速率，用 bucket size 留出短时突发额度。代价是两个参数要调好，桶太大就会放过过多突发。
why_en: Token bucket controls the long-term rate with refills while bucket size allows short bursts.
tradeoff: 短时突发容忍 vs 参数调优
whenOtherWins: 如果你要稳定匀速处理请求，leaking bucket 会比 token bucket 更贴近目标。

termDefinitions.meaning: 按固定速率补 token，请求拿到 token 才放行的限流算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Token bucket refills tokens at a fixed rate and allows a request only if it can spend a token.

scenario: 一个下游老系统每秒最多稳定处理 50 个请求，突发会让它排队超时。你宁愿入口排队或丢弃。
scenario_en: A legacy downstream can steadily process at most 50 requests per second, and bursts cause timeouts; queuing or dropping at the edge is acceptable.
q: 哪种算法更贴合稳定出流？
q_en: Which algorithm fits a stable outflow requirement?
options: Leaking bucket
Token bucket
固定窗口只在整点重置
不做限流
options_en: Leaking bucket
Token bucket
Fixed window reset only at round boundaries
No rate limiting
why: Leaking bucket 用有限 FIFO 队列接请求，再按固定 outflow rate 处理，能把入口突发削平。代价是老请求塞满队列时，新请求可能被丢。
why_en: Leaking bucket smooths bursts through a bounded FIFO queue and a fixed outflow rate.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务希望允许短时间爆发，只要长期平均不超限，token bucket 更合适。

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出队列，先进入的请求先处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO means First In First Out, where earlier requests are processed first.

termDefinitions.meaning: 队列向下游释放请求的固定速率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Outflow rate is the fixed rate at which queued requests are released downstream.

tradeoff: 稳定出流 vs 突发体验

scenario: 规则是每分钟最多 5 次。客户端在 12:00:59 发 5 次，又在 12:01:00 立刻发 5 次。
scenario_en: The rule allows 5 requests per minute; a client sends 5 at 12:00:59 and 5 more at 12:01:00.
q: 固定窗口计数器会出什么问题？
q_en: What goes wrong with a fixed window counter?
options: 窗口边界附近可能放过双倍流量
每个请求都必须存完整时间戳
完全不能重置计数器
一定比滑动日志更耗内存
options_en: It can allow double traffic around window boundaries
It must store every request timestamp
It cannot reset counters
It always uses more memory than sliding logs
why: 固定窗口按整点重置，边界两侧的请求分别落进两个窗口，但任意滚动 60 秒内可能已经超限。它简单省内存，但准确性差。
why_en: Fixed windows are cheap but can over-admit traffic around reset boundaries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把时间切成固定窗口，每个窗口只维护一个计数器的限流算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fixed window counter keeps one counter per fixed time bucket.

scenario: 合规 API 要求任意滚动 60 秒内绝不能超过 100 次，用户数不大，内存不是主要瓶颈。
scenario_en: A compliance API must never exceed 100 requests in any rolling 60 seconds; user count is small and memory is not the main bottleneck.
q: 哪种算法更准确？
q_en: Which algorithm is most accurate?
options: Sliding window log
Fixed window counter
只用客户端 sleep
随机丢弃
options_en: Sliding window log
Fixed window counter
Only client-side sleep
Random dropping
why: Sliding window log 记录请求时间戳，每次删除窗口外记录后再判断数量，能严格按滚动窗口限流。代价是每个请求可能都留下时间戳，内存更高。
why_en: Sliding window log is accurate because it counts actual timestamps inside the rolling window, at higher memory cost.
whenOtherWins: 如果是海量用户、允许极小误差，sliding window counter 会用更少内存。

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存请求时间戳，并按当前滚动窗口内的时间戳数量限流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sliding window log stores request timestamps and counts those inside the rolling window.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以当前时刻往前看的连续时间范围，不按整点固定切分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling window is a continuous lookback interval ending at the current time.

tradeoff: 限流准确性 vs 内存和写入成本

scenario: 限流规则要比固定窗口平滑，但业务能接受很小误差，系统要服务海量 key。
scenario_en: The limiter should be smoother than fixed windows, but tiny error is acceptable and the system must serve many keys.
q: 哪种算法更省内存？
q_en: Which algorithm is more memory efficient?
options: Sliding window counter
Sliding window log
为每个请求建一行数据库
不设置过期时间
options_en: Sliding window counter
Sliding window log
Create a database row per request
Never set expiration
why: Sliding window counter 用当前窗口计数加上一段上一窗口权重来近似滚动窗口，不保存每次请求。它省内存，但假设上一窗口流量均匀，所以不是严格精确。
why_en: Sliding window counter approximates a rolling window with weighted counters, saving memory at the cost of small error.
whenOtherWins: 如果强合规要求不能误放，sliding window log 会更安全。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用当前窗口计数和上一窗口加权计数近似滚动窗口的算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sliding window counter approximates a rolling window using the current count plus a weighted previous count.

tradeoff: 内存效率和近似平滑 vs 严格滚动窗口准确性

scenario: 限流中间件需要记录 user:123 在 60 秒窗口内的请求数。读写路径必须很快，并且旧窗口要自动清理。
scenario_en: Rate-limiting middleware needs to track requests for user:123 within a 60-second window; reads/writes must be fast and old windows should expire automatically.
q: Redis 计数器最小命令形态是什么？
q_en: What is the minimal Redis counter shape?
options: INCR 后给新 key 设置 EXPIRE
每次写入磁盘数据库并全表统计
把计数存在客户端 cookie
只在日志里 grep 次数
options_en: INCR and set EXPIRE for a new key
Write to a disk database and scan the table
Store the count in a client cookie
Grep logs for counts
why: Redis 在内存里做 INCR 很快，EXPIRE 让窗口结束后自动删 key。生产里要把 INCR 和首次 EXPIRE 做成原子逻辑，否则可能漏过期。
why_en: Redis INCR is fast and EXPIRE cleans up old windows, but production code must make the first increment and TTL atomic.
whenOtherWins: 如果规则需要严格滚动窗口，每个请求时间戳用 sorted set 会比单计数器更准确。
codeSample:
# 60s fixed-window counter
INCR rl:user:123:20260706T1200
EXPIRE rl:user:123:20260706T1200 60
TTL rl:user:123:20260706T1200

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用内存数据存储，支持计数、过期和脚本等能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory data store that supports counters, expiration, and scripting.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，把整数值原子加 1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: INCR is a Redis command that atomically increments an integer value.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，给 key 设置秒级过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EXPIRE is a Redis command that sets a key's time-to-live in seconds.

tradeoff: 内存计数低延迟 vs 原子过期和窗口正确性

scenario: 客户端超过配额后，服务端需要告诉它失败原因和多久后可以重试。
scenario_en: After a client exceeds its quota, the server needs to explain the failure and when retry is allowed.
q: HTTP 响应应该包含什么？
q_en: What should the HTTP response include?
options: 429 和 Retry-After 类限流头
200 但空 body
500 内部错误
301 永久重定向
options_en: 429 plus Retry-After style rate-limit headers
200 with an empty body
500 internal error
301 permanent redirect
why: 429 明确表示请求太多，Retry-After 告诉客户端等待多久再试。这样客户端能做退避，而不是把失败当服务故障猛重试。
why_en: HTTP 429 plus retry headers tells clients they are throttled and should back off instead of retrying aggressively.
codeSample:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Retry-After: 42

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 状态码，表示客户端在给定时间内发送了太多请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests means the client has exceeded a request limit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 告诉客户端等待多少秒或等到什么时间再重试的响应头。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Retry-After tells the client how long to wait before retrying.

scenario: 平台要支持“营销短信每天 5 条”和“登录每分钟 5 次”这类不同维度、不同窗口的规则。
scenario_en: The platform needs rules such as marketing messages 5 per day and login attempts 5 per minute, with different dimensions and windows.
q: 规则应如何管理？
q_en: How should rules be managed?
options: 配置化保存，由 worker 拉取到缓存
硬编码进每个客户端
只写在 README
每次请求人工审批
options_en: Store as configuration and let workers load it into cache
Hard-code into every client
Only document it in a README
Manually approve every request
why: 配置化规则能独立发布和回滚，缓存后请求路径读取也快。代价是要处理配置版本、刷新延迟和错误规则回滚。
why_en: Config-backed rules are easier to update and can be cached for fast request-time decisions.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一个内部脚本和一条固定规则，硬编码可以先当临时实现。

termDefinitions.meaning: 规则中用于匹配限流对象的键值描述，比如 auth_type=login。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A descriptor is a key-value description used to match a rate-limit rule, such as auth_type=login.

tradeoff: 动态规则调整 vs 配置发布和审计复杂度

scenario: 两个限流线程同时读取 Redis 计数 3，都判断 4 未超限，然后各自写回 4。
scenario_en: Two limiter threads read Redis count 3 at the same time, both decide 4 is allowed, and both write back 4.
q: 这个并发 bug 是什么？
q_en: What concurrency bug is this?
options: read-check-write 竞态少计数
CDN 缓存过期时间太长
DNS 域名解析全部失败
客户端本地缓存命中
options_en: A read-check-write race undercounts requests
The CDN cache expiration is too long
All DNS name resolution has failed
The client local cache hit
why: 读取、判断、写回不是一个原子动作，并发请求会覆盖彼此的更新。常见修法是 Lua 脚本或 Redis 原子数据结构，而不是给热路径加大锁。
why_en: The separate read-check-write steps race, so concurrent requests can overwrite each other's counter updates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结果依赖并发操作先后顺序的 bug。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition is a bug where the result depends on timing between concurrent operations.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 可执行的服务器端脚本，可把多步逻辑作为一个原子操作运行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Lua script in Redis can run multi-step logic atomically on the server.

scenario: 负载均衡把同一用户的请求打到多个限流节点。每个节点只保存本地计数时，用户可以绕过全局配额。
scenario_en: A load balancer sends the same user's requests to multiple limiter nodes; each node keeps only local counters, so the user can bypass the global quota.
q: 分布式限流计数放哪里？
q_en: Where should distributed limiter counters live?
options: 共享的集中式数据存储，如 Redis
每个限流节点本地内存
浏览器 localStorage
随机一个 API 服务器
options_en: A shared centralized store such as Redis
Local memory on each limiter node
Browser localStorage
A random API server
why: 共享存储让所有限流节点看到同一份计数，配额才是全局的。sticky session 能缓解但不够灵活，扩容和故障切换会麻烦。
why_en: A shared store gives all limiter nodes the same counter state, making quotas global instead of per-node.
whenOtherWins: 如果是单节点服务，本地内存计数最简单；一旦有多节点，就要共享状态或接受误差。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一客户端固定路由到同一后端，减少状态同步需求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sticky sessions route the same client to the same backend to reduce state-sharing needs.

tradeoff: 全局配额一致性 vs 本地内存低延迟

scenario: 限流 Redis 短暂不可用。业务要求限流故障不能让整个核心 API 全部不可用，但也不能无限放量太久。
scenario_en: The rate-limit Redis is briefly unavailable; the core API must not go fully down, but unlimited traffic cannot continue for long.
q: 故障策略怎么选？
q_en: Which failure policy fits?
options: 短时 fail-open 加降级保护和告警
永久放开所有限制
所有请求都返回 500
删除限流规则
options_en: Short fail-open with degradation guards and alerts
Disable all limits forever
Return 500 for every request
Delete rate-limit rules
why: 高容错要求限流器坏了不要立刻拖死主业务，所以可以短时放行并收紧下游保护。代价是攻击流量可能穿透，必须告警、限时和降级。
why_en: Short fail-open keeps the core API alive during limiter failure, but it needs alerts and fallback guards to avoid unlimited abuse.
whenOtherWins: 如果 API 是高风险扣款或安全动作，fail-closed 可能更安全，即宁可拒绝也不放过滥用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护组件故障时默认放行请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fail-open means requests are allowed when the protection component fails.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保护组件故障时默认拒绝请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fail-closed means requests are rejected when the protection component fails.

tradeoff: fail-open 可用性 vs fail-closed 保护强度

scenario: 限流服务只部署在美国东部，亚洲用户每个 API 请求都要跨洲检查配额，延迟明显上涨。
scenario_en: The limiter runs only in us-east, so Asian users must cross continents for every quota check and latency increases.
q: 性能优化优先做什么？
q_en: What performance optimization should come first?
options: 把限流能力部署到更靠近用户的边缘或多区域
把所有请求改成同步跨洲写
增加响应 JSON 缩进
关闭健康检查
options_en: Deploy limiting closer to users at edge or multi-region locations
Make every request a synchronous cross-continent write
Add indentation to response JSON
Disable health checks
why: 限流在每个请求热路径上，跨洲 RTT 会直接加到用户延迟里。多区域或边缘部署能降延迟，但计数同步通常要接受最终一致或分桶配额。
why_en: Because rate limiting is on the hot path, edge or multi-region deployment reduces user-visible round-trip latency.
whenOtherWins: 如果限流决策必须全局强一致，可能要牺牲延迟，把敏感操作集中到一个强一致区域。

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求从客户端到服务端再返回的往返时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RTT is the time for a request to travel to the server and back.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同副本短期可不一致，但没有新写入时最终会收敛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency allows temporary replica differences that converge when writes stop.

tradeoff: 本地快速判断 vs 全局精确计数

scenario: 限流上线后，团队要判断规则是否误伤正常用户，并指导 API 客户端减少被限流。
scenario_en: After launch, the team needs to detect whether rules hurt valid users and guide API clients to avoid throttling.
q: 应该关注哪些动作？
q_en: What actions should you focus on?
options: 监控通过率、429 比例和热点规则
客户端缓存可重复读取的数据
客户端按 Retry-After 做退避
忽略所有被拒请求
options_en: Monitor allow rate, 429 rate, and hot rules
Cache repeatable reads on the client
Back off according to Retry-After
Ignore all rejected requests
why: 监控告诉你规则太松还是太严，客户端缓存和退避能减少无效重试。被拒请求不能直接忽略，因为它们可能是误伤、攻击或容量不足信号。
why_en: Monitor 429s and hot rules, and have clients cache and back off so throttling does not turn into retry storms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 失败后等待一段时间再重试，常随失败次数增加等待时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backoff waits before retrying, often increasing the delay after repeated failures.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大量客户端失败后同时重试，反而进一步压垮服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A retry storm happens when many clients retry after failures and overload the service further.

scenario: 你要设计服务端 API 限流器，所有请求都会经过它。
scenario_en: You are designing a server-side API rate limiter and every request passes through it.
q: 哪些需求会直接影响架构？
q_en: Which requirements directly shape the architecture?
options: 低延迟，不能明显拖慢 HTTP 响应
分布式，多服务实例共享规则和计数
故障时不能拖垮主业务
必须保存用户头像
options_en: Low latency so HTTP responses are not slowed much
Distributed state shared by many service instances
Failure should not take down the core business
It must store user avatars
why: 限流在热路径上，所以延迟、共享状态和故障策略是核心需求。头像存储不是限流器职责。
why_en: A rate limiter sits on the hot path, so latency, shared state, and failure behavior shape the design.

scenario: 同一用户对发帖、点赞、加好友有不同限制：1/s、5/s、150/day。
scenario_en: The same user has different limits for posting, liking, and adding friends: 1/s, 5/s, and 150/day.
q: Token bucket 需要怎么建？
q_en: How should token buckets be created?
options: 按用户加 API 维度建多个 bucket
所有动作共用一个全局 bucket
每个请求新建永久 bucket
只按服务器 CPU 建 bucket
options_en: Create separate buckets by user and API dimension
Use one global bucket for all actions
Create a permanent bucket per request
Bucket only by server CPU
why: 不同动作的配额和窗口不同，应该拆成不同 key，否则点赞可能吃掉发帖额度。bucket 数量会影响内存，所以 key 维度要和业务规则对齐。
why_en: Different actions need separate bucket keys because their quotas and windows differ.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标只是保护整个集群每秒最多 10K 请求，全局 bucket 就够表达规则。
tradeoff: 规则表达准确性 vs bucket 数量和内存成本

scenario: 规则是平均每秒 10 次，允许用户短时间最多连发 30 次，然后回到平均速率。
scenario_en: The rule allows an average of 10 requests per second and a short burst of up to 30 requests.
q: Token bucket 参数怎么设？
q_en: How should token bucket parameters be set?
options: refill rate=10/s，bucket size=30
refill rate=30/s，bucket size=10
refill rate=0，bucket size=无限
只设置 HTTP 端口
options_en: refill rate = 10/s and bucket size = 30
refill rate = 30/s and bucket size = 10
refill rate = 0 and bucket size = infinite
Only set the HTTP port
why: refill rate 决定长期平均速率，单位是 tokens/s；bucket size 决定可积攒的突发额度。这个参数会直接影响用户峰值体验和下游保护强度。
why_en: Refill rate sets the long-term average and bucket size sets the maximum burst.

termDefinitions.meaning: token bucket 每秒或每窗口补充 token 的速率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Refill rate is how quickly tokens are added back to a token bucket.

q: Token bucket 处理一个请求的顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the request flow for token bucket?
steps: 如果 token 不足，拒绝或排队这个请求。
根据距离上次检查的时间补充 token，但不超过 bucket size。
如果 token 足够，扣 1 个 token。
读取该用户和 API 对应的 bucket 状态。
why: 完整链路是读状态、按时间补 token、尝试扣 token、再决定放行或拒绝。漏掉补 token 或容量上限，都会让速率不准。
why_en: The flow reads bucket state, refills by elapsed time, spends a token if available, and then allows or rejects.
diagram:
flowchart LR
A[Read bucket] --> B[Refill tokens]
B --> C{Token available?}
C -- yes --> D[Spend and allow]
C -- no --> E[Reject or queue]

scenario: Leaking bucket 队列容量是 100，下游每秒处理 10 个。一次突发来了 500 个请求。
scenario_en: A leaking bucket queue has capacity 100 and drains 10 requests per second; a burst of 500 requests arrives.
q: 最近的请求可能发生什么？
q_en: What may happen to recent requests?
options: 队列被旧请求占满，后来的请求被拒绝
所有 500 个都会立即处理
下游速率自动变成 500/s
队列容量变成无限
options_en: Old requests fill the queue and later ones are rejected
All 500 are processed immediately
Downstream rate automatically becomes 500/s
Queue capacity becomes infinite
why: Leaking bucket 平滑出流，但有限队列会让突发中的后续请求被丢。它保护下游，牺牲的是突发期的新请求体验。
why_en: Leaking bucket protects downstream with a bounded queue, but later burst requests can be dropped.

scenario: 一个免费套餐每天 1000 次 API 调用，产品希望每天午夜重置额度，边界附近短时多用一点可以接受。
scenario_en: A free tier allows 1000 API calls per day, quota resets at midnight, and slight boundary overuse is acceptable.
q: 哪种算法足够简单？
q_en: Which algorithm is simple enough?
options: Fixed window counter
Sliding window log
逐请求人工审核
跨洲强同步事务
options_en: Fixed window counter
Sliding window log
Manual review per request
Cross-continent synchronous transactions
why: 固定窗口和“每天重置”这种产品语义一致，实现也省内存。代价是窗口边界不严格，所以不适合安全敏感的滚动限制。
why_en: Fixed windows fit human-friendly reset periods when small boundary bursts are acceptable.
whenOtherWins: 如果规则是任意 24 小时都不能超过 1000 次，滑动窗口会更合适。
tradeoff: 实现简单 vs 窗口边界误差

scenario: 限流器用 Redis 固定窗口。你需要把“加计数、首次设置过期、判断是否超限”作为一个原子决策。
scenario_en: A fixed-window limiter uses Redis, and incrementing, setting first TTL, and checking the limit must be one atomic decision.
q: 为什么常用 Lua 脚本？
q_en: Why is a Lua script commonly used?
options: 把多步 Redis 操作放到服务端一次执行
让客户端睡眠更久
替代所有监控
把 HTTP 变成 UDP
options_en: Run multiple Redis operations once on the server
Make clients sleep longer
Replace all monitoring
Turn HTTP into UDP
why: Lua 脚本能避免多个客户端在 INCR、EXPIRE、判断之间插队。代价是脚本要短小可控，避免阻塞 Redis。
why_en: Lua keeps the increment, TTL setup, and limit check atomic on the Redis server.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要简单原子加一，单个 INCR 命令已经足够。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一组操作要么作为整体完成，中间不会被其他操作插入观察到半成品。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Atomic means a set of operations completes as one indivisible unit.

tradeoff: 多步原子正确性 vs Redis 脚本阻塞风险
optionMeanings: Lua 在 Redis 服务端一次跑完多条命令。
睡眠只降低客户端频率，不保证计数正确。
监控只能发现问题，不能替代原子更新。
传输协议变化不解决 Redis 并发。
optionDirectness: 多命令必须一起成功时适合。
客户端自控可信时才有辅助价值。
上线后观测需要它，但不是修复手段。
不适合解决限流计数竞态。
optionScenarioImpacts: 把判断逻辑留在 Redis 侧完成，客户端只拿结果。
仍可能被恶意客户端绕过。
竞态照样发生，只是更容易看见。
会引入无关协议改造。
optionMeanings_en: Run multiple Redis operations once on the server.
Make clients sleep longer.
Replace all monitoring.
Turn HTTP into UDP.
optionDirectness_en: This matches the scenario constraint.
Only fits when this statement is true: make clients sleep longer.
It does not fit this scenario constraint.
This matches the scenario constraint.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It commits the design to this path: Run multiple Redis operations once on the server.
It commits the design to this assumption: Make clients sleep longer.
It commits the design to this assumption: Replace all monitoring.
It commits the design to this assumption: Turn HTTP into UDP.

scenario: 代码先 INCR 新 key，进程在执行 EXPIRE 前崩溃。这个 key 之后一直没有 TTL。
scenario_en: Code runs INCR on a new key and crashes before EXPIRE; the key then has no TTL.
