It commits the design to this assumption: Flush on every read.
It commits the design to this assumption: Never flush; query the commit log.
It commits the design to this assumption: Flush only when deleting the database.

scenario: LSM 存储不断 flush 新 SSTable。删除会写 tombstone，旧值和删除标记可能分散在多个文件里。
scenario_en: An LSM store keeps flushing new SSTables. Deletes write tombstones, and old values plus delete markers may sit in many files.
q: compaction 主要解决什么？
q_en: What does compaction mainly solve?
options: 合并文件并清旧版本
把 commit log 压缩成图片
把副本同步到同一机房
让 Bloom filter 不再误判
options_en: Merge files and clear old versions
Compress commit logs into images
Sync replicas into one data center
Make Bloom filters never false-positive
why: SSTable 越多，读一个 key 要查的候选越多。compaction 用后台 I/O 换更少文件、更少旧版本和更稳的读延迟。
why_en: More SSTables increase read fanout, so compaction spends background I/O to reduce files, obsolete versions, and read latency.
tradeoff: 后台 I/O/写放大 vs 读放大
whenOtherWins: 写入极少、SSTable 数量很小的时候，可以降低 compaction 频率。

termDefinitions.meaning: 写优化存储结构，把写入批量落成不可变有序文件，再后台合并。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An LSM tree is a write-optimized structure that flushes writes into immutable sorted files and compacts them later.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删除操作写下的删除标记，用来在合并前压住旧值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tombstone is a delete marker that suppresses older values until compaction removes them.

optionMeanings: 后台整理多个 SSTable。
日志压缩不是 compaction 的目标。
副本修复属于 anti-entropy。
Bloom filter 误判只能调低，不能消灭。
optionDirectness: SSTable 多、读放大明显时适合。
日志归档另有机制。
跨副本一致性要用修复流程。
误判率靠参数调节。
optionScenarioImpacts: 读候选文件变少，旧值被清掉。
不会减少读路径文件数量。
不会清本机旧版本。
会高估 Bloom filter 能力。
optionMeanings_en: Merge files and clear old versions.
Compress commit logs into images.
Sync replicas into one data center.
Make Bloom filters never false-positive.
optionDirectness_en: This matches the scenario constraint.
Only fits when this statement is true: compress commit logs into images.
Only fits when this statement is true: sync replicas into one data center.
Only fits when this statement is true: make Bloom filters never false-positive.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It commits the design to this path: Merge files and clear old versions.
It commits the design to this assumption: Compress commit logs into images.
It commits the design to this assumption: Sync replicas into one data center.
It commits the design to this assumption: Make Bloom filters never false-positive.

scenario: Bloom filter 判断某个 SSTable 可能包含 key，但实际查文件后没有找到。
scenario_en: A Bloom filter says an SSTable may contain a key, but the file lookup does not find it.
q: Bloom filter 误判会造成什么？
q_en: What does a Bloom-filter false positive cause?
options: 多做一次无用磁盘查找，但不会漏掉真实 key
返回错误 value 给客户端
永久删除这个 key
破坏 quorum 公式
options_en: An extra useless disk lookup, but no missed real key
A wrong value is returned to the client
The key is permanently deleted
The quorum formula is broken
why: Bloom filter 可以误报“可能在”，不能误报“肯定不在”。所以它影响性能，不应该影响正确性。
why_en: Bloom filters can false-positive but not false-negative, so they may waste I/O without hiding an existing key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结构说“可能存在”，但真实数据里不存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive means the structure says an item may exist when it actually does not.

tradeoff: 少量无用 I/O vs 不漏真实 key
whenOtherWins: 如果磁盘 I/O 已经很便宜、内存很紧，可以把 Bloom filter 做小一点，接受更多误判。

scenario: 一次读从多个 SSTable 找到同一个 key 的多个版本，另有一个 tombstone。系统需要返回对客户端正确的状态。
scenario_en: A read finds multiple versions of the same key across SSTables, plus a tombstone. The system must return the correct state.
q: 读路径如何选择结果？
q_en: How should the read path choose the result?
options: 按版本或时间戳合并，tombstone 可覆盖旧值
随机返回第一个文件里的值
永远忽略 tombstone
把所有版本直接拼成字符串
options_en: Merge by version or timestamp, letting tombstones suppress older values
Randomly return the first file value
Always ignore tombstones
Concatenate all versions into a string
why: LSM 读路径要理解同一 key 的多版本。最新写或删除标记决定可见结果，旧值等 compaction 清掉。
why_en: An LSM read must reconcile multiple versions of a key; the latest write or delete marker determines the visible result.
tradeoff: 写入顺序化 vs 读时合并复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果存储引擎原地更新，读时多版本合并压力会小一些。

termDefinitions.meaning: 写优化存储结构，把写入批量落成不可变有序文件，再后台合并。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An LSM tree is a write-optimized structure that flushes writes into immutable sorted files and compacts them later.

scenario: 社交资料 KV 在网络分区时仍要允许用户更新简介。短时间看到旧简介可以接受，稍后同步即可。
scenario_en: A social-profile KV store should let users update bios during network partitions. Seeing an old bio briefly is acceptable if it syncs later.
q: 这个业务更像 AP 还是 CP？
q_en: Is this business closer to AP or CP?
options: AP，继续服务并接受短暂旧值
CP，所有分区期间写入都报错
CA，完全不考虑分区
单机内存表，无需复制
options_en: AP, continue serving and accept temporary staleness
CP, reject all writes during partitions
CA, ignore partitions entirely
Single-node memory table with no replication
why: 简介不是强金融不变量，用户体验更怕不可用。AP 让写入先成功，之后靠同步和冲突策略收敛。
why_en: A profile bio is not a hard financial invariant, so AP behavior favors user availability and repairs later.
tradeoff: 用户可用性 vs 立即一致
whenOtherWins: 如果字段代表法定身份或余额，CP 会更稳。

scenario: KV 的 key 可能是很长的 JSON 查询条件，也可能是短的哈希摘要。系统每次 get/put 都要传输和比较 key。
scenario_en: KV keys may be long JSON query strings or short hash digests. Every get/put transmits and compares the key.
q: 为什么短 key 通常更好？
q_en: Why are shorter keys usually better?
options: 减少网络、内存和索引比较开销
让 value 自动变小
保证不会有冲突
让 CAP 选择消失
options_en: They reduce network, memory, and index-comparison overhead
They automatically shrink values
They guarantee no collisions
They remove CAP tradeoffs
why: key 会出现在请求、索引、缓存和日志里。短 key 不改变语义，但能降低每次操作的固定成本。
why_en: Keys appear in requests, indexes, caches, and logs, so shorter keys reduce per-operation overhead without changing semantics.
tradeoff: 可读性 vs 操作开销
whenOtherWins: 排障或人工操作很重要时，可读 key 也有价值，可以用前缀加短 ID 折中。

termDefinitions.meaning: Consistency、Availability、Partition Tolerance 三者在网络分区时不能同时满分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CAP says consistency, availability, and partition tolerance cannot all be fully satisfied during a network partition.

scenario: KV 设计假设单个 key-value 小于 10KB。现在产品想把 50MB 文件直接作为 value 写入。
scenario_en: The KV design assumes each key-value pair is under 10KB. Product now wants to write 50MB files directly as values.
q: 大 value 会改变什么设计？
q_en: How do large values change the design?
options: 应考虑对象存储保存大文件，KV 只存引用
直接塞进 memtable，没有任何影响
把 W 和 R 都设为 0
关闭副本避免网络传输
options_en: Use object storage for large files and keep only references in KV
Put them into the memtable with no impact
Set both W and R to 0
Disable replication to avoid network transfer
why: 大 value 会放大复制、日志、compaction 和读写延迟。KV 更适合存小对象或元数据，大文件交给对象存储。
why_en: Large values amplify replication, logging, compaction, and latency, so KV should store metadata or references while object storage holds files.
tradeoff: 简单 get/put vs 大对象传输成本
whenOtherWins: 如果系统专门是 blob store，就应围绕分块、校验和对象存储路径设计。

termDefinitions.meaning: 面向大对象或文件的存储服务，通常用对象 key 读写整块数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Object storage stores large blobs or files addressed by object keys.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后台合并 SSTable、清理旧版本或删除标记的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compaction is the background process of merging SSTables and removing obsolete versions or tombstones.

scenario: KV 集群没有固定 master。每个节点都能接请求、维护成员信息、转发到副本并保存部分数据。
scenario_en: A KV cluster has no fixed master. Every node can accept requests, maintain membership, forward to replicas, and store part of the data.
q: 去中心化架构的好处是什么？
q_en: What is the benefit of this decentralized architecture?
options: 减少单点故障，并让节点增删更自动
让所有请求必须经过一个 leader
取消副本和故障检测
让一致性永远最强
options_en: Reduce single points of failure and make membership changes more automatic
Force all requests through one leader
Remove replication and failure detection
Make consistency always strongest
why: 节点职责对称时，某个协调节点挂了不等于集群停摆。代价是成员状态、冲突和修复逻辑更复杂。
why_en: Symmetric node roles avoid one coordinator becoming a cluster-wide stop point, at the cost of more membership and repair complexity.
tradeoff: 无单点 vs 协议复杂度
whenOtherWins: 强事务数据库可能选择 leader 或共识组来换更清晰的一致性语义。

q: Cassandra 风格 KV 写路径的正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct order of a Cassandra-style KV write path?
steps: 追加 commit log 保证崩溃可恢复
写入 memtable 作为内存有序缓冲
达到阈值后 flush 成不可变 SSTable
后台 compaction 合并 SSTable 并清理旧版本
why: 这条链把持久性、低延迟写入、磁盘落盘和后台整理分开。漏掉任何一步，都讲不清 LSM 的取舍。
why_en: The chain separates durability, fast in-memory writes, disk flushing, and background cleanup, which is the LSM tradeoff.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种去中心化宽列数据库，常用 LSM 风格存储路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a decentralized wide-column database that commonly uses an LSM-style storage path.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写优化存储结构，把写入批量落成不可变有序文件，再后台合并。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An LSM tree is a write-optimized structure that flushes writes into immutable sorted files and compacts them later.

scenario: KV 使用 Cassandra 风格的 LSM 写路径：commit log、memtable、SSTable 和后台 compaction 分工不同。
scenario_en: The KV store uses a Cassandra-style LSM write path with commit log, memtable, SSTable, and background compaction.

q: 分布式 KV 需要分别处理哪些故障？
q_en: Which failures should a distributed KV store handle separately?
options: 单节点临时不可达
副本永久丢失或长期落后
整个数据中心不可用
用户把 value 写成字符串
options_en: A single node temporarily unreachable
A replica permanently lost or far behind
A whole data center unavailable
A user writes a string value
why: 临时故障靠 handoff，永久分歧靠 anti-entropy，机房故障靠跨 DC 副本。普通字符串 value 不是故障类型。
why_en: Temporary failure uses handoff, permanent divergence uses anti-entropy, and data-center outage requires cross-site replicas.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据中心，是一组可能共享电力、网络或地理风险的基础设施。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A data center is an infrastructure site that may share power, network, or geographic risks.

scenario: 客户端收到写成功后，立刻断电重启一个副本。系统不能丢这次已确认写。
scenario_en: A client receives write success, then one replica loses power and restarts. The system must not lose that acknowledged write.
q: 单节点内最关键的持久化机制是什么？
q_en: What is the key per-node durability mechanism?
options: 写前日志或 commit log
只放 memtable
只靠客户端重试
只靠 gossip 心跳
options_en: A write-ahead log or commit log
Only the memtable
Only client retries
Only gossip heartbeats
why: 副本级持久性要先落本地日志。gossip 只能发现节点状态，不能恢复内存里丢失的数据。
why_en: Replica durability needs a local log first; gossip detects liveness but cannot recover lost in-memory writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写数据页或内存表前先追加的恢复日志。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A write-ahead log is appended before data pages or memory tables so writes can be recovered.

tradeoff: 本地持久性 vs 只做存活检测
whenOtherWins: 如果只是临时缓存节点，数据源可重建，本地 commit log 可以弱化。

scenario: 用户刚修改个人资料，马上刷新页面却可能被路由到旧副本。产品希望这个用户至少读到自己的新写入。
scenario_en: A user updates their profile and immediately refreshes, but may be routed to a stale replica. Product wants the user to at least read their own write.
q: 如何支持 read-your-writes？
q_en: How can read-your-writes be supported?
options: 会话路由或更高 R
永远 R=1 随机读
删除所有旧副本
关闭写入确认
options_en: Session routing or higher R
Always random-read with R=1
Delete all old replicas
Disable write acknowledgments
why: 最终一致不等于用户必须读到旧值。会话粘性、版本 token 或更高 R 都能保护“读到自己的写”。
why_en: Eventual consistency can still provide read-your-writes through session routing, version tokens, or stronger read consistency.
tradeoff: 用户体验一致性 vs 读延迟/路由状态
whenOtherWins: 纯匿名浏览数据不需要这个保证，随机读低延迟更重要。

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端完成写入后，自己的后续读取能看到这次写。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Read-your-writes means a client can see its own completed write in later reads.

scenario: 同一个 KV 平台同时服务购物车、余额缓存和推荐特征。不同业务对新鲜度和可用性要求不同。
scenario_en: One KV platform serves carts, balance cache, and recommendation features. Different workloads have different freshness and availability needs.
q: 为什么要提供 tunable consistency？
q_en: Why offer tunable consistency?
options: 让每类请求按业务风险选择 R/W 或一致性级别
让所有业务强制同一个延迟
让 key 不再需要分片
让冲突永远不会出现
options_en: Let each request choose R/W or consistency level by business risk
Force one latency for every workload
Remove the need for sharding
Make conflicts impossible
why: 一个固定一致性策略很难同时满足所有业务。可调一致性让高风险操作多等副本，低风险读走低延迟。
why_en: One fixed policy rarely fits every workload, so tunable consistency lets risky operations wait for more replicas and low-risk reads stay fast.
tradeoff: 统一简单性 vs 按业务调优
whenOtherWins: 单一业务、单一 SLO 的小系统可以固定一种一致性级别，减少使用错误。

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务对外承诺或内部追踪的目标水平，比如延迟或可用性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLO is a target level for a service, such as latency or availability.

scenario: 你要设计订单 ID。要求：全局唯一、纯数字、64-bit 内、按时间大致递增、峰值超过 10,000 IDs/s。
scenario_en: You are designing order IDs that must be globally unique, numeric, fit in 64 bits, roughly time-ordered, and exceed 10,000 IDs per second.
q: 为什么单库 auto_increment 不够？
q_en: Why is a single database auto_increment not enough?
options: 它会把生成能力和可用性绑到单点数据库
它生成的 ID 不是数字
它不能保证本机递增
它一定超过 128-bit
options_en: It ties generation capacity and availability to one database point
It does not generate numeric IDs
It cannot increment locally
It is always larger than 128 bits
why: 单库自增简单，但吞吐和故障域都集中。分布式系统需要多节点独立生成，还不能互相撞号。
why_en: Single-database auto-increment is simple, but it centralizes throughput and failure risk instead of letting many nodes generate safely.
tradeoff: 集中简单性 vs 分布式可用性
whenOtherWins: 小型单体应用只需要一台数据库时，自增主键仍然最简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库自动递增生成主键值的功能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Auto-increment is a database feature that automatically assigns increasing primary-key values.

scenario: ID 要 64-bit、纯数字、按时间排序。你在比较 UUID、ticket server、multi-master 自增、Snowflake。
scenario_en: IDs must be 64-bit, numeric, and time-ordered. You compare UUIDs, a ticket server, multi-master auto-increment, and Snowflake.
q: 哪个方案最贴合这些约束？
q_en: Which approach best fits these constraints?
options: Snowflake 风格按 bit 分段生成
UUID v4 随机生成
单 ticket server 自增
多主库按步长自增
options_en: Snowflake-style bit-partitioned IDs
Random UUID v4
Single ticket-server increment
Multi-master increment by step
why: Snowflake 把时间、机房、机器和序列号放进 64-bit，能多节点生成且大致按时间递增。其他方案至少会卡在长度、排序、单点或拓扑变化上。
why_en: Snowflake packs time, location, machine, and sequence into 64 bits, giving distributed generation with rough time ordering.
tradeoff: 约束贴合度 vs 依赖时钟和配置
whenOtherWins: 如果只要求全局唯一、不要求 64-bit 或排序，UUID 会更省协调。

termDefinitions.meaning: 128-bit 的通用唯一标识符，通常可由节点独立生成。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A UUID is a 128-bit universally unique identifier that can usually be generated independently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把时间戳、节点标识和序列号编码到整数 ID 的分布式 ID 思路。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Snowflake is a distributed ID scheme that encodes timestamp, node identity, and sequence into one integer.

scenario: Web 服务器各自本地生成 UUID，几乎不需要协调。现在产品要求 ID 必须放进 64-bit 整数列，并按创建时间排序。
scenario_en: Web servers generate UUIDs locally with almost no coordination. Product now requires IDs to fit a 64-bit integer column and sort by creation time.
q: UUID 在这个场景的主要问题是什么？
q_en: What is the main issue with UUIDs here?
options: 通常太长，而且不天然按时间递增
必须依赖单点数据库
每秒只能生成一个
不能在 Web 服务器生成
options_en: They are usually too long and not naturally time-increasing
They require a single database point
They can generate only one per second
They cannot be generated on web servers
why: UUID 的优势是低协调和低碰撞概率。这里硬约束是 64-bit 数字和时间排序，所以优势不够抵消格式不匹配。
why_en: UUIDs are great for low coordination, but they do not fit a 64-bit numeric, time-ordered requirement.
tradeoff: 无协调唯一性 vs ID 格式要求
whenOtherWins: 日志追踪、对象外部引用这类不要求短整数排序的场景，UUID 很合适。

scenario: 团队考虑用一个 ticket server 统一发号。实现简单，ID 递增，但所有服务都要请求它。
scenario_en: The team considers a ticket server that hands out IDs centrally. It is simple and increasing, but every service must call it.
q: ticket server 的最大风险是什么？
q_en: What is the biggest risk of a ticket server?
options: 单点故障和吞吐瓶颈
ID 一定不是数字
ID 一定不能递增
无法和数据库一起使用
options_en: Single point of failure and throughput bottleneck
IDs are never numeric
IDs can never increase
It cannot be used with databases
why: 集中发号容易理解，但发号服务挂了，下游都拿不到新 ID。做多 ticket server 又会引入同步和分段分配问题。
why_en: A central ticket server is easy to reason about, but if it fails every dependent service stops getting new IDs.
tradeoff: 实现简单 vs 高可用
whenOtherWins: 中小规模内部系统、发号量低且可接受主备切换时，ticket server 可以很实用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 集中生成并分发唯一 ID 的服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ticket server is a centralized service that generates and hands out unique IDs.

scenario: 两个数据库主节点各自自增。为了避免冲突，一个发奇数，一个发偶数；之后要新增第三个主节点。
scenario_en: Two database masters generate IDs independently, one odd and one even. Later, a third master must be added.
q: 多主步长自增的扩展问题是什么？
q_en: What scaling issue does multi-master step increment have?
options: 节点数变化会改变步长和号段规则，迁移很麻烦
它不能生成数字 ID
它完全不依赖数据库
它天然按全局时间排序
options_en: Changing node count changes step and allocation rules, making migration hard
It cannot generate numeric IDs
It does not rely on databases at all
It is naturally globally time-ordered
why: 按 k 个主节点设置步长时，k 变了规则也变。跨机房和节点增删都会让配置、排序和冲突处理复杂化。
why_en: When the step depends on the number of masters, adding or removing masters changes the allocation rules and complicates migration.
tradeoff: 局部生成 vs 拓扑变更成本
whenOtherWins: 固定两个主库、规模稳定、只要避免冲突不要求时间排序时，这个方案可以凑合。

q: Snowflake 64-bit ID 通常由哪些部分组成？
q_en: What fields usually make up a Snowflake-style 64-bit ID?
text: 一个 Snowflake 风格 ID 常见布局是：{{sign bit}}、{{timestamp}}、datacenter ID、machine ID、sequence number。
text_en: A Snowflake-style ID commonly contains a {{sign bit}}, {{timestamp}}, datacenter ID, machine ID, and sequence number.
why: 这些字段把“什么时候生成”和“哪台机器生成”编码进同一个整数。序列号处理同一毫秒内的多次生成。
why_en: These fields encode when and where the ID was generated, with the sequence handling multiple IDs in the same millisecond.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一机器同一时间粒度内递增的小计数，用来避免撞号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sequence number is a small counter within the same time bucket on one machine to avoid collisions.

scenario: Snowflake 布局给 datacenter ID 5 bits，machine ID 5 bits。每个 bit 字段能表示 2^bits 个值。
scenario_en: A Snowflake layout gives 5 bits to datacenter ID and 5 bits to machine ID. A bit field represents 2^bits values.
q: 这两个字段带来什么容量上限？
q_en: What capacity limit do these two fields imply?
options: 32 个机房，每个机房 32 台机器
5 个机房，每个机房 5 台机器
10 个机房，共 10 台机器
64 个机房，每个机房 64 台机器
options_en: 32 data centers and 32 machines per data center
5 data centers and 5 machines per data center
10 data centers and 10 machines total
64 data centers and 64 machines per data center
why: 公式是 2^5=32。这个数字用于规划发号节点上限；超过后要重新分配 bit，或引入 worker 组、号段服务等方案。
why_en: Five bits gives 2^5 or 32 values, which bounds how many data centers and machines the ID layout can encode.

termDefinitions.meaning: 二进制位，只能表示 0 或 1；n 个 bit 能表示 2^n 种状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bit is a binary digit, and n bits can represent 2^n states.

scenario: Snowflake 序列号字段是 12 bits，并且每台机器每毫秒重置一次。
scenario_en: The Snowflake sequence field is 12 bits and resets every millisecond on each machine.
q: 12-bit sequence 的吞吐含义是什么？
q_en: What throughput does a 12-bit sequence imply?
options: 单机每毫秒最多 4096 个 ID
整个系统每天 4096 个 ID
单机每秒最多 12 个 ID
只能支持 4096 台机器
options_en: Up to 4096 IDs per machine per millisecond
4096 IDs per day for the whole system
Up to 12 IDs per second per machine
Only 4096 machines are supported
why: 公式是 2^12=4096。它是单机器、单毫秒内的序列空间；超过就要等下一毫秒或扩大序列字段。
why_en: Twelve bits gives 4096 sequence values per machine per millisecond; beyond that you wait or allocate more bits.

scenario: Snowflake 用 41-bit 毫秒时间戳，相对自定义 epoch 计时。你要评估这套 ID 布局能用多久。
scenario_en: Snowflake uses a 41-bit millisecond timestamp relative to a custom epoch, and you need to estimate how long the layout lasts.
q: 41-bit 时间戳的设计影响是什么？
q_en: What design impact does a 41-bit timestamp have?
options: 约 69 年寿命，决定 epoch 和迁移计划
机器数会自动扩到 69 台
每秒只能生成 69 个 ID
可以忽略时钟回拨问题
options_en: About 69 years of lifetime, driving epoch and migration planning
The machine count automatically expands to 69
Only 69 IDs can be generated per second
Clock rollback can be ignored
why: 公式是 (2^41-1) ms /1000/3600/24/365，约 69 年。这个数不是背诵点，它决定 epoch 选多近，以及未来何时需要迁移 ID 格式。
why_en: A 41-bit millisecond timestamp lasts about 69 years, so it drives epoch choice and long-term ID migration planning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统约定的起始时间点，时间戳字段记录相对它经过了多久。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An epoch is the chosen start time from which timestamp values count elapsed time.

scenario: 产品要求新生成的 ID 大致按创建时间排序，方便数据库按 ID 范围扫描近期数据。
scenario_en: Product wants newly generated IDs to roughly sort by creation time so the database can range-scan recent records by ID.
q: Snowflake 中哪个字段主要提供时间排序？
q_en: Which Snowflake field mainly provides time ordering?
options: 高位 timestamp 字段
低位 sequence number
sign bit
machine ID 的最后一位
options_en: The high-order timestamp field
The low-order sequence number
The sign bit
The last bit of machine ID
why: 时间戳放在高位，时间越晚，高位数值越大。低位机器和序列字段只负责同一时间附近的区分。
why_en: Putting the timestamp in high-order bits makes later times sort larger, while lower fields disambiguate nearby IDs.
tradeoff: 时间可排序 vs 时钟依赖
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要随机唯一且不按时间查，随机 UUID 不依赖机器时钟排序。

scenario: 发号机器的系统时钟向后回拨。它可能再次使用过去的 timestamp 和相同 sequence。
scenario_en: An ID generator machine clock moves backward, so it may reuse an old timestamp with the same sequence values.
q: 时钟回拨会带来什么风险？
q_en: What risk does clock rollback create?
options: 可能生成重复 ID 或破坏时间排序
只会让 ID 更短
会自动扩展 machine ID
会让数据库读更快
options_en: It can create duplicate IDs or break time ordering
It only makes IDs shorter
It automatically expands the machine ID
It makes database reads faster
why: Snowflake 的唯一性依赖 timestamp、机器 ID、序列号组合不重复。时钟倒退会重用时间桶，所以要等待、拒绝发号或切换保护策略。
why_en: Snowflake uniqueness relies on not reusing the same timestamp-machine-sequence tuple, so clock rollback must be guarded.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常见的网络时间同步协议，用来让机器时钟尽量一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NTP is a common protocol for synchronizing machine clocks across a network.

scenario: 两台发号进程被错误配置成同一个 datacenter ID 和 machine ID，并且它们在同一毫秒内发号。
scenario_en: Two generator processes are misconfigured with the same datacenter ID and machine ID and generate IDs in the same millisecond.
q: 机器 ID 配置错误会导致什么？
q_en: What can wrong machine-ID assignment cause?
options: 不同机器可能生成相同 ID
ID 会自动转成 UUID
系统吞吐提升一倍
timestamp 字段失效为 0
options_en: Different machines may generate the same ID
IDs automatically become UUIDs
System throughput doubles
The timestamp field becomes zero
why: 机器 ID 是分布式唯一性的隔离字段。两个进程共享同一身份时，timestamp 和 sequence 撞上的概率就变成真实风险。
why_en: Machine ID separates generators; if two processes share it, matching timestamp and sequence values can collide.

q: 调整 Snowflake bit 分配时，哪些取舍成立？
q_en: When tuning Snowflake bit allocation, which tradeoffs are valid?
options: 更多 timestamp bits 能延长可用年限
更多 sequence bits 能提高单机同毫秒吞吐
更多 machine bits 能支持更多发号节点
更多 sign bits 会自动提升一致性
options_en: More timestamp bits extend the usable lifetime
More sequence bits raise per-machine per-millisecond throughput
More machine bits support more generator nodes
More sign bits automatically improve consistency
why: 64-bit 总预算固定，给一个字段更多 bit，就要从别的字段拿。调参要看寿命、节点数、单机峰值哪个更紧。
why_en: The 64-bit budget is fixed, so bit allocation trades lifetime, generator count, and per-machine burst capacity.

q: Snowflake 为什么能多节点生成可排序 ID？
q_en: Why can Snowflake generate sortable IDs on many nodes?
steps: timestamp 放在高位，让晚生成的 ID 通常更大
datacenter 和 machine 字段隔离不同发号节点
sequence 字段处理同一机器同一毫秒内的多次生成
所有字段拼成一个 64-bit 数字返回
why: 这条链把排序、分布式唯一性和同毫秒并发分开说。面试里不要只说“用 Snowflake”四个字。
why_en: The reasoning separates time ordering, generator identity, and same-millisecond concurrency instead of just naming Snowflake.

scenario: ID 生成器是下单、发帖、写日志的前置依赖。服务不可用时，业务写入都会被卡住。
scenario_en: The ID generator is a prerequisite for orders, posts, and logs; when it is unavailable, business writes are blocked.
q: ID 生成器的高可用重点是什么？
q_en: What is the high-availability focus for an ID generator?
options: 让多个独立节点本地发号，并严格分配唯一机器身份
只部署一个最大规格机器
让客户端自己随机猜 ID
每次发号都做跨机房同步事务
options_en: Let multiple independent nodes generate locally with unique machine identities
Deploy one largest possible machine
Let clients randomly guess IDs
Run a cross-region synchronous transaction for every ID
why: 发号服务不能成为写路径单点。多节点本地发号能抗单机故障，但机器身份和时钟保护必须管严。
why_en: The generator must not be a write-path single point, so local multi-node generation needs strict identity and clock safeguards.
tradeoff: 本地高可用 vs 配置纪律
whenOtherWins: 低吞吐内部后台任务可以用单主号段服务，简单性更重要。

scenario: 面试官说“ID 要唯一”。你还不知道它是否需要排序、是否必须数字、长度限制和吞吐量。
scenario_en: The interviewer says IDs must be unique, but you do not yet know whether they must sort, be numeric, fit a length limit, or meet a throughput target.
q: 设计 ID 生成器前最该澄清什么？
q_en: What should be clarified before designing an ID generator?
options: 澄清格式、排序、长度和 QPS
确认前端按钮颜色
确认表名是否好看
确认日志是否英文
options_en: Clarify format, ordering, length, and QPS
Confirm frontend button color
Confirm whether table names look nice
Confirm whether logs use English
why: 不同约束会选出完全不同方案。UUID、ticket server 和 Snowflake 的差异主要就是格式、排序、吞吐和可用性。
why_en: Different constraints lead to different choices; UUID, ticket server, and Snowflake differ mainly on format, ordering, throughput, and availability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒请求数，用来描述发号接口吞吐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS means queries per second and describes request throughput.

tradeoff: 需求约束清晰度 vs 过早选型
whenOtherWins: 如果题目已经明确给出格式、排序和吞吐，才可以直接比较具体生成方案。

scenario: 系统要求 ID 按时间大致递增，但不要求每次严格 +1。
scenario_en: The system requires IDs to be roughly increasing by time, but not strictly increasing by exactly one.
q: “按时间递增”和“连续递增”有什么区别？
q_en: How is time-increasing different from gapless incrementing?
options: 时间递增允许跳号；连续递增要求没有空洞
时间递增必须单库生成
连续递增更容易多机无协调
两者完全一样
options_en: Time-increasing allows gaps; gapless incrementing requires no holes
Time-increasing must be generated by one database
Gapless incrementing is easier without coordination
They are identical
why: Snowflake 这类方案会因为机器号和序列号产生跳号。面试需求通常要可排序，不是要审计级无空洞序列。
why_en: Snowflake-style IDs can skip values because of machine and sequence fields; the usual requirement is sortability, not a gapless ledger.
tradeoff: 可排序分布式生成 vs 无空洞序列
whenOtherWins: 发票号、审计流水这类法规场景可能真的需要连续或可解释的号段。

scenario: 你考虑用 UUID 做数据库主键。写入分布式服务很简单，但主键索引要存 128-bit 且插入顺序随机。
scenario_en: You consider UUIDs as database primary keys. Distributed generation is easy, but the primary-key index stores 128-bit random-ish values.
q: UUID 的数据库代价是什么？
q_en: What database cost can UUIDs create?
options: 索引更大，随机写可能让局部性变差
必须中心化发号
只能表达 32 个机器
每毫秒只能生成一个
options_en: Larger indexes and random writes can hurt locality
They require centralized generation
They can represent only 32 machines
They can generate only one per millisecond
why: UUID 省协调，但长度和随机性会影响索引大小、缓存命中和写入局部性。它不是免费主键。
why_en: UUIDs save coordination, but their size and randomness can hurt index size, cache locality, and write locality.
tradeoff: 无协调生成 vs 存储/索引局部性
whenOtherWins: 外部公开 ID 或跨系统追踪 ID 常常更看重无协调和不可猜。

scenario: 一个 ticket server 是单点瓶颈。团队考虑让业务服务一次拿一段 ID，比如 1000 个，存在本地慢慢用。
scenario_en: A ticket server is a bottleneck. The team considers letting services fetch blocks of IDs, such as 1000 at a time, and use them locally.
q: 批量领号能改善什么？
q_en: What does block allocation improve?
options: 少打 ticket server，但会跳号
完全消除单点
自动按机器时间排序
取消 64-bit 限制
options_en: Fewer ticket-server calls, but gaps appear
Fully remove the single point
Automatically sort by machine time
Remove the 64-bit limit
why: 号段缓存把中心服务压力摊薄。机器拿了号段后崩溃，没用完的号会空掉，所以不能要求无空洞。
why_en: Block allocation reduces central calls, but unused IDs in a crashed node create gaps, so it cannot promise gapless IDs.
tradeoff: 中心吞吐 vs 号段浪费
whenOtherWins: 如果 ID 必须严格连续，批量预取会很难接受。

scenario: Snowflake 有 5-bit datacenter 和 5-bit machine。你计划 20 个机房，每个机房 40 台发号机器。
scenario_en: Snowflake has 5-bit datacenter and 5-bit machine fields. You plan 20 data centers and 40 generator machines per data center.
q: 这个规划哪里超出 bit 布局？
q_en: Where does this plan exceed the bit layout?
options: 40 台/机房超过 32 上限
20 个机房超过 32 上限
两者都超过
两者都没超过
options_en: 40 machines per data center exceeds 32
20 data centers exceeds 32
Both exceed the layout
Neither exceeds the layout
why: 5 bits 能表示 2^5=32。20 个机房没超，但 40 台/机房超过 machine 字段，需要重分 bit 或分组。
why_en: Five bits encode 32 values; 20 data centers fit, but 40 machines per data center exceed the machine field.

scenario: 某台发号机器在同一毫秒内已经用完 4096 个 sequence。下一次请求仍在同一毫秒到达。
scenario_en: One generator has already used all 4096 sequence values in the same millisecond. Another request arrives before the clock advances.
q: sequence 溢出时应该怎么做？
q_en: What should happen on sequence overflow?
options: 等到下一毫秒再发号，或返回限流/重试
从 0 重新开始继续发
复用上一条 ID
把 machine ID 临时改成别人的
options_en: Wait for the next millisecond, or return throttle/retry
Restart from 0 and continue
Reuse the previous ID
Temporarily borrow another machine ID
why: 同一 timestamp、machine、sequence 组合不能重复。序列耗尽后继续循环会撞号，只能等时间前进或拒绝。
why_en: The same timestamp-machine-sequence tuple must not repeat, so overflow must wait for time to advance or reject the request.
tradeoff: 唯一性安全 vs 单机瞬时吞吐
whenOtherWins: 如果这种峰值经常发生，应增加机器数或给 sequence 更多 bit。

scenario: 发号服务检测到本机时间比上次发号时间小 50ms。继续发号可能重用旧时间桶。
scenario_en: The generator detects local time is 50ms behind the last issued timestamp. Continuing may reuse an old time bucket.
q: 时钟回拨的常见保护策略是什么？
q_en: What is a common protection strategy for clock rollback?
options: 短回拨等待追平；长回拨拒绝服务并告警
直接忽略并继续发号
把 sequence 扩成无限大
删除 machine ID 字段
options_en: Wait out small rollbacks; reject and alert on large rollbacks
Ignore it and continue
Make the sequence infinite
Delete the machine ID field
why: 小回拨等待能保住唯一性且影响有限。长回拨说明时钟不可信，继续发号风险比短暂停服更大。
why_en: Waiting out small rollbacks preserves uniqueness, while large rollbacks should stop issuance because the clock is no longer trustworthy.
tradeoff: 可用性 vs 唯一性
whenOtherWins: 如果业务可接受非时间排序 ID，可以改用不依赖本地时钟的发号方案。

scenario: 你在 2026 年上线 Snowflake 类 ID。如果 epoch 设成 1970 年，41-bit 时间戳已经消耗了几十年空间。
scenario_en: You launch Snowflake-like IDs in 2026. If the epoch is 1970, the 41-bit timestamp has already spent decades of range.
q: 为什么选择接近上线时间的 custom epoch？
q_en: Why choose a custom epoch near launch time?
options: 把 41-bit 时间范围尽量留给系统未来使用
让 ID 变成随机字符串
增加每毫秒 sequence 数量
减少机器 ID 冲突
options_en: Reserve more of the 41-bit timestamp range for the system’s future
Turn IDs into random strings
Increase sequence values per millisecond
Reduce machine-ID conflicts
why: timestamp 记录的是相对 epoch 的毫秒数。epoch 越接近上线，溢出时间越晚。
why_en: The timestamp stores milliseconds since the epoch, so a launch-near epoch pushes overflow farther into the future.
tradeoff: 寿命最大化 vs 跨系统 epoch 统一
whenOtherWins: 多个系统必须按同一时间基准比较 ID 时，统一 epoch 可能更重要。

scenario: Snowflake 64-bit 布局保留最高位 sign bit 为 0，让 ID 在有符号整数里仍保持非负。
scenario_en: A Snowflake 64-bit layout keeps the highest sign bit at 0 so IDs remain non-negative in signed integer types.
q: sign bit 保留为 0 有什么实际作用？
q_en: What is the practical purpose of keeping the sign bit at 0?
options: 避免 signed long 里出现负数
让时间戳容量翻倍
让机器数翻倍
保证 JSON 不丢精度
options_en: Avoid negatives in signed long
Double timestamp capacity
Double machine count
Guarantee JSON precision
why: 很多数据库和语言默认用 signed long。最高位固定 0 可以减少负数 ID 带来的排序和展示问题。
why_en: Many databases and languages use signed long integers, so fixing the top bit to zero avoids negative IDs and display surprises.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最高位表示正负号的整数类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A signed integer uses its highest bit to represent positive or negative sign.

scenario: 下游系统只接受 int64 主键，不能存连字符，也不能存字母。
scenario_en: A downstream system accepts only int64 primary keys, with no hyphens or letters.
q: 这个约束会排除什么方案？
q_en: Which solution does this constraint rule out?
options: 标准 UUID 字符串
Snowflake 64-bit 整数
ticket server 整数
数据库自增整数
options_en: Standard UUID strings
Snowflake 64-bit integers
Ticket-server integers
Database auto-increment integers
why: 标准 UUID 文本包含 128-bit 内容和分隔符，不适合 int64 数字列。Snowflake 和 ticket server 都能输出数字。
why_en: A standard UUID string carries 128-bit content and separators, so it does not fit an int64 numeric-only field.
tradeoff: 严格数字格式 vs 无协调 UUID
whenOtherWins: 如果下游能接受字符串或二进制 128-bit 字段，UUID 会重新变成低协调成本方案。

scenario: 你可以选 Snowflake 本地发号，也可以让数据库事务插入时返回自增 ID。系统有多机房写入。
scenario_en: You can use local Snowflake generation or have a database transaction return an auto-increment ID. The system writes from multiple data centers.
q: Snowflake 相比数据库自增的主要优势是什么？
q_en: What is Snowflake’s main advantage over database auto-increment?
options: 发号不在每次写入时依赖单个数据库节点
保证 ID 无空洞
完全不依赖时钟
不需要配置机器身份
options_en: ID generation does not depend on one database node for every write
It guarantees gapless IDs
It does not depend on clocks at all
It needs no machine identity configuration
why: Snowflake 让业务节点本地生成 ID，减少跨机房写前协调。代价是要管理时钟、机器号和 bit 容量。
why_en: Snowflake lets services generate IDs locally, reducing pre-write coordination at the cost of clock, machine-id, and bit-capacity management.
tradeoff: 本地生成低延迟 vs 运维约束
whenOtherWins: 单库单区域应用用数据库自增更简单，也更容易调试。

q: Snowflake 容量耗尽前应如何规划？
q_en: How should Snowflake capacity exhaustion be planned?
steps: 监控 timestamp 接近 41-bit 上限的时间窗口
评估是否需要新 epoch、扩展位数或新 ID 版本
设计新旧 ID 共存和排序规则
逐步迁移写入方和数据库字段约束
why: ID 格式一旦进入数据库和外部接口，迁移很慢。容量问题要提前几年规划，而不是溢出当天处理。
why_en: ID formats spread into databases and APIs, so timestamp exhaustion needs years of migration planning, not same-day fixes.

q: Snowflake 类 ID 生成器上线前要重点防哪些风险？
q_en: Which risks should be guarded before launching a Snowflake-like generator?
options: 机器 ID 重复分配
系统时钟回拨
同毫秒 sequence 溢出
浏览器缓存 301
options_en: Duplicate machine-ID assignment
System clock rollback
Sequence overflow in one millisecond
Browser caching of 301 redirects
why: 这三项都会威胁唯一性、排序或可用性。301 缓存是 URL shortener 的跳转问题，不是 ID 发号核心风险。
why_en: Duplicate machine IDs, clock rollback, and sequence overflow threaten uniqueness, ordering, or availability.

scenario: 需求是 10,000 IDs/s。Snowflake 单机理论上 4096 IDs/ms，远高于平均需求，但峰值可能集中到少数机器。
scenario_en: The requirement is 10,000 IDs per second. A Snowflake node can theoretically issue 4096 IDs per millisecond, but bursts may concentrate on a few machines.
q: 吞吐规划不能只看什么？
q_en: What should throughput planning not rely on alone?
options: 不能只看全局平均 QPS，还要看单机瞬时峰值
只要平均满足就永远不会溢出
只看数据库磁盘大小
只看机房数量
options_en: Do not look only at global average QPS; check per-node bursts
If average fits, overflow is impossible
Look only at database disk size
Look only at data-center count
why: sequence 限制是单机器、单毫秒的。全局平均 10k/s 很低，但流量不均或批处理突发仍可能打爆单机时间桶。
why_en: The sequence limit is per machine per millisecond, so low global average QPS can still hide per-node bursts.
tradeoff: 全局平均吞吐 vs 单机瞬时峰值
whenOtherWins: 如果流量天然均匀分散到足够多机器，全局平均值才更接近容量判断。

scenario: 订单 ID 用 Snowflake 后大致递增。外部用户可以在 URL 里看到订单 ID。产品担心别人猜测业务量或枚举资源。
scenario_en: Order IDs are Snowflake-like and roughly increasing. External users can see them in URLs, and product worries about business-volume leakage or enumeration.
q: 可排序 ID 暴露给外部有什么风险？
q_en: What risk comes from exposing sortable IDs externally?
options: 可能泄露生成时间和增长趋势，甚至方便枚举
会破坏数据库主键唯一性
会让 sequence 自动溢出
会让 NTP 停止工作
options_en: They can leak creation time and growth trends, and ease enumeration
They break primary-key uniqueness
They automatically overflow the sequence
They stop NTP from working
why: Snowflake 的可排序性对内部存储有用，但外部可见时可能暴露节奏。可以用随机 public ID 或权限校验隔离。
why_en: Snowflake ordering is useful internally, but public exposure can leak timing and volume, so use random public IDs or strict authorization.
tradeoff: 内部可排序性 vs 外部不可猜性
whenOtherWins: 内部事件表和日志系统通常不在意可猜性，更看重排序和定位。

termDefinitions.meaning: 常见的网络时间同步协议，用来让机器时钟尽量一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NTP is a common network protocol for keeping machine clocks synchronized.

scenario: URL 短链服务每天新建 1 亿条短链。你要估算写入 QPS。
scenario_en: A URL shortener creates 100 million new short links per day, and you need write QPS.
q: 1 亿/天写入对架构意味着什么？
q_en: What does 100 million writes per day imply for the architecture?
options: 约 1,160/s，要按持续写入吞吐设计
只需要单进程内存数组
redirect 路径不会有压力
短码长度可以固定为 2 位
options_en: About 1,160 per second, so design for sustained write throughput
A single-process memory array is enough
The redirect path has no pressure
Short codes can stay fixed at two characters
why: 公式是 100,000,000 / 24 / 3600 ≈ 1,160 QPS。这个数用来估算 Web 层、ID 生成器和数据库写入吞吐。
why_en: One hundred million per day is about 1,160 writes per second, which sizes the web tier, ID generator, and database writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询或请求数，用来估算服务吞吐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS means queries per second and is used to estimate service throughput.

scenario: 短链服务写入约 1,160/s。读写比假设为 10:1，你要估算跳转读流量。
scenario_en: The shortener writes about 1,160 links per second. Assume a 10:1 read-to-write ratio and estimate redirect reads.
q: 10:1 读写比对 redirect 路径意味着什么？
q_en: What does a 10:1 read-write ratio imply for redirects?
options: 缓存并横向扩展 redirect
写路径会比读路径高十倍
可以不保存 shortURL 映射
所有点击都应同步写主库事务
options_en: Cache and horizontally scale redirects
Writes become ten times higher than reads
The shortURL mapping does not need storage
Every click should synchronously write a primary transaction
why: 公式是 1,160 × 10 ≈ 11,600 QPS。它说明 redirect 路径比创建路径更需要缓存和横向扩展。
why_en: A 10:1 ratio turns 1,160 writes per second into about 11,600 reads per second, making the redirect path cache-critical.

scenario: 系统 10 年要支持约 3650 亿条短链，短码字符集是 0-9、a-z、A-Z，共 62 个字符。
scenario_en: The system must support about 365 billion links over 10 years, using 62 characters: 0-9, a-z, and A-Z.
q: 短码至少需要几位？
q_en: What minimum short-code length is needed?
options: 7 位，因为 62^7 约 3.5 万亿
5 位，因为 62^5 足够
10 位，因为必须等于年数
64 位，因为 ID 是 64-bit
options_en: 7 characters, because 62^7 is about 3.5 trillion
5 characters, because 62^5 is enough
10 characters, because it must equal years
64 characters, because the ID is 64-bit
why: 公式是找最小 n 使 62^n ≥ 3650 亿；62^7 约 3.5 万亿，留有余量。这个长度直接决定短链可读性和容量上限。
why_en: Find the smallest n where 62^n covers 365 billion; 62^7 is roughly 3.5 trillion, so seven characters works.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 62 个 URL 友好字符表示数字的编码方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Base62 is an encoding that represents numbers with 62 URL-friendly characters.

scenario: 短链一旦创建就不会更新或删除。目标是尽量减少短链服务的重复 redirect 请求，点击分析不是核心需求。
scenario_en: Short links are immutable after creation. The goal is to reduce repeated redirect traffic to the shortener, and click analytics is not core.
q: 跳转状态码应优先选哪个？
q_en: Which redirect status should be preferred?
options: 301 permanent redirect
302 temporary redirect
500 internal error
202 accepted
options_en: 301 permanent redirect
302 temporary redirect
500 internal error
202 accepted
why: 301 告诉浏览器和中间缓存这个映射长期有效，后续同一短链可能不再打到短链服务。代价是点击统计会少看到重复访问。
why_en: A 301 lets clients cache the permanent mapping and reduces repeat traffic, at the cost of less complete click tracking.
tradeoff: 服务端负载 vs 点击可观测性
whenOtherWins: 如果业务要精确统计每次点击来源和次数，302 更适合。

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 永久重定向，客户端可以缓存映射。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A 301 redirect is an HTTP permanent redirect that clients may cache.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 临时重定向，客户端通常会再次请求短链服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A 302 redirect is an HTTP temporary redirect where clients usually come back to the shortener.

codeSample:
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location: https://example.com/long
Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000

scenario: 短链平台要按每次点击统计来源、时间和设备。短链目标 URL 仍不可变，但分析准确性很重要。
scenario_en: The shortener must record each click source, time, and device. Destination URLs are immutable, but analytics accuracy matters.
q: 为了点击分析，跳转状态码更适合什么？
q_en: Which redirect status better supports click analytics?
options: 302 temporary redirect
301 permanent redirect
204 no content
304 not modified
options_en: 302 temporary redirect
301 permanent redirect
204 no content
304 not modified
why: 302 会让后续点击继续先到短链服务，服务端才能记录每次访问。代价是短链服务承担更多读流量。
why_en: A 302 sends future clicks back through the shortener, preserving analytics while increasing redirect traffic.
tradeoff: 点击可观测性 vs 服务端负载
whenOtherWins: 如果统计不重要、目标 URL 永久不变，301 可以把重复跳转压力交给客户端缓存。
codeSample:
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://example.com/long
Cache-Control: no-store

scenario: 高层设计先用内存哈希表保存 shortURL 到 longURL。但系统要保存 10 年、数千亿条记录，进程重启也不能丢。
scenario_en: The high-level design starts with an in-memory map from shortURL to longURL, but the system must retain hundreds of billions of rows for 10 years and survive restarts.
q: 映射关系应放在哪里？
q_en: Where should the mapping be stored?
options: 持久化数据库表，并用缓存加速热读
只放每台 Web 服务器内存
只写浏览器 cookie
不保存，靠短码反推出 longURL
options_en: In a persistent database table, with cache for hot reads
Only in each web server’s memory
Only in browser cookies
Do not store it; reverse the short code into the long URL
why: 短码到长 URL 是核心持久状态，必须落库。读多时可以把热门映射放缓存，但缓存不能替代长期存储。
why_en: The short-to-long mapping is durable state, so it belongs in storage, while cache only accelerates hot reads.
tradeoff: 持久性 vs 访问延迟
whenOtherWins: 一次性临时短链、过期很快且可丢失时，纯缓存设计才可能成立。

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程或机器故障后仍必须保留的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Durable state is data that must survive process or machine failure.

q: URL shortener 的核心 API 通常有哪些？
q_en: What are the core APIs of a URL shortener?
options: POST 创建短链，输入 longUrl，返回 shortURL
GET 访问短码，返回或重定向到 longURL
DELETE 必须支持任意用户删除短链
PUT 必须允许修改短码对应 longURL
options_en: POST creates a short link from longUrl and returns shortURL
GET resolves a short code and redirects to longURL
DELETE must let any user delete links
PUT must let users change the longURL for a code
why: 题设里短链不可删除、不可更新，所以核心只有创建和跳转。删除、更新会额外引入权限、缓存失效和历史语义问题。
why_en: With immutable links, the core APIs are creation and redirect; delete or update would add authorization and cache-invalidation complexity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 HTTP 方法和资源路径表达操作的 API 风格。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: REST is an API style that expresses operations through HTTP methods and resource paths.

scenario: 短链服务要生成 7 位短码。你在比较“长 URL 哈希截断+冲突处理”和“唯一数字 ID 做 base62 转换”。
scenario_en: The shortener needs 7-character codes. You compare truncating a hash of the long URL with collision handling versus converting a unique numeric ID to base62.
q: 两种生成方式的核心差别是什么？
q_en: What is the core difference between the two generation methods?
options: 哈希截断要处理碰撞；base62 依赖唯一 ID 避免碰撞
哈希截断一定可逆；base62 一定不可存数据库
哈希截断不需要查重；base62 必须递归加盐
两者都不需要保存映射
options_en: Hash truncation needs collision handling; base62 relies on unique IDs to avoid collisions
Hash truncation is always reversible; base62 cannot be stored in a database
Hash truncation never needs checks; base62 must recursively salt
Neither method needs to store a mapping
why: 截断哈希可能让两个 longURL 得到同一个短码，所以要查重和再哈希。base62 把唯一 ID 编成短字符串，冲突问题转移给 ID 生成器。
why_en: Truncated hashes can collide and need checking, while base62 conversion shifts uniqueness to the ID generator.
tradeoff: 无中心哈希 vs 唯一 ID 依赖
whenOtherWins: 如果不能部署可靠 ID 生成器，哈希加碰撞检测也可以工作，只是查重成本更高。

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个不同输入得到同一个短码或哈希结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A collision occurs when two different inputs produce the same short code or hash result.

q: 使用唯一 ID + base62 时，创建短链的顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the short-link creation flow with unique ID plus base62?
steps: 检查 longURL 是否已经存在，存在就返回旧 shortURL
为新 longURL 生成全局唯一数字 ID
把 ID 转成 base62 短码
保存 id、shortURL、longURL 映射并返回短链
why: 先查重能让同一个 longURL 复用已有短链。新 URL 才发号、编码、落库，避免短码和持久映射不一致。
why_en: Checking first reuses existing links, while new URLs get an ID, base62 code, and durable mapping in one flow.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[longURL] --> B{exists?}
  B -- yes --> C[return old shortURL]
  B -- no --> D[generate unique ID]
  D --> E[base62 code]
  E --> F[insert mapping]
  F --> G[return shortURL]

q: 短链 redirect 的读路径顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the redirect read path order?
steps: 用户访问短链，负载均衡转发到 Web 服务
先查 cache 里的 shortURL 到 longURL 映射
cache miss 时查数据库，找不到则返回无效短链
找到 longURL 后返回 301 或 302 redirect
why: 读路径把最热映射放在缓存里，保护数据库。miss 后再落库查，并区分有效短链和用户乱输的短码。
why_en: The read path uses cache for hot mappings, falls back to storage on misses, and handles invalid codes explicitly.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  U[user] --> LB[load balancer]
  LB --> W[web]
  W --> C{cache hit?}
  C -- yes --> R[redirect]
  C -- no --> DB[(db)]
  DB --> R

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存中没有需要的数据，必须访问后端存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cache miss means the requested data is not in cache and must be fetched from backend storage.

scenario: 短链读 QPS 约是写 QPS 的 10 倍，很多热门短链会被反复点击。数据库保存完整映射。
scenario_en: Redirect QPS is about 10 times write QPS, and popular short links are clicked repeatedly. The database stores the complete mapping.
q: redirect 路径为什么要加缓存？
q_en: Why add cache to the redirect path?
options: 缓存热门映射，挡数据库读
让短码自动变得更短
替代唯一 ID 生成器
保证 302 变成 301
options_en: Cache hot mappings to shield database reads
Automatically make short codes shorter
Replace the unique ID generator
Guarantee 302 becomes 301
why: redirect 是读多路径，热门链接重复命中很高。缓存 shortURL→longURL 能把大部分重复读挡在数据库前面。
why_en: Redirect is read-heavy and popular links repeat, so caching shortURL-to-longURL mappings shields the database.
tradeoff: 低读延迟 vs 缓存一致性/容量
whenOtherWins: 如果链接访问几乎没有重复，缓存命中率低，数据库索引和横向读扩展更重要。

scenario: 攻击者批量调用创建短链 API，试图制造垃圾链接并压垮数据库写入。
scenario_en: An attacker bulk-calls the create-short-link API to create spam links and overload database writes.
q: 创建接口前应加什么保护？
q_en: What protection should sit before the creation API?
options: 按身份限流创建请求
把请求都改成 301
关闭 redirect 缓存
让数据库随机丢写
options_en: Rate-limit creation by identity
Change every request to 301
Disable redirect cache
Let the database randomly drop writes
why: 创建短链是写路径，滥用会直接消耗 ID、存储和审核资源。限流先在入口丢弃过量请求，保护后端。
why_en: Short-link creation burns IDs, storage, and moderation resources, so rate limiting drops abuse before it reaches the backend.
tradeoff: 滥用防护 vs 误伤正常突发
whenOtherWins: 内部可信批处理任务可以走单独配额或白名单，而不是普通用户限流。

termDefinitions.meaning: 按用户、IP 或 token 限制请求速率的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rate limiter caps request rate by user, IP, token, or another identity.

scenario: 短链 Web 层只接收请求、查缓存/数据库、返回结果；会话状态不放在单台 Web 服务器内存里。
scenario_en: The web tier receives requests, checks cache/database, and returns responses; session state is not stored on a single web server.
q: Web 层应如何扩展？
q_en: How should the web tier scale?
options: 保持无状态，通过负载均衡水平扩展
把所有用户固定到同一台 Web 服务器
只靠数据库主库扩容
让浏览器直接访问数据库
options_en: Keep it stateless and scale horizontally behind a load balancer
Pin every user to one web server
Scale only the primary database
Let browsers access the database directly
why: 无状态 Web 服务器可以随流量增删，负载均衡只需要分发请求。状态放到缓存和数据库，避免机器故障带走用户会话。
why_en: Stateless web servers can be added or removed behind a load balancer because durable state lives in cache and storage.
tradeoff: 水平扩展简单性 vs 外部状态依赖
whenOtherWins: 如果有长连接或本地会话状态，就需要 sticky session 或共享会话存储。

scenario: 短链映射表 10 年会到数千亿行。单库索引和存储都接近上限。
scenario_en: The short-link mapping table will reach hundreds of billions of rows over 10 years, pushing one database beyond index and storage limits.
q: 数据库层下一步应考虑什么？
q_en: What should the database layer consider next?
options: 复制读流量，并按 shortURL 或 ID 分片
把所有数据搬回 Web 内存
取消 longURL 字段
每次 redirect 都重新生成短码
options_en: Use replication for reads and shard by shortURL or ID
Move all data back into web memory
Remove the longURL field
Regenerate the short code on every redirect
why: 复制可以分摊读，分片可以拆容量和写入压力。分片键要支持按 shortURL 快速定位映射。
why_en: Replication spreads reads, while sharding splits capacity and write load; the shard key must support shortURL lookup.
tradeoff: 扩展容量 vs 路由和运维复杂度
whenOtherWins: 早期数据量小的时候，单库加缓存可以先跑，避免过早分片。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据按某个键拆到多个数据库或节点上。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding splits data across multiple databases or nodes by a chosen key.

scenario: 用户访问 https://sho.rt/abc999，但数据库和缓存都找不到这个 shortURL。
scenario_en: A user visits https://sho.rt/abc999, but neither cache nor database has that shortURL.
q: 系统应该如何处理无效短码？
q_en: How should the system handle an invalid short code?
options: 返回 404 或业务化的无效链接页面
随机跳到首页
创建一个新 longURL
一直重试数据库直到成功
options_en: Return 404 or a product invalid-link page
Randomly redirect to the homepage
Create a new longURL
Retry the database forever
why: 找不到映射说明短码无效或已不可用。明确返回 404 能避免错误跳转和无限重试。
why_en: If no mapping exists, the code is invalid or unavailable, so a clear 404 avoids wrong redirects and retry loops.

scenario: 你把数字 ID 11157 转成 base62。base62 每次除以 62 取余，并把余数映射到 0-9、a-z、A-Z。
scenario_en: You convert numeric ID 11157 to base62 by repeated division by 62 and mapping remainders to 0-9, a-z, and A-Z.
q: base62 转换的本质是什么？
q_en: What is the essence of base62 conversion?
options: 把同一个整数换成 62 进制字符串表示
对 longURL 做不可逆加密
压缩 longURL 内容本身
查询数据库确认是否碰撞
options_en: Represent the same integer as a base-62 string
Irreversibly encrypt the long URL
Compress the long URL content itself
Query the database to confirm collision
why: base62 不是哈希 longURL，而是数字进制转换。只要输入 ID 唯一，输出短码也唯一。
why_en: Base62 is number-base conversion, not hashing the long URL; a unique input ID gives a unique code.
tradeoff: 短字符串编码 vs 发号器依赖
whenOtherWins: 如果没有全局唯一数字 ID，直接哈希 longURL 再处理碰撞更独立。
codeSample:
11157 / 62 = 179 remainder 59 -> X
179   / 62 = 2   remainder 55 -> T
2     / 62 = 0   remainder 2  -> 2
# read remainders backward: 2TX

q: 短链系统额外讨论扩展点有哪些？
q_en: What are useful extra scaling topics for a URL shortener?
options: 创建接口限流，防止垃圾短链
stateless Web 层水平扩展
数据库复制和分片
把所有 redirect 都改成同步跨机房事务
options_en: Rate limit creation to prevent spam links
Scale the stateless web tier horizontally
Use database replication and sharding
Turn every redirect into a synchronous cross-region transaction
why: 这些扩展点分别保护写入口、Web 吞吐和持久存储。redirect 读路径要快，通常不该每次做跨机房同步事务。
why_en: These topics protect the write entry point, web throughput, and storage scale; redirects should stay fast rather than run cross-region transactions.

q: URL shortener 的端到端设计链怎么讲？
q_en: How should you explain the end-to-end URL shortener design chain?
steps: 用估算得到写 QPS、读 QPS、存储量和短码长度
创建路径用唯一 ID 生成器加 base62 生成短码
持久表保存 shortURL 到 longURL，读路径加缓存
根据负载、分析和滥用需求补 301/302、限流、分片
why: 这条链从容量约束开始，再落到生成、存储、读取和运营扩展。它比直接画组件更像完整面试回答。
why_en: Start from capacity, then explain generation, storage, reads, and operational extensions for a complete interview answer.

scenario: 客户端创建短链请求超时后会重试。同一个 longURL 如果每次都生成新短码，会制造重复记录。
scenario_en: A client retries short-link creation after a timeout. If the same longURL creates a new code every time, duplicate rows accumulate.
q: 创建短链如何做幂等？
q_en: How can short-link creation be idempotent?
options: 先查 longURL，命中返回旧码
每次重试都生成新 ID
让客户端随机猜短码
忽略数据库唯一约束
options_en: Look up longURL and return existing code
Generate a new ID on every retry
Let the client guess a code
Ignore database uniqueness
why: 幂等创建让超时重试不会改变结果。通常需要 longURL 规范化和唯一索引配合，避免同义 URL 重复。
why_en: Idempotent creation makes retries return the same result, often using URL normalization and a unique index.
tradeoff: 去重一致性 vs 创建路径多一次查询
whenOtherWins: 如果产品允许同一 longURL 拥有多个 campaign 短链，就要把 campaign 或用户也放进幂等键。

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一请求重复执行多次，结果仍像执行一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotency means repeating the same request has the same effect as running it once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把等价 URL 统一成规范形式，比如处理大小写、默认端口或尾部斜杠。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: URL normalization converts equivalent URLs into a canonical form, such as handling case, default ports, or trailing slashes.

scenario: 用户希望自定义短码，比如 /sale。短码空间不再只由系统生成，可能和已有短码冲突。
scenario_en: Users want custom aliases such as /sale. The code space is no longer generated only by the system and may collide with existing codes.
q: custom alias 需要什么保护？
q_en: What protection does custom alias need?
options: shortURL 唯一约束加原子保留
相信前端按钮禁用
允许后写覆盖先写
只在缓存里检查一次
options_en: Unique shortURL plus atomic reservation
Trust disabled frontend buttons
Let later writes overwrite earlier ones
Check only once in cache
why: 自定义短码是共享命名空间。必须用数据库唯一约束或原子保留，前端检查挡不住并发创建。
why_en: Custom aliases share a namespace, so uniqueness must be enforced atomically in storage, not only by frontend checks.
tradeoff: 用户可读短码 vs 命名冲突处理
whenOtherWins: 如果不支持 custom alias，系统生成 ID+base62 可以让冲突处理简单很多。

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库保证某列或列组合不会出现重复值的约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A unique constraint makes the database reject duplicate values for a column or column set.

scenario: 产品新增临时短链，7 天后失效。失效后访问应显示过期页面，并且缓存不能长期返回旧 longURL。
scenario_en: Product adds temporary short links that expire after seven days. After expiry, visits should show an expired page, and cache must not keep returning the old longURL.
q: 过期短链要改哪些设计？
q_en: What design changes are needed for expiring links?
options: expiresAt 加缓存 TTL 配合
只改前端文案
继续永久 301 缓存
删除 longURL 列
options_en: expiresAt plus matching cache TTL
Change only frontend copy
Keep permanent 301 caching
Remove the longURL column
why: 过期是服务端状态，读路径必须检查。缓存 TTL 和 redirect 状态码也要配合，否则过期后客户端还可能直接跳转。
why_en: Expiry is server-side state, so reads must check it and cache TTL plus redirect status must not outlive the link.
tradeoff: 生命周期控制 vs 缓存效率
whenOtherWins: 永久不可变短链可以用更长缓存和 301 来减轻服务端流量。

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或缓存项的存活时间，到期后应失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the time-to-live after which cached or stored data should expire.

scenario: 短链可以随机生成 7 位码，也可以用唯一 ID 做 base62。两者都要保证 shortURL 不重复。
scenario_en: A shortener can generate random 7-character codes or convert unique IDs to base62. Both must avoid duplicate shortURLs.
q: 随机码和 ID+base62 的核心取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the core tradeoff between random codes and ID+base62?
options: 随机码不可预测但要碰撞重试；base62 可预测但天然唯一
随机码必须 128-bit；base62 不能落库
随机码只能读；base62 只能写
两者都不需要唯一约束
options_en: Random codes are less predictable but need collision retries; base62 is predictable but unique from the ID
Random codes must be 128-bit; base62 cannot be stored
Random codes are read-only; base62 is write-only
Neither needs uniqueness enforcement
why: 随机码对外更难猜，但容量接近上限时碰撞重试会变多。ID+base62 简单稳定，但连续 ID 会暴露增长趋势。
why_en: Random codes are harder to guess but need retries as space fills, while ID-based base62 is simple but more predictable.
tradeoff: 不可预测性 vs 生成确定性
whenOtherWins: 公开短码担心枚举时，随机码或加密映射比连续 ID 更合适。

scenario: 你用 MD5 后截取前 7 位当短码。两个不同 longURL 可能截出同一个 7 位字符串。
scenario_en: You hash long URLs with MD5 and take the first seven characters. Two different longURLs may produce the same seven-character code.
q: 发现 hash collision 时应怎么做？
q_en: What should happen when a hash collision is found?
options: 换盐或换输入再算，并再次检查 shortURL 唯一性
覆盖旧 longURL 映射
返回两个 longURL 给浏览器选择
假设碰撞不会发生
options_en: Change salt or input and hash again, then recheck shortURL uniqueness
Overwrite the old longURL mapping
Return both longURLs for the browser to choose
Assume collisions never happen
why: 短码空间有限，碰撞必须按存储唯一性处理。覆盖会让旧短链跳错目标，是严重数据损坏。
why_en: The short-code space is finite, so collisions must be resolved against storage uniqueness; overwriting would corrupt existing links.
tradeoff: 哈希独立性 vs 查重成本
whenOtherWins: ID+base62 把唯一性问题转给发号器，通常不需要递归加盐。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种哈希函数；在短链场景可产生摘要，但截断后仍可能碰撞。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MD5 is a hash function; in shorteners it can create a digest, but truncating it can still collide.

scenario: hash+碰撞方案每次创建都要查数据库确认短码是否已存在。数据库读压力开始影响创建延迟。
scenario_en: A hash-plus-collision scheme checks the database on every create to see whether the short code exists. Those reads are hurting latency.
q: Bloom filter 在这里能帮什么？
q_en: How can a Bloom filter help here?
options: 先过滤明显不存在的短码，减少数据库查重
保证永远没有碰撞
替代持久化映射表
把 longURL 压缩成 7 位
options_en: Filter clearly absent codes before database uniqueness checks
Guarantee collisions never happen
Replace the durable mapping table
Compress longURL into seven characters
why: Bloom filter 可以快速说“肯定没见过”，从而跳过部分数据库查重。它可能误报存在，所以仍需要数据库做最终唯一性裁判。
why_en: A Bloom filter can skip some database checks for definitely unseen codes, but storage still makes the final uniqueness decision.
tradeoff: 少查数据库 vs 误报导致额外重试
whenOtherWins: ID+base62 路线通常不需要这层查重优化。

termDefinitions.meaning: 空间很省的概率集合，能判断肯定不存在或可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a compact probabilistic set that reports definitely absent or maybe present.

scenario: 短链表现在只有 shortURL 和 longURL。产品要按创建时间做清理，并支持用户查看自己创建的链接。
scenario_en: The short-link table currently has only shortURL and longURL. Product wants cleanup by creation time and user-owned link lists.
q: schema 需要补哪些字段或索引？
q_en: What fields or indexes should the schema add?
options: 加 ownerId/createdAt 和对应索引
只保留 longURL 一个字段
删除 shortURL 运行时重算
塞进无索引 JSON 字符串
options_en: Add ownerId/createdAt and indexes
Keep only one longURL field
Delete shortURL and recompute
Use one unindexed JSON string
why: 核心跳转只要 shortURL→longURL，但运营功能需要额外访问路径。字段和索引要跟查询模式一起设计。
why_en: Redirect only needs shortURL-to-longURL, but operations and user pages need fields and indexes aligned with their query patterns.
tradeoff: 最小映射表 vs 产品查询能力
whenOtherWins: 纯匿名永久短链服务可以先只保留 id、shortURL、longURL。

scenario: 短链每次点击都要统计来源和时间。redirect 路径 P99 不能被分析写入拖慢。
scenario_en: Every click must be analyzed by source and time, but redirect P99 must not be slowed by analytics writes.
q: 点击分析应如何接入 redirect 路径？
q_en: How should click analytics attach to redirects?
options: redirect 快速返回，同时异步写点击事件到日志或队列
redirect 同步等待分析数据库写成功
把点击统计写进浏览器 cookie 就结束
为了分析关闭所有缓存
options_en: Return redirects quickly and asynchronously write click events to a log or queue
Wait synchronously for the analytics database write
Store analytics only in a browser cookie
Disable all cache for analytics
why: redirect 是用户面前的热路径。点击事件可以异步入队，分析系统慢了也不该挡跳转。
why_en: Redirect is a user-facing hot path, so click events should be queued asynchronously instead of blocking navigation.
tradeoff: 跳转延迟 vs 分析实时性
whenOtherWins: 少量企业后台链接可以同步写审计日志，换更强的记录保证。

termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 请求都不超过的延迟值，用来观察尾延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: P99 is the latency that 99% of requests are at or below, used to track tail latency.

scenario: 短链原本不可更新。现在企业用户可以修改目标 longURL。redirect 缓存里可能还存着旧映射。
scenario_en: Links used to be immutable. Now enterprise users can update the destination longURL, while redirect cache may still hold the old mapping.
q: 允许更新后最麻烦的是什么？
q_en: What becomes tricky when updates are allowed?
options: 缓存失效和 301 客户端缓存都可能保留旧目标
数据库不再能保存字符串
短码长度必须翻倍
base62 不能再使用
options_en: Cache invalidation and 301 client caching may preserve old targets
The database can no longer store strings
Short-code length must double
Base62 can no longer be used
why: 不可变短链让缓存策略很简单。允许更新后，服务端缓存和浏览器永久缓存都可能让用户继续跳旧地址。
why_en: Immutable links make caching simple; updatable links must handle server cache invalidation and clients that cached permanent redirects.
tradeoff: 可更新性 vs 缓存简单性
whenOtherWins: 如果业务能坚持不可更新，301 和长 TTL 缓存会更省流量。

scenario: 某个热门短链被新闻首页引用，几分钟内产生百万级点击。创建流量不高，但 redirect 暴涨。
scenario_en: A hot short link is referenced by a news homepage and receives millions of clicks in minutes. Creation traffic is low, but redirects spike.
q: 读多扩展优先保护哪条路径？
q_en: Which path should read-heavy scaling protect first?
options: redirect Web 层和映射缓存
创建短链 ID 生成器
后台过期清理任务
用户管理页分页
options_en: Redirect web tier and mapping cache
Creation ID generator
Background expiry cleanup
User-page pagination
why: 热点来自 redirect，不是创建。扩 Web 层和缓存命中能吸收点击洪峰，避免每次都查数据库。
why_en: The spike is on redirects, not creation, so scaling web servers and cache hits absorbs click traffic before the database.
tradeoff: 读路径弹性 vs 缓存容量
whenOtherWins: 如果瓶颈是批量创建营销链接，ID 生成器和写库才是优先扩展点。

scenario: 攻击者创建大量短链指向钓鱼网站。系统不仅有写入压力，还有安全和信誉风险。
scenario_en: An attacker creates many short links to phishing sites. The system has both write pressure and safety/reputation risk.
q: 反滥用除了限流还需要什么？
q_en: What anti-abuse work is needed beyond rate limiting?
options: 恶意 URL 检测、用户信誉和举报/封禁流程
把所有链接永久 301
删除缓存层
让短码按顺序更容易猜
options_en: Malicious-URL detection, user reputation, and report/block workflows
Make every link a permanent 301
Delete the cache layer
Make codes sequential and easier to guess
why: 限流只控制速度，不能判断目标是否恶意。短链服务会替坏链接隐藏原始域名，所以需要安全审核链路。
why_en: Rate limiting controls volume, not malicious destinations; a shortener hides original domains, so it needs abuse detection and blocking.
tradeoff: 开放创建体验 vs 平台信誉
whenOtherWins: 封闭企业内部短链可以减少公开反滥用投入，但仍要有审计。

termDefinitions.meaning: 诱导用户泄露账号、支付信息或下载恶意内容的欺诈行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Phishing is fraud that tricks users into revealing credentials, payment data, or downloading malicious content.

scenario: 短码字符集使用 0-9、a-z、A-Z。客服发现用户口头读码时大小写容易混淆。
scenario_en: Short codes use 0-9, a-z, and A-Z. Support finds users confuse case when reading codes aloud.
q: 字符集选择有什么取舍？
q_en: What is the tradeoff in choosing the character set?
options: base62 短，但大小写易混
字符越多永远无代价
只用数字容量无限大
大小写不影响系统
options_en: Base62 is short but case-confusing
More characters are always free
Digits only give infinite capacity
Case never affects systems
why: 容量公式是 alphabetSize^length。字符集越大，同容量所需长度越短；但可读性、输入错误和大小写处理会变难。
why_en: Capacity is alphabetSize to the length; larger alphabets shorten codes but can hurt readability and manual entry.
tradeoff: 短码长度 vs 人工可读性
whenOtherWins: 机器点击为主的短链更适合 base62；口播场景可能选去歧义字符集。

scenario: redirect 请求只有 shortURL。数据库表很大，如果 shortURL 没有索引，每次都要扫描映射表。
scenario_en: Redirect requests contain only shortURL. The table is huge; without an index on shortURL each lookup scans the mapping table.
q: redirect 表最关键的索引是什么？
q_en: What is the key index for redirects?
options: shortURL 唯一索引
longURL 全文索引
createdAt 单列索引作为唯一入口
ownerName 模糊索引
options_en: A unique index on shortURL
A full-text index on longURL
A createdAt-only index as the sole entry point
A fuzzy index on ownerName
why: redirect 的主查询是 shortURL 查 longURL。唯一索引既加速点查，也防止两个 longURL 占同一短码。
why_en: Redirect is a point lookup by shortURL, so a unique index both speeds reads and prevents code collisions.
tradeoff: 写入索引成本 vs 快速跳转
whenOtherWins: 后台按时间清理还需要 createdAt 索引，但它不能替代跳转索引。

q: hash 截断方案的碰撞处理链是什么？
q_en: What is the collision-handling chain for truncated hashes?
steps: 对 longURL 计算哈希并截取候选短码
查询 shortURL 唯一索引确认是否已占用
若占用，加入盐或改变输入重新计算
成功后插入映射并返回短链
why: 关键是存储唯一性必须参与闭环。只靠哈希函数本身，无法证明短码空间里没有碰撞。
why_en: The storage uniqueness check closes the loop; the hash function alone cannot prove a short code is unused.

termDefinitions.meaning: hash 把输入映射成固定长度指纹或编号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash maps input to a fixed-size fingerprint or number.

termDefinitions.meaning: shortURL 是短链系统暴露给用户访问的短码或短地址。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shortURL is the short code or address exposed to users by a URL shortener.

termDefinitions.meaning: unique index 是数据库保证某列值不重复的索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A unique index is a database index that enforces uniqueness for a column or key.

termDefinitions.meaning: collision 是两个不同输入生成了同一个短码或指纹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A collision happens when two different inputs produce the same code or fingerprint.

scenario: 创建短链会产生新资源，redirect 是读取已有短码并返回跳转。你用 REST 风格 API。
scenario_en: Creating a short link creates a new resource, while redirect reads an existing code and returns a redirect. You use REST-style APIs.
q: HTTP 方法怎么选更自然？
q_en: Which HTTP methods are natural here?
options: POST 创建短链；GET 访问短码跳转
GET 创建短链；POST 跳转
DELETE 创建短链；PATCH 跳转
PUT 所有请求都复用
options_en: POST creates the short link; GET visits the code and redirects
GET creates the short link; POST redirects
DELETE creates; PATCH redirects
PUT handles every request
why: 创建有副作用，POST 更合适。访问短码是读取资源并返回 redirect，浏览器天然用 GET。
why_en: Creation has side effects, so POST fits; visiting a short code is a GET that resolves to a redirect.
tradeoff: HTTP 语义清晰 vs 接口滥用风险
whenOtherWins: 如果客户端要指定完整资源 ID 并要求幂等替换，PUT 才可能合适。

termDefinitions.meaning: Web 客户端和服务器通信的应用层协议。

whenOtherWins: 如果规模很小且不能接受任何误判，普通 hash set 或数据库唯一约束更直观。

q: frontier 存储怎么折中？
q_en: What storage compromise fits the frontier?
options: 磁盘保存主体，内存缓冲读写
全部放应用进程内存并定期快照
关系库表保存全部 URL，并按状态索引扫描

options_en: Keep the main set on disk with memory buffers for reads and writes.

why: 主体落盘解决容量和恢复，内存 buffer 降低频繁入队出队的 I/O。代价是崩溃恢复要处理 buffer 刷盘边界。

tradeoff: 持久容量 vs 队列吞吐
whenOtherWins: 如果 frontier 只有几万 URL，内存队列加快照更简单。
