termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka 是持久化追加日志式消息系统，常用于事件流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a durable append-log messaging system often used for event streams.

optionMeanings: 磁盘保存完整 frontier，内存 buffer 承接热入队出队。
进程内存队列很快，但可靠性依赖快照。
关系库状态表用索引查询待抓 URL。
日志记录所有入队事件，状态表记录消费进度。
optionDirectness: 数亿 URL、既要吞吐也要恢复时更合适。
URL 规模小、丢少量进度可接受时更简单。
规模中等且团队更熟数据库运维时可用。
需要事件回放、审计和多消费者时更合适。
optionScenarioImpacts: 热路径少碰磁盘，崩溃后还能从主体恢复。
进程挂掉可能丢最近 buffer，容量也受内存限制。
频繁 enqueue/dequeue 会把数据库变成瓶颈。
能力强，但要维护日志压缩、状态一致性和重放。
optionMeanings_en: Keep the main set on disk with memory buffers for reads and writes.
Keep everything in process memory with periodic snapshots.
Store all URLs in a relational table and scan by status index.
Store enqueue events in Kafka or a log and maintain a consumable state table.
optionDirectness_en: Use when disk provides capacity and recovery, while memory buffers reduce queue I/O on the hot path.
Only fits when the goal is to keep everything in process memory with periodic snapshots.
Only fits when the goal is to store all URLs in a relational table and scan by status index.
Only fits when the goal is to store enqueue events in Kafka or a log and maintain a consumable state table.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It commits the design to this path: Keep the main set on disk with memory buffers for reads and writes.
It creates this risk here: Keep everything in process memory with periodic snapshots.
It commits the design to this assumption: Store all URLs in a relational table and scan by status index.
It commits the design to this assumption.

scenario: 下载线程经常要把域名解析成 IP；外部 DNS 查询可能 10-200ms，还会阻塞线程。
scenario_en: Downloader threads constantly resolve domains to IPs; external DNS calls may take 10-200 ms and block threads.
q: HTML 下载器先加什么优化？
q_en: What optimization should the HTML downloader add first?
options: 本地 DNS cache，定期刷新
每个 URL 都同步查公共 DNS
把 IP 写死在代码里
取消域名解析直接请求 URL
options_en: A local DNS cache refreshed periodically.
Synchronously query public DNS for every URL.
Hard-code IP addresses in code.
Skip resolution and request URLs directly.
why: DNS 查询在下载链路上很频繁，缓存域名到 IP 能少掉大量等待。代价是 TTL 到期和 IP 变化要靠后台刷新处理。
why_en: A local DNS cache removes repeated blocking lookups from the downloader hot path while requiring refresh logic.
tradeoff: 解析延迟 vs 地址新鲜度
whenOtherWins: 如果域名很少且变化强依赖权威 DNS，短 TTL 的实时查询更保守。

termDefinitions.meaning: Domain Name System，把域名解析成 IP 地址。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DNS maps domain names to IP addresses.

termDefinitions.meaning: Time To Live，缓存记录在过期前可复用的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is how long a cached record may be reused.

scenario: 你的爬虫准备访问一个新站点；站点可能声明哪些路径不允许被某些 crawler 抓取。
scenario_en: Your crawler is about to visit a new site; the site may declare which paths a crawler should not fetch.
q: 抓取前要先处理什么？
q_en: What should be handled before crawling?
options: 读取并缓存 robots.txt 规则
直接全站并发抓取
只看页面 title
先把所有链接写入索引
options_en: Fetch and cache robots.txt rules.
Crawl the whole site in parallel immediately.
Only inspect the page title.
Write all links to the index first.
why: robots.txt 是站点给 crawler 的访问规则，先读它能避免抓禁区。缓存可以少重复下载，但要定期刷新。
why_en: Read robots.txt before crawling a site so the crawler respects disallowed paths without refetching the file every time.
whenOtherWins: 如果站点是你自有服务且另有白名单协议，也可以用内部策略替代 robots.txt。

termDefinitions.meaning: Robots Exclusion Protocol 的常见文件名，用来声明 crawler 可抓和不可抓路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: robots.txt is the common Robots Exclusion Protocol file that tells crawlers which paths are allowed.

scenario: 下载后的 HTML 可能畸形、超大或带恶意结构；下载线程必须保持吞吐。
scenario_en: Downloaded HTML may be malformed, huge, or maliciously structured; downloader threads must keep throughput high.
q: 解析器为什么拆成独立组件？
q_en: Why split parsing into a separate component?
options: 隔离慢解析和坏页面，避免拖住下载链路
让 DNS 解析更准确
替代 URL frontier
减少 robots.txt 文件大小
options_en: To isolate slow parsing and bad pages from the download path.
To make DNS resolution more accurate.
To replace the URL frontier.
To reduce robots.txt size.
why: 解析是 CPU 和异常风险更高的阶段，拆出去能让下载器继续拉取页面。代价是多一次组件间传递和队列。
why_en: Parsing is CPU-heavy and failure-prone, so isolating it keeps downloaders focused on network throughput.
tradeoff: 下载吞吐 vs 管线复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果只是小规模脚本，下载后进程内解析更省事。

termDefinitions.meaning: HyperText Markup Language，网页结构标记语言。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTML is the markup language used to structure web pages.

scenario: 一个页面下载成功后，系统要决定是否存内容、是否抽取链接、以及哪些新 URL 进入待抓队列。
scenario_en: After a page is downloaded, the system must decide whether to store content, extract links, and enqueue new URLs.
q: 页面进入系统后的处理顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the processing order after a page enters the system?
steps: 过滤抽出的 URL，并检查 URL Seen
解析和校验 HTML
内容指纹查重，重复则丢弃
抽取链接并转成绝对 URL
新 URL 写入 frontier
why: 先保证页面可解析，再用内容去重避免重复存储；只有新内容才值得抽链接。最后再用 URL 去重保护 frontier。
why_en: Validate the page, dedupe the content, extract links, filter and dedupe URLs, then enqueue only new crawl targets.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Downloaded HTML] --> B[Parse and validate]
  B --> C[Content hash seen?]
  C -->|new| D[Extract links]
  D --> E[Filter URLs]
  E --> F[URL seen?]
  F -->|new| G[URL frontier]

termDefinitions.meaning: 包含协议和域名的完整 URL，便于后续下载器直接访问。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An absolute URL includes scheme and host so a downloader can fetch it directly.

scenario: 大规模爬虫会遇到坏 HTML、慢站点、服务器扩缩容和进程崩溃。
scenario_en: A large crawler sees malformed HTML, slow sites, server scaling events, and process crashes.
q: 哪些措施主要提升鲁棒性？
q_en: Which measures mainly improve robustness?
options: 保存 crawl state，失败后可恢复
异常处理和数据校验
consistent hashing 分散下载器负载
把所有页面永久放内存
options_en: Persist crawl state so failures can recover.
Use exception handling and data validation.
Use consistent hashing to spread downloader load.
Keep every page permanently in memory.
why: 恢复状态、校验输入和稳定分配负载，都是让系统在坏数据和节点变化下继续跑。全内存只会放大故障损失。
why_en: Persisted state, validation, and stable load distribution keep the crawler running through bad inputs and node changes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一致性哈希让节点增删时只迁移少量 key，常用于分摊负载。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing moves only a small portion of keys when nodes are added or removed.

scenario: 已抓页面会新增、修改和删除；但全量重抓几十亿 URL 会浪费下载预算。
scenario_en: Crawled pages can be added, edited, or deleted, but recrawling billions of URLs wastes crawl budget.
q: 怎么安排 freshness？
q_en: How should freshness be scheduled?
options: 按历史更新频率和重要性调度重抓
每天全量重抓所有 URL
永不重抓已见 URL
只重抓 URL 最短的页面
options_en: Schedule recrawls by update history and importance.
Recrawl every URL every day.
Never recrawl seen URLs.
Recrawl only the shortest URLs.
why: freshness 的约束是预算有限，所以高价值、常变化页面要更频繁。代价是要记录历史信号，低价值页面会更旧。
why_en: Freshness should spend crawl budget on important or frequently changing pages instead of recrawling everything equally.
tradeoff: 内容新鲜度 vs 抓取成本
whenOtherWins: 如果是合规归档且规模很小，固定周期全量重抓更容易解释。

termDefinitions.meaning: 索引内容接近真实网页当前状态的程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freshness is how closely indexed content matches the current web state.

scenario: 某站点不断生成 /foo/bar/foo/bar/... 这类越来越深的 URL，队列数量异常增长。
scenario_en: A site keeps generating deeper URLs such as /foo/bar/foo/bar/..., and its queue count grows abnormally.
q: 先怎么防 spider trap？
q_en: How should you first guard against a spider trap?
options: 限制 URL 长度/深度，并对异常站点加定制过滤
提高该站点优先级
关闭 URL Seen
把所有路径都存 5 年
options_en: Limit URL length or depth and add custom filters for abnormal sites.
Raise that site's priority.
Disable URL Seen.
Store every path for five years.
why: 无限路径会吃掉 frontier 和下载预算，先用长度/深度挡住明显陷阱。没有万能自动识别法，异常站点常要人工确认后加规则。
why_en: Spider traps consume the frontier, so cap obvious path growth and add site-specific filters after confirming abnormal behavior.
whenOtherWins: 如果这个深路径是业务必须抓的合法目录，要用白名单放行并单独限速。

termDefinitions.meaning: 会让 crawler 陷入无限或近似无限链接空间的页面模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A spider trap is a page pattern that sends a crawler into an infinite or near-infinite link space.

scenario: 很多网页靠 JavaScript 运行后才生成链接；直接下载原始 HTML 时看不到这些链接。
scenario_en: Many pages generate links only after JavaScript runs; raw HTML downloads do not reveal those links.
q: 要补哪条能力？
q_en: What capability should be added?
options: 动态渲染后再解析链接
只增加 DNS cache
只扩大 Bloom filter
禁止抓取含脚本页面
options_en: Render dynamically before parsing links.
Only add a DNS cache.
Only enlarge the Bloom filter.
Ban pages that contain scripts.
why: 问题不在下载速度，而在链接要运行脚本后才出现。渲染成本高，所以通常只给需要它的页面走这条路径。
why_en: If links appear only after JavaScript runs, render the page before extraction, but reserve that costly path for pages that need it.
tradeoff: 链接完整性 vs 渲染成本
whenOtherWins: 如果目标站点主要是静态 HTML，直接解析更便宜。

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器执行的脚本语言，常用来动态生成页面内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: JavaScript is a browser-executed language often used to generate page content dynamically.

scenario: 你要启动全网搜索爬虫，手里不能只有一个首页；希望尽快覆盖不同地区和主题。
scenario_en: You are bootstrapping a web-scale crawler and cannot start from a single homepage; you want early coverage across regions and topics.
q: seed URL 怎么选更稳？
q_en: How should seed URLs be chosen?
options: 只选一个最热门网站首页
按地区和主题分桶，各桶放高质量入口
随机生成域名直到能访问
只从广告链接开始
options_en: Pick one very popular home page only.
Bucket by region and topic, with high-quality entry URLs per bucket.
Generate random domains until they work.
Start only from advertisement links.
why: 种子 URL 决定早期覆盖面，按地区和主题分桶能减少偏向单一站点。代价是维护入口清单和质量评分。
why_en: Seed URLs shape early coverage, so bucket them by region and topic instead of relying on one starting point.
tradeoff: 覆盖多样性 vs 种子维护成本
whenOtherWins: 如果只抓一个公司站点，根域名和 sitemap 就是更简单的种子。

termDefinitions.meaning: 爬虫开始遍历时放入 frontier 的初始 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A seed URL is an initial URL placed into the crawl frontier.

scenario: 你只需要抓某大学站点，不做全网索引；目标是覆盖该域名下的公开页面。
scenario_en: You only need to crawl one university site, not the whole web; the goal is public pages under that domain.
q: 这种范围下 seed 该怎么简化？
q_en: How can seeds be simplified for this scope?
options: 使用大学根域名和 sitemap 作为入口
继续按全球国家分桶
从随机社交媒体链接开始
只抓外链最多的商业站点
options_en: Use the university root domain and sitemap as entries.
Still bucket by every country worldwide.
Start from random social-media links.
Crawl the commercial site with the most backlinks.
why: 范围变成单站点时，根域名和 sitemap 已经给出高质量入口。全网分桶会增加无关抓取。
why_en: For a single-domain crawl, the root domain and sitemap give focused high-quality entry points.
tradeoff: 范围聚焦 vs 全网覆盖
whenOtherWins: 如果目标回到全网索引，单域名 seed 会严重偏窄。

termDefinitions.meaning: 网站提供的 URL 清单，帮助搜索引擎发现可抓页面。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sitemap is a site-provided URL list that helps crawlers discover pages.

scenario: 同一页面可能出现 http/https、大小写、尾斜杠、跟踪参数等多个 URL 形式。
scenario_en: The same page may appear with http/https, casing, trailing slash, or tracking parameters.
q: URL Seen 前应先做什么？
q_en: What should happen before URL Seen?
options: 直接把原始字符串入库
先做规范化，再查重
只比较页面标题
只保留 query string
options_en: Store the raw string directly.
Canonicalize first, then dedupe.
Compare only page titles.
Keep only the query string.
why: 不规范化会让同一资源绕过去重，造成重复抓取。代价是规则要小心，不能误删有业务含义的参数。
why_en: Canonicalization prevents duplicate crawl work caused by different URL spellings for the same resource.
tradeoff: 去重效果 vs 误合并风险
whenOtherWins: 如果站点明确把参数作为核心内容标识，规范化规则要按站点定制。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把等价 URL 转成统一形式，便于比较和去重。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Canonicalization converts equivalent URLs into one normalized form for comparison.

scenario: HTML 里抽出的链接常是 /wiki/A 这类相对路径；下载器后续需要完整地址。
scenario_en: Links extracted from HTML are often relative paths such as /wiki/A; the downloader later needs full addresses.
q: link extractor 还要做哪步？
q_en: What else should the link extractor do?
options: 把相对 URL 转成绝对 URL
把所有链接改成同一个 host
删除协议和域名
把 HTML 存进 DNS cache
options_en: Convert relative URLs to absolute URLs.
Rewrite all links to the same host.
Remove scheme and domain.
Store HTML in the DNS cache.
why: frontier 需要可直接下载的地址，所以相对路径要结合当前页面 base URL 补全。否则后续组件不知道目标 host。
why_en: The frontier needs fetchable URLs, so relative links must be resolved against the current page base URL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不包含完整协议和主机名、依赖当前页面上下文解释的 URL。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A relative URL lacks full scheme and host and must be resolved against the current page.

scenario: 爬虫只收 HTML；PDF、图片、错误链接和黑名单站点都不该进入下载队列。
scenario_en: The crawler only collects HTML; PDFs, images, broken links, and blacklisted sites should not enter the download queue.
q: URL filter 放在哪更合适？
q_en: Where should the URL filter sit?
options: 下载前，在抽链后、URL Seen 前过滤
内容存储五年后再过滤
DNS 解析完成后只过滤 IP
完全交给浏览器渲染器
options_en: Before download, after extraction and before URL Seen.
Filter only after five years in content storage.
Filter only IPs after DNS resolution.
Leave it entirely to the browser renderer.
why: 越早过滤，越少污染 frontier 和 URL Seen。把垃圾 URL 先入队会浪费下载器和去重存储。
why_en: Filter unwanted URLs before enqueueing so the frontier and dedupe store stay clean.
whenOtherWins: 如果过滤规则依赖下载后的内容特征，就要在 parser 后再做第二层内容过滤。

termDefinitions.meaning: 明确禁止访问或处理的站点、路径或模式集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A blacklist is a set of sites, paths, or patterns that should be blocked.

tradeoff: 早过滤节省资源 vs 规则误杀风险

scenario: 同一站点 robots.txt 允许抓取，但站点也要求 crawler 不要短时间连续请求。
scenario_en: A site allows crawling in robots.txt but still expects crawlers not to send rapid repeated requests.
q: robots 和 rate limit 的关系是什么？
q_en: How do robots and rate limiting relate?
options: robots 说明可抓范围，rate limit 控制抓取节奏
robots 能自动限制每秒连接数
rate limit 可以忽略 robots 禁止路径
二者都只用于内容去重
options_en: robots defines allowed scope, while rate limiting controls pacing.
robots automatically limits connections per second.
Rate limiting can ignore disallowed robots paths.
Both are only for content deduplication.
why: robots 解决能不能抓，礼貌限速解决抓多快。两者都要有，少一个都会伤害站点或合规性。
why_en: robots controls permission, while rate limiting controls pace; a polite crawler needs both.
whenOtherWins: 如果站点通过 Crawl-delay 明确给出节奏，可以把该值并入 per-host rate limit。

termDefinitions.meaning: 某些 robots 规则里声明的请求间隔提示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Crawl-delay is a robots directive hinting how long a crawler should wait between requests.

tradeoff: 抓取权限边界 vs 请求节奏控制

scenario: DNS cache 里的 IP 过旧，某域名已经迁移；下载器持续连接失败。
scenario_en: The DNS cache has a stale IP after a domain moved, and downloaders keep failing to connect.
q: DNS cache 需要什么保护？
q_en: What guard does a DNS cache need?
options: TTL 过期刷新，并在连接失败时触发重新解析
永远不刷新缓存
失败时把 URL 标记为重复内容
把所有域名解析到同一 IP
options_en: Refresh on TTL expiry and re-resolve on connection failures.
Never refresh cached records.
Mark the URL as duplicate content on failure.
Resolve every domain to the same IP.
why: DNS cache 是性能优化，不是永久真相。TTL 和失败重解析能在速度和正确性之间折中。
why_en: A DNS cache is an optimization, so TTL and failure-triggered refresh balance speed with correctness.
tradeoff: 解析速度 vs 地址正确性
whenOtherWins: 如果域名极少且变化频繁，可以缩短 TTL，接受更多 DNS 查询。

termDefinitions.meaning: Internet Protocol 地址，网络中定位主机的地址。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An IP address identifies a host on a network.

scenario: 单机下载器达不到峰值吞吐；URL 空间很大，机器也要能横向增加。
scenario_en: One downloader machine cannot meet peak throughput; the URL space is huge and machines must be added horizontally.
q: 分布式 crawler 怎么分工？
q_en: How should a distributed crawler divide work?
options: 按 URL/host 分片，把不同分片交给不同下载器
所有机器重复抓同一批 URL
只扩数据库，不扩下载器
让每台机器随机抢全网且不去重
options_en: Shard by URL or host and assign shards to downloaders.
Make every machine crawl the same URLs repeatedly.
Scale only the database, not downloaders.
Let every machine randomly grab the whole web with no dedupe.
why: 分片让下载任务可水平扩展，也减少重复抓取。代价是分片迁移和热点 host 需要额外均衡。
why_en: Sharding the URL space lets download work scale horizontally while reducing duplicate effort.
tradeoff: 水平扩展 vs 分片均衡成本
whenOtherWins: 小型一次性爬虫可以先用单机队列，避免分布式协调。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据或任务按规则切成多个分区，每个分区由不同节点处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shard is a partition of data or work handled by a subset of nodes.

scenario: 下载器集群经常增删机器；你不希望每次扩容都重新分配几乎所有 host。
scenario_en: Downloader machines are added and removed often; you do not want nearly every host reassigned on each change.
q: host 到下载器的映射用什么？
q_en: What should map hosts to downloaders?
options: consistent hashing
按当前秒数取模
手写固定机器列表
随机数每次重算
options_en: Consistent hashing.
Modulo by current second.
A hard-coded machine list.
Recompute random assignment every time.
why: 一致性哈希让节点变化时只迁移相邻一小段 key，扩缩容更平滑。代价是还要处理虚拟节点和热点。
why_en: Consistent hashing limits remapping when downloader nodes change, which makes scaling smoother.
whenOtherWins: 如果节点集合固定且很小，简单 hash modulo 也够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一致性哈希把节点和 key 放到环上，节点变化时只影响部分 key。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing places nodes and keys on a ring so membership changes move only part of the keys.

tradeoff: 按 host 固定调度 vs 全局负载均衡灵活性

scenario: 下载某 URL 时服务器超时；这个 URL 可能稍后恢复，但一直重试会占满 worker。
scenario_en: Fetching a URL times out; it may recover later, but retrying forever can occupy workers.
q: 失败重试怎么设计？
q_en: How should fetch retry be designed?
options: 有限次数加 backoff，失败状态持久化后以后再调度
无限 tight loop 重试
立即把 host 永久拉黑
丢弃所有同域名 URL
options_en: Use bounded retries with backoff, persist failure state, and reschedule later.
Retry forever in a tight loop.
Immediately blacklist the host forever.
Drop every URL from the same domain.
why: 短超时保护 worker，backoff 避免打爆慢站点。持久化失败状态能让系统恢复后继续处理。
why_en: Bounded backoff protects workers and slow sites while persistent failure state allows later recovery.
whenOtherWins: 如果明确是 404 这类永久失败，可以直接记录终态，不必重试。

termDefinitions.meaning: 失败后逐步拉长重试间隔，避免持续压垮下游。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backoff increases retry delay after failures to avoid hammering a dependency.

scenario: HTML 原文有 PB 级，少量热门页面会频繁被解析或查询。
scenario_en: Raw HTML is PB-scale, while a small set of popular pages is frequently parsed or queried.
q: 内容存储怎么选？
q_en: How should content storage be shaped?
options: 大部分落盘/对象存储，热门内容进内存缓存
全部进内存
全部放 DNS cache
只存 URL 不存内容
options_en: Store most content on disk/object storage and cache hot content in memory.
Put everything in memory.
Put everything in the DNS cache.
Store only URLs and no content.
why: PB 级内容必须依赖便宜持久存储，内存只服务热点。这样成本可控，但冷数据读取会慢一些。
why_en: PB-scale content belongs on durable storage, with memory reserved for hot pages.
tradeoff: 存储成本 vs 热点延迟
whenOtherWins: 如果系统只做实时监控不保留原文，内容存储可以更短 TTL。

termDefinitions.meaning: 面向大对象的持久存储，常用于图片、HTML 快照和备份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Object storage is durable storage for large objects such as images, HTML snapshots, and backups.

scenario: parser 收到畸形 HTML，可能抛异常或解析出异常多链接。
scenario_en: The parser receives malformed HTML that may throw errors or produce an abnormal number of links.
q: parser 层要有哪些防护？
q_en: What guards should the parser have?
options: 异常捕获、大小限制、链接数量上限和数据校验
把异常直接传给下载线程崩溃
信任所有 HTML
只校验 DNS 结果
options_en: Exception handling, size limits, link-count caps, and validation.
Let exceptions crash downloader threads.
Trust all HTML.
Validate only DNS results.
why: Web 输入不可信，parser 要把坏页面关在本组件内。限制大小和链接数也能挡部分陷阱页面。
why_en: Parser boundaries should contain malformed web input with validation and resource limits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制单个任务可消耗的 CPU、内存、大小或输出数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A resource limit caps CPU, memory, size, or output count for one task.

scenario: 高 PageRank 页面持续进入 frontier；如果只抓最高优先级，低优先级页面永远没机会。
scenario_en: High-PageRank pages keep entering the frontier; if you always fetch the top priority, low-priority pages may never run.
q: queue selector 怎么避免饥饿？
q_en: How can the queue selector avoid starvation?
options: 按权重随机选择队列，并给低优先级保留小概率
永远只选最高优先级队列
完全无视优先级
把低优先级 URL 删除
options_en: Sample queues by weight while reserving some probability for low priority.
Always choose only the highest-priority queue.
Ignore priority entirely.
Delete low-priority URLs.
why: 权重选择能偏向重要页面，又不会让长尾永久饥饿。代价是高优先级页面的抓取速度略受影响。
why_en: Weighted sampling favors important pages without starving the long tail.
tradeoff: 重要性优先 vs 长尾覆盖
whenOtherWins: 如果任务是只抓 Top N 站点，严格最高优先级可能符合目标。

termDefinitions.meaning: 低优先级任务长期得不到执行机会。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Starvation means low-priority work waits indefinitely.

scenario: 一个新闻首页每小时变化，某个老博客三年没更新；全量同频重抓太浪费。
scenario_en: A news homepage changes hourly, while an old blog has not changed for years; recrawling both equally wastes budget.
q: recrawl 间隔怎么定？
q_en: How should recrawl intervals be chosen?
options: 根据历史变化频率动态调整
所有页面每分钟重抓
所有页面永不重抓
只按 URL 字母顺序
options_en: Adjust by historical change frequency.
Recrawl every page every minute.
Never recrawl any page.
Use URL alphabetical order only.
why: 变化快的页面需要更短间隔，稳定页面可以慢一点。这个策略把 freshness 预算花在更可能变的地方。
why_en: Use historical change rate to spend freshness budget where pages are likely to change.
whenOtherWins: 如果法规要求固定归档周期，业务规则会覆盖动态间隔。

termDefinitions.meaning: 对已经抓过的 URL 再次抓取，用来刷新索引内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recrawl means fetching an already-seen URL again to refresh indexed content.

tradeoff: 页面新鲜度 vs 重抓预算

scenario: 页面里有广告、隐藏 spam 链接和低价值代码片段；索引容量有限。
scenario_en: Pages contain ads, hidden spam links, and low-value code snippets; index capacity is limited.
q: 噪声内容怎么处理？
q_en: How should noisy content be handled?
options: 在解析后加内容质量/anti-spam 过滤
全部当成同等高质量内容
只靠 DNS cache 过滤
把广告链接优先抓取
options_en: Add content-quality or anti-spam filtering after parsing.
Treat everything as equally high quality.
Filter only through DNS cache.
Prioritize ad links.
why: 抓到不代表值得索引，质量过滤能保护存储和搜索结果。代价是误杀风险，需要可调规则和样本评估。
why_en: Quality filtering protects storage and search relevance, but it needs tuning to avoid false drops.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标是法律取证式全量归档，过滤要更保守，可能只打标签不删除。

termDefinitions.meaning: 识别和压低垃圾或欺骗性内容的过滤机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Anti-spam mechanisms detect and reduce low-quality or deceptive content.

scenario: 某站点导航链接由 AJAX 请求后渲染；普通 HTML downloader 只能拿到空壳页面。
scenario_en: A site renders navigation links after AJAX calls; a plain HTML downloader gets only a shell page.
q: 动态页面的抓取管线怎么改？
q_en: How should the crawl pipeline change for dynamic pages?
options: 先 headless render 再抽链
增加 URL Seen 容量即可
只改 consistent hashing
跳过 parser 直接入库
options_en: Render headlessly before link extraction.
Only increase URL Seen capacity.
Only change consistent hashing.
Skip parsing and store directly.
why: 链接生成依赖脚本执行时，必须先渲染出 DOM。渲染贵，所以要按站点或页面特征选择性启用。
why_en: When links require script execution, render the DOM first, but use this expensive path selectively.
tradeoff: 动态链接覆盖 vs 渲染成本
whenOtherWins: 静态站点不需要 headless browser，直接解析 HTML 更便宜。

termDefinitions.meaning: Asynchronous JavaScript and XML，网页异步向服务器取数据的模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AJAX is a browser pattern for asynchronously fetching data from a server.

termDefinitions.meaning: Document Object Model，浏览器解析后形成的页面对象树。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The DOM is the page object tree created by the browser.

scenario: link extractor 产生新 URL 的速度超过 downloader 消费速度，frontier 持续膨胀。
scenario_en: The link extractor produces new URLs faster than downloaders consume them, and the frontier keeps growing.
q: 系统需要什么背压？
q_en: What backpressure does the system need?
options: 限制入队速率或丢弃低优先级 URL
无限扩内存队列
关闭所有去重
让 parser 同步等待 DNS
options_en: Throttle enqueue rate or drop low-priority URLs.
Grow the in-memory queue without bound.
Disable all deduplication.
Make the parser synchronously wait for DNS.
why: frontier 是缓冲，不是无限垃圾桶。背压能保护内存和磁盘，通常先牺牲低价值 URL。
why_en: The frontier is a buffer, not an infinite sink, so backpressure protects storage by slowing or shedding low-value URLs.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是短暂峰值且磁盘容量充足，可以先扩大持久队列吸收。

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时，向上游减速或拒绝更多输入的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure slows or rejects upstream input when downstream cannot keep up.

scenario: URL Seen 的内存结构重启后丢失；系统恢复时可能把大量已抓 URL 重新入队。
scenario_en: The in-memory URL Seen structure is lost on restart; recovery may enqueue many already-crawled URLs again.
q: URL Seen 为什么还要持久层？
q_en: Why does URL Seen need a persistent layer?
options: 恢复已访问状态，避免重启后重复抓取
让 Bloom filter 没有误判
替代 HTML storage
提升 DNS 权威性
options_en: Recover visited state and avoid duplicate crawling after restart.
Make Bloom filters have no false positives.
Replace HTML storage.
Improve DNS authority.
why: 内存过滤器服务热路径，持久 URL store 服务恢复和审计。两层职责不同，不能只靠内存。
why_en: The in-memory filter serves the hot path, while persistent URL storage supports recovery and auditing.
whenOtherWins: 极小临时爬虫可以接受重启后从头来，持久层可省。

termDefinitions.meaning: 进程重启或机器故障后仍保留数据的存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A persistent store keeps data after process restarts or machine failures.

tradeoff: 热路径速度 vs 重启恢复能力

scenario: 爬虫上线后要调优 freshness、礼貌性和失败恢复，而不是只看抓了多少页。
scenario_en: After launch, a crawler must tune freshness, politeness, and recovery, not only count fetched pages.
q: 哪些指标最该监控？
q_en: Which metrics matter most?
options: 核心 crawler 健康指标
员工人数和办公室温度
模板点击率
聊天未读数
options_en: Core crawler health metrics.
Headcount and office temperature.
Template click rate.
Chat unread count.
why: 这些指标分别对应站点压力、积压、稳定性、浪费和索引质量。只有下载总数会掩盖系统是否健康。
why_en: These metrics map to site pressure, backlog, reliability, wasted work, and index quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: frontier 中等待处理的 URL 数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Frontier depth is the number of URLs waiting in the frontier.

scenario: 你要把新发现 URL 放进一个既讲优先级又讲礼貌性的 frontier。
scenario_en: You need to put newly discovered URLs into a frontier that handles both priority and politeness.
q: frontier 入队到出队的关键顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the key frontier path from enqueue to dequeue?
steps: queue selector 按权重选择 front queue
URL 规范化、过滤和 URL Seen 去重
queue router 按 host 放入 back queue
prioritizer 计算 URL 分数
worker 从 host back queue 按限速下载
why: 先清洗和去重，再决定价值；出队时还要按 host 控制节奏。这样 priority 和 politeness 不互相替代。
why_en: Clean and dedupe first, score priority next, then route by host so priority and politeness both hold.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Normalize and dedupe] --> B[Prioritizer]
  B --> C[Front queues]
  C --> D[Host router]
  D --> E[Back queues]
  E --> F[Rate-limited workers]

scenario: 平均页面 500 KB，每月新增 10 亿页面；你要给存储团队一个月增量量级。
scenario_en: Average page size is 500 KB and the crawler adds 1 billion pages per month; you need a monthly storage order of magnitude.
q: 月增量存储怎么算？
q_en: How do you calculate monthly storage growth?
text: 月增量约 {{1B * 500 KB = 500 TB}}；这个数决定对象存储、分片数和压缩策略。
text_en: Monthly growth is about {{1B * 500 KB = 500 TB}}; it drives object storage, shard count, and compression strategy.
why: 这是设计输入，不是要背数字。它告诉你内存缓存只能放热点，长期原文必须进入便宜持久存储。
why_en: The number is a design input: hot pages may be cached, but long-term raw content needs cheap durable storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: Terabyte，约 1000 GB 的存储单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A terabyte is a storage unit of about one thousand gigabytes.

scenario: 系统每天发送 1000 万 push、100 万 SMS、500 万 email，允许高峰时轻微延迟。
scenario_en: The system sends 10M push, 1M SMS, and 5M emails per day, with slight delay allowed under peak load.
q: 这个吞吐对架构意味着什么？
q_en: What does this throughput imply for architecture?
text: 总量约 {{16M/day}}，平均约 {{185 notifications/s}}；它是 worker 数、队列容量和第三方限流配置的基数。
text_en: The total is about {{16M/day}}, around {{185 notifications/s}} on average; it feeds worker count, queue capacity, and provider rate limits.
why: 平均值不高，但通知有活动尖峰，所以不能用同步单机硬发。队列吸收突发，worker 按通道水平扩容。
why_en: The average rate is modest, but campaign bursts require queues and horizontally scaled workers rather than synchronous sending.

termDefinitions.meaning: Short Message Service，手机短信通道。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SMS means Short Message Service, the phone text-message channel.

scenario: 一个通知系统同时发 push、SMS 和 email；某个 SMS 供应商宕机时，不希望 push 和 email 也堵住。
scenario_en: A notification system sends push, SMS, and email; if the SMS provider is down, push and email should keep flowing.
q: 队列怎么拆？
q_en: How should the queues be split?
options: 每种通知类型独立队列和 worker
所有通知共用一个 FIFO 队列
绕过队列同步调用供应商
按用户姓名首字母分队列
options_en: Use a separate queue and worker pool per notification type.
Use one FIFO queue for all notifications.
Synchronously call providers without queues.
Partition queues by the first letter of user names.
why: 通道隔离能把 SMS 故障限制在 SMS 队列里。代价是每个通道都要单独监控积压和重试。
why_en: Separate queues isolate one provider's outage from other channels, while requiring per-channel monitoring and retry policy.
tradeoff: 故障隔离 vs 运维组件数
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一种通知且量很小，单队列更简单。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  API[Notification API] --> PushQ[Push queue]
  API --> SMSQ[SMS queue]
  API --> EmailQ[Email queue]
  PushQ --> PW[Push workers]
  SMSQ --> SW[SMS workers]
  EmailQ --> EW[Email workers]

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列取任务并执行发送动作的后台进程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A worker is a background process that pulls jobs from a queue and performs delivery.

scenario: 业务允许通知晚到，但不允许支付提醒这类通知在系统故障后直接丢失。
scenario_en: The business allows notification delay, but payment reminders must not disappear after system failures.
q: 防丢失先加什么？
q_en: What should be added first to prevent loss?
options: 通知日志持久化，再由队列/worker 重试
只把事件放内存队列
失败后让客户端自己猜
关闭第三方回调
options_en: Persist a notification log, then retry through queues and workers.
Keep events only in an in-memory queue.
Let clients guess after failure.
Disable provider callbacks.
why: 可靠性的底线是先把要发什么落库，worker 失败后还能重建任务。代价是要处理重复发送和日志清理。
why_en: Persist the notification intent before delivery so failed workers can retry without losing the message.
whenOtherWins: 如果是低价值营销实验，允许丢弃时可以用更轻的 best-effort 管线。

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存待发送或已发送通知事件的持久记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A notification log is a durable record of notification events to send or already sent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 尽力而为语义，系统尝试发送但不保证成功。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Best-effort means the system tries but does not guarantee delivery.

scenario: worker 超时后重试，第三方也可能返回不确定结果；同一个事件可能被处理两次。
scenario_en: A worker retries after timeout, and provider results may be ambiguous; the same event may be processed twice.
q: 怎么降低重复通知？
q_en: How do you reduce duplicate notifications?
options: 用 event_id 做幂等去重，见过就丢弃
承诺分布式 exactly once
把重试次数设为无限
改用更长模板文案
options_en: Use event_id for idempotent dedupe and discard seen events.
Promise distributed exactly-once delivery.
Retry forever.
Use longer template copy.
why: 分布式发送很难保证真正 exactly once，所以要用事件 ID 把重试变成幂等。代价是去重窗口和存储也要设计。
why_en: In distributed delivery, use an event ID for idempotency instead of promising true exactly-once semantics.
tradeoff: 不丢失重试 vs 重复抑制
whenOtherWins: 如果供应商提供强幂等 key，也应把本地 event_id 映射到供应商 key。

termDefinitions.meaning: 通知事件的唯一标识，用来判断同一事件是否已处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An event_id uniquely identifies a notification event for deduplication.

termDefinitions.meaning: 幂等表示同一操作重复执行，最终效果仍像执行一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means repeating the same operation has the same final effect as doing it once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 精确一次语义，表示既不丢也不重复；跨系统发送通常很难严格保证。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exactly once means no loss and no duplicates, which is very hard across distributed systems.

scenario: 用户可以按 push/email/SMS 选择退订；系统准备发送前已拿到用户 ID 和通道。
scenario_en: Users can opt out per push, email, or SMS channel; the system has the user ID and channel before sending.
q: 设置检查放在哪里？
q_en: Where should the settings check happen?
options: 发送前查 settings
只在客户端下载时检查
交给第三方服务决定
发送失败后再检查
options_en: Check settings before sending.
Check only in the client at download time.
Let the third-party provider decide.
Check only after delivery fails.
why: 退订是发送前约束，越早过滤越少浪费队列和供应商额度。代价是设置缓存要避免过期太久。
why_en: Opt-out is a pre-send constraint, so checking it early saves queue capacity and provider quota.
whenOtherWins: 如果设置要求强实时生效，就要缩短缓存 TTL 或在发送前读主库。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户明确选择不接收某类通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Opt-out means the user has chosen not to receive a notification type.

termDefinitions.meaning: Time To Live，缓存条目可被复用的时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the lifetime of a cached entry.

tradeoff: 发送前过滤 vs 每次读取设置的成本

scenario: 每天有大量相似通知，只是商品名、日期、链接和样式参数不同。
scenario_en: Millions of notifications share the same shape, with only item name, date, link, and style parameters changing.
q: 为什么要引入模板？
q_en: Why introduce templates?
options: 复用格式并减少人工拼接错误
让所有通知绕过设置检查
替代消息队列
保证第三方永不失败
options_en: Reuse format and reduce manual composition errors.
Bypass all settings checks.
Replace message queues.
Guarantee providers never fail.
why: 模板把稳定文案和变量分开，批量发送时更容易保持一致。代价是模板版本、审核和回滚要纳入流程。
why_en: Templates separate stable copy from variables, making high-volume notification creation more consistent.
whenOtherWins: 如果通知完全一次性且量很小，直接拼一条消息更快。

termDefinitions.meaning: 预先定义的通知骨架，发送时填入变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A template is a predefined notification body filled with variables at send time.

tradeoff: 模板复用和审核 vs 模板管理成本

scenario: 营销服务可能连续触发很多消息；用户收到太多会关闭整个 App 的通知权限。
scenario_en: A marketing service may trigger many messages in a row; too many notifications may make users disable the app entirely.
q: 该加什么保护？
q_en: What protection should be added?
options: 按用户和通道做 frequency cap
无限提高 worker 数
把所有消息改成 push
只监控 CPU
options_en: Add a per-user and per-channel frequency cap.
Keep increasing worker count.
Convert every message to push.
Monitor only CPU.
why: 这里的瓶颈不是 worker，而是用户注意力和退订风险。限频会牺牲部分触达，但保护长期可用性。
why_en: Rate limiting protects user attention and long-term opt-in, even though some sends will be delayed or dropped.
tradeoff: 触达量 vs 用户疲劳
whenOtherWins: 如果是安全验证码或交易提醒，限频规则要更宽或走高优先级通道。

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制某用户在某时间窗口内最多收到多少通知。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A frequency cap limits how many notifications a user can receive in a time window.

scenario: 产品要进入一个 APNS/FCM 或某短信供应商不可用的新市场，还要快速切换替代供应商。
scenario_en: The product enters a market where APNS/FCM or an SMS provider may be unavailable, and provider switching must be quick.
q: 第三方集成怎么设计？
q_en: How should third-party integration be designed?
options: 按通道抽象 provider adapter，可插拔替换
业务代码里到处直接调用供应商 SDK
只支持一个全球供应商
让客户端直接拿 appSecret 调供应商
options_en: Use pluggable provider adapters per channel.
Call provider SDKs directly throughout business code.
Support only one global provider.
Let clients call providers with appSecret.
why: 供应商可用性会随地区变化，adapter 能把切换限制在通道实现里。代价是要抽象最小公共能力和错误码。
why_en: Provider adapters localize market-specific provider changes behind a channel interface.
tradeoff: 可替换性 vs 抽象成本
whenOtherWins: 如果只服务单一地区且供应商长期稳定，直接集成可先上线。

termDefinitions.meaning: Apple Push Notification Service，Apple 的 iOS 推送服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: APNS is Apple's push notification service for iOS devices.

termDefinitions.meaning: Firebase Cloud Messaging，常用于 Android 推送。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FCM is Firebase Cloud Messaging, commonly used for Android push.

termDefinitions.meaning: Software Development Kit，供应商提供的开发工具包。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SDK is a vendor-provided Software Development Kit.

scenario: 同一个用户可能有手机、平板和桌面端；push 需要定位到具体设备。
scenario_en: One user may have a phone, tablet, and desktop; push delivery must target concrete devices.
q: device token 存在哪里更合理？
q_en: Where should device tokens be stored?
options: device 表存 token
只放 user 表一个字段
只存在客户端内存
写进通知模板
options_en: Store tokens in the device table.
As one field on the user table only.
Only in client memory.
Inside the notification template.
why: push token 是设备级标识，一个用户多设备时要一对多建模。email 和 phone 更像用户联系信息，可放用户资料或联系表。
why_en: Push tokens are device-level identifiers, so model them as many devices per user.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确只允许单设备登录，user 表上的当前 token 可以作为简化版本。

termDefinitions.meaning: 推送平台分配给某个设备/应用安装的发送标识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A device token is the push-platform identifier for a device or app installation.

scenario: push 队列积压持续增长，第三方没有报错，但用户收到通知越来越晚。
scenario_en: The push queue backlog keeps growing, providers report no errors, and users receive notifications later and later.
q: 该先看哪个指标并采取什么动作？
q_en: Which metric and action should come first?
options: 看队列深度并扩 worker
模板字符数；改短文案
用户头像缓存命中率；清缓存
数据库表名长度；重命名
options_en: Watch queue depth and scale workers.
Template character count; shorten copy.
Avatar cache hit rate; clear cache.
Database table-name length; rename tables.
why: 队列深度直接说明生产快于消费。扩 worker 增加消费能力，或限流入口避免延迟继续扩大。
why_en: Queue depth shows producers are outpacing consumers, so scale workers or throttle incoming sends.
whenOtherWins: 如果积压来自第三方限流，盲目扩 worker 无效，要改退避和发送速率。

termDefinitions.meaning: 队列中还没被处理的任务积压。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backlog is the number of queued jobs waiting to be processed.

scenario: 通知 API 只给内部服务或可信客户端用；如果被滥用，会变成垃圾通知入口。
scenario_en: The notification API is for internal services or trusted clients; abuse would turn it into a spam gateway.
q: API 层先做什么安全控制？
q_en: What security control belongs at the API layer?
options: 认证调用方并保护密钥
把 appSecret 下发给所有用户
只依赖消息模板
关闭所有日志
options_en: Authenticate callers and protect secrets.
Ship appSecret to every user.
Rely only on templates.
Disable all logs.
why: 通知入口必须先确认调用方身份，不然任何人都能触发发送。密钥泄漏后要能轮换，并配合限流。
why_en: Authenticate notification callers because an unauthenticated send API becomes a spam endpoint.
whenOtherWins: 如果所有调用都在私有网络内，也仍要用服务身份或 mTLS 做内层保护。

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端或服务接入 API 的凭据对，secret 必须保密。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An appKey/appSecret pair authenticates API callers, and the secret must stay private.

termDefinitions.meaning: Mutual TLS，客户端和服务端都用证书互相认证。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mTLS is Mutual TLS, where client and server authenticate each other with certificates.

scenario: 产品团队想知道通知是否真的带来打开、点击和后续转化，而不仅是发出去了。
scenario_en: The product team wants to know opens, clicks, and downstream conversion, not just whether messages were sent.
q: 要接入哪类组件？
q_en: What component should be integrated?
options: 事件追踪/analytics 管线
DNS resolver
URL frontier
关系图数据库
options_en: An event-tracking or analytics pipeline.
A DNS resolver.
A URL frontier.
A social graph database.
why: 发送成功只说明供应商接收了请求，不能说明用户互动。埋点能反哺模板、限频和投放策略。
why_en: Delivery success does not measure user engagement, so tracking opens and clicks feeds future notification strategy.
whenOtherWins: 如果是强事务告警，首要指标是送达和失败告警，互动分析可以后置。

termDefinitions.meaning: 收集和分析事件数据，用于理解用户行为和系统效果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Analytics collects and analyzes event data to understand behavior and outcomes.

tradeoff: 投递成功信号 vs 用户互动信号

scenario: worker 调第三方发送失败；系统既不能丢通知，也不能无限静默重试。
scenario_en: A worker fails to send through a provider; the system must not lose the notification or retry silently forever.
q: 失败后的可靠处理顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the reliable failure-handling sequence?
steps: 若重试耗尽，告警开发者或切备用供应商
worker 调 provider 失败
按退避策略重新入队等待下一次 worker 拉取
读取持久 notification log 重建任务
成功则标记完成并记录结果，否则进入重试判断
why: 先有持久记录，失败才有东西可重试；重试要有退避和上限。否则不是打爆供应商，就是故障没人知道。
why_en: Durable intent enables retry, and bounded backoff keeps failures visible instead of hammering the provider.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Log[Notification log] --> W[Worker]
  W --> P[Provider]
  P -->|fail| R[Retry with backoff]
  R --> W
  R -->|exhausted| A[Alert or failover]
  P -->|ok| Done[Mark sent]

termDefinitions.meaning: 重试间隔逐步拉长，避免故障时持续打满下游。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backoff gradually increases retry delay to avoid overwhelming a failing dependency.

scenario: 通知希望尽快到达，但大促高峰时允许几十秒级延迟，不能为了低延迟丢数据。
scenario_en: Notifications should arrive quickly, but during campaign peaks a delay of tens of seconds is acceptable; data loss is not.
q: 这更像什么系统语义？
q_en: What delivery semantics does this imply?
options: soft real-time，用队列缓冲峰值
hard real-time，必须固定毫秒送达
离线批处理，第二天统一发
纯客户端轮询
options_en: Soft real-time with queues absorbing peaks.
Hard real-time with fixed millisecond delivery.
Offline batch, sent the next day.
Pure client polling.
why: 需求说尽快但可延迟，所以队列换来削峰和可靠性。硬实时会增加复杂度和成本，这里不值得。
why_en: This is soft real-time: queueing can trade small delay for reliability and burst absorption.
tradeoff: 低延迟 vs 削峰可靠性
whenOtherWins: 如果是电话呼叫控制或交易撮合，硬实时约束才可能主导设计。

termDefinitions.meaning: 软实时表示越快越好，但小延迟可接受。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Soft real-time means faster is better, but small delays are acceptable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 硬实时表示错过时间界限就是系统失败。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hard real-time means missing the deadline is a system failure.

scenario: notification server 位于业务服务和队列之间，是发送入口而不是最终投递方。
scenario_en: The notification server sits between business services and queues; it is the send entry point, not the final delivery provider.
q: 它通常负责哪些事？
q_en: What does it usually handle?
options: 认证和基础参数校验
读取用户/设备/模板元数据
把事件写入对应消息队列
直接替代 APNS/FCM 的全球网络
options_en: Authentication and basic validation.
Fetching user, device, and template metadata.
Writing events to the right message queue.
Replacing the global APNS/FCM networks.
why: 入口层适合做轻量校验、补齐元数据和入队。真正跨运营商或平台的投递仍由第三方网络完成。
why_en: The entry layer validates, enriches, and enqueues; platform delivery still belongs to external push, SMS, or email providers.

termDefinitions.meaning: Apple Push Notification Service，iOS 推送网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: APNS is Apple's iOS push notification network.

termDefinitions.meaning: Firebase Cloud Messaging，常见 Android 推送网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FCM is a common Android push notification network.

scenario: 用户不在 App 前台，但你希望新消息或提醒主动出现在锁屏上。
scenario_en: The user is not actively using the app, but you want new messages or alerts to appear on the lock screen.
q: 通知系统为什么偏 push？
q_en: Why does the notification system favor push?
options: 客户端轮询更省电
服务端经平台主动触达设备，不靠客户端频繁拉取
所有通知都必须等用户打开 App
push 不需要用户授权
options_en: Client polling saves more battery.
The server reaches devices through platform services without frequent client pulls.
Every notification must wait until the user opens the app.
Push requires no user permission.
why: 移动端频繁 pull 会浪费电量和网络，push 把唤醒交给平台。代价是依赖 APNS/FCM 等外部服务和用户授权。
why_en: Push avoids constant client polling by using platform delivery services, at the cost of provider dependency and permissions.
tradeoff: 主动触达 vs 外部平台依赖
whenOtherWins: 如果只是站内消息列表，用户打开页面时 pull 最新数据就够。

termDefinitions.meaning: 平台主动把通知投递到设备的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A push notification is delivered proactively to a device by a platform service.

scenario: 同一条促销消息要发给 iOS 和 Android 用户；两个平台的推送网关不同。
scenario_en: The same campaign must reach iOS and Android users, but the platforms use different push gateways.
q: 通道适配层要区分什么？
q_en: What should the channel adapter distinguish?
options: APNS 给 iOS，FCM 常给 Android
APNS 给 SMS，FCM 给 email
两者都只负责模板存储
两者都能绕过设备 token
options_en: APNS for iOS, FCM commonly for Android.
APNS for SMS and FCM for email.
Both only store templates.
Both bypass device tokens.
why: 不同平台网关、凭据和 payload 格式不同，所以 adapter 要按平台封装。业务服务不该直接散落这些差异。
why_en: APNS and FCM differ in gateway, credentials, and payload shape, so hide them behind platform adapters.
whenOtherWins: 如果只支持一个平台，先做单 adapter 可以更快上线。

termDefinitions.meaning: Apple Push Notification Service，Apple 设备的推送服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: APNS is Apple Push Notification Service for Apple devices.

termDefinitions.meaning: Firebase Cloud Messaging，Google/Firebase 提供的推送服务，常用于 Android。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FCM is Firebase Cloud Messaging, commonly used for Android push.

tradeoff: 平台差异封装 vs adapter 维护成本

scenario: SMS 和 email 都能自己搭服务，但交付率、退信处理和运营商接入都很麻烦。
scenario_en: SMS and email can be self-hosted, but deliverability, bounces, and carrier integration are hard.
q: 为什么常用第三方 gateway？
q_en: Why use third-party gateways?
options: 它们提供投递网络、交付率工具和分析能力
它们让用户无法退订
它们替代所有业务数据库
它们保证没有任何费用
options_en: They provide delivery networks, deliverability tooling, and analytics.
They make opt-out impossible.
They replace all business databases.
They guarantee zero cost.
why: SMS/email 的难点在外部网络和送达质量，商业 gateway 通常更成熟。代价是成本、限流和供应商锁定。
why_en: SMS and email delivery quality depends on external networks, where commercial gateways are usually stronger.
tradeoff: 交付能力 vs 成本和锁定
whenOtherWins: 如果是内部低量邮件，自己维护 SMTP 也可能够用。

termDefinitions.meaning: 连接内部系统和外部投递网络的服务入口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A gateway connects an internal system to an external delivery network.

termDefinitions.meaning: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol，邮件服务器之间传送邮件的协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SMTP is the Simple Mail Transfer Protocol used between mail servers.

scenario: 业务服务不会直接调用每个第三方；它们先调用内部 notification API。
scenario_en: Business services do not call every provider directly; they call an internal notification API first.
q: notification server 入口最少要做什么？
q_en: What must the notification server entry point do?
options: 认证调用方、校验目标、取模板/设置并入队
直接保证用户已打开通知
替用户安装 App
替 APNS 保存五年历史
options_en: Authenticate callers, validate targets, fetch templates/settings, and enqueue.
Guarantee the user has opened the notification.
Install the app for the user.
Store five years of APNS history.
why: 入口层负责把业务意图变成规范的发送事件，不能把脏数据直接丢给 worker。真正投递由后面的 worker 和 provider 完成。
why_en: The entry layer turns business intent into a valid send event before workers and providers handle delivery.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次待发送通知的结构化事件，包含用户、通道、模板和变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A send event is a structured notification intent with user, channel, template, and variables.

scenario: 大促开始十分钟内涌入几百万通知；第三方通道有每秒发送上限。
scenario_en: A campaign creates millions of notifications in ten minutes, while the provider has a per-second send limit.
q: 队列在这里主要解决什么？
q_en: What does the queue mainly solve here?
options: 削峰缓冲，让 worker 按下游能力消化
让第三方没有限流
让所有通知变成同步请求
删除用户设置检查
options_en: Buffer bursts so workers consume at downstream capacity.
Make providers have no rate limits.
Turn all notifications into synchronous calls.
Remove user settings checks.
why: 队列把入口峰值变成可控消费速率，避免 API 线程等待供应商。代价是用户收到通知可能晚一点。
why_en: Queues convert producer bursts into controlled consumer throughput, trading latency for stability.
tradeoff: 峰值吸收 vs 端到端延迟
whenOtherWins: 如果通知必须毫秒级响应，队列延迟预算要更严格，甚至走专用高优先级通道。

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制单位时间内可发送或调用的数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rate limit caps how many sends or calls can happen per time window.

scenario: 一个服务要给 500 万用户发送同一活动提醒，但每个用户的语言和退订设置不同。
scenario_en: A service must send the same campaign to 5 million users, but each user has different language and opt-out settings.
q: fanout 该在哪里展开？
q_en: Where should fanout be expanded?
options: 在后台批处理/队列中分批展开，并逐个检查设置
让调用方同步循环 500 万次
把一个事件直接丢给 APNS 让它猜用户
只给第一个用户发送
options_en: Expand in batches through background jobs/queues and check settings per user.
Make the caller synchronously loop 5 million times.
Send one event to APNS and let it guess users.
Send only to the first user.
why: 大 fanout 会很慢，要异步分批处理；每个用户仍要套模板、查设置和选通道。
why_en: Large fanout should be batched asynchronously while still applying per-user settings and templates.
tradeoff: 批量吞吐 vs 个性化检查
whenOtherWins: 如果只是给一个用户发交易通知，不需要 campaign fanout。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个发送意图展开成许多接收者任务的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout expands one send intent into many recipient-specific tasks.

scenario: 用户卸载重装 App 或更换手机后，旧 device token 可能失效。
scenario_en: After a user reinstalls the app or changes phones, old device tokens may become invalid.
q: token 生命周期怎么处理？
q_en: How should token lifecycle be handled?
options: 更新新 token，清理旧 token
永远保留所有旧 token
只把 token 写进模板
用户退订时删除邮箱
options_en: Update new tokens and prune old ones.
Keep every old token forever.
Put tokens only inside templates.
Delete email addresses when users opt out.
why: device token 是会变化的路由地址，服务端要更新和淘汰。否则会浪费发送额度，还可能漏发新设备。
why_en: Device tokens are mutable routing identifiers, so update and prune them over time.
whenOtherWins: 如果是 email 地址变更，也要类似做验证和更新，但机制不同。

termDefinitions.meaning: 推送平台给某个设备安装分配的投递标识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A device token is the delivery identifier assigned by a push platform to an app installation.

scenario: 业务方想区分“我们提交给供应商了”和“供应商确认送达/失败了”。
scenario_en: The business wants to distinguish submitted-to-provider from provider-confirmed delivered or failed.
q: 需要接哪类反馈？
q_en: What feedback should be integrated?
options: 接 provider delivery receipt
DNS TTL 刷新
URL Seen Bloom filter
聊天 heartbeat
options_en: Consume provider delivery receipts.
DNS TTL refresh.
URL Seen Bloom filter.
Chat heartbeat.
why: 提交成功不等于用户收到，receipt 能更新发送状态和失败原因。代价是回调也要鉴权、去重和重试。
why_en: Provider receipts distinguish accepted requests from delivery outcomes and failure reasons.
whenOtherWins: 如果通道不提供 receipt，只能用提交状态和抽样监控近似。

termDefinitions.meaning: 第三方回传的投递结果事件，例如已送达、失败或退信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A delivery receipt is a provider event reporting delivered, failed, or bounced status.

tradeoff: 供应商反馈闭环 vs 额外异步状态处理

scenario: email provider 返回 429；继续全速重试会让失败更久。
scenario_en: The email provider returns HTTP 429; retrying at full speed will prolong the failure.
q: worker 应该怎么退避？
q_en: How should workers back off?
options: 按 provider 和通道做指数退避，并保留最大重试次数
立刻无限重试同一请求
把所有 email 改成 SMS
删除 notification log
options_en: Use provider/channel-level exponential backoff with a retry cap.
Retry the same request forever immediately.
Convert every email to SMS.
Delete the notification log.
why: 429 表示下游限流，退避要降低对该 provider 的压力。最大次数和死信队列能让故障可见。
why_en: A 429 means the downstream is throttling, so exponential backoff and retry caps keep pressure controlled.
whenOtherWins: 如果是永久错误如无效邮箱，应该直接标失败，不进入多轮重试。

termDefinitions.meaning: Too Many Requests，表示调用方超过限流。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests means the caller exceeded a rate limit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保存多次处理失败任务的队列，便于排查或人工处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue stores jobs that failed repeatedly for later inspection.

scenario: 通知系统已经能发送，但运营需要知道延迟、失败、重复和用户互动。
scenario_en: The notification system can send messages, but operations need latency, failure, duplicate, and engagement visibility.
q: 观测面板至少看什么？
q_en: What should the dashboard include?
options: 看队列、延迟、错误、重复、互动
网页 PageRank
聊天在线绿点数作为唯一指标
DNS cache 命中率作为所有通道指标
options_en: Track queues, latency, errors, duplicates, engagement.
Web PageRank.
Chat online-dot count as the only metric.
DNS cache hit rate for every channel.
why: 这些指标覆盖系统健康和产品效果：发得快不快、失败在哪、是否扰民、有没有互动。
why_en: These metrics cover both system health and product outcome: speed, failures, duplicates, and engagement.

termDefinitions.meaning: 收到通知后打开或查看的人数比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Open rate is the fraction of recipients who open or view a notification.

termDefinitions.meaning: 收到通知后点击链接或按钮的人数比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Click rate is the fraction of recipients who click a notification link or action.

scenario: 发送前每条通知都要查用户是否对该 channel opt-in；高峰时设置表压力很大。
scenario_en: Before each send, the system checks whether the user opted into that channel; the settings table is under heavy peak load.
q: settings 读取怎么优化？
q_en: How should settings reads be optimized?
options: 缓存用户通知设置，并用短 TTL 或变更失效
完全跳过退订检查
把设置硬编码在 worker
每次都全表扫描
options_en: Cache notification settings with short TTL or change invalidation.
Skip opt-out checks entirely.
Hard-code settings in workers.
Scan the full table every time.
why: 设置读多写少，缓存能保护数据库；但退订要尽快生效，所以 TTL 不能太长。
why_en: Settings are read-heavy, so cache them, but keep TTL or invalidation tight for opt-out correctness.
tradeoff: 数据库压力 vs 退订生效速度
whenOtherWins: 如果法规要求退订立即生效，发送前读主库或强失效更稳。

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据变化后让旧缓存失效的动作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Invalidation marks stale cached data unusable after the source changes.

scenario: 一个营销模板上线后发现链接错误；同时队列里还有旧模板生成的待发送任务。
scenario_en: A campaign template ships with a bad link, while queued jobs generated from the old template still exist.
q: 模板系统要支持什么？
q_en: What should the template system support?
options: 模板版本和回滚，任务记录使用的版本
只保存一个可覆盖模板
让 worker 随机选模板
不记录变量
options_en: Template versions and rollback, with jobs recording the version used.
Keep only one overwritable template.
Let workers pick templates randomly.
Do not record variables.
why: 版本能解释某条通知按哪个内容发出，也能停止坏版本继续扩散。代价是模板管理更像发布流程。
why_en: Versioning makes template sends auditable and lets you roll back bad content.
whenOtherWins: 小型内部提醒可以先用简单模板，但生产营销系统需要版本和审核。

termDefinitions.meaning: 发现新版本有问题后切回旧版本的操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rollback means reverting to a previous version after a bad release.

scenario: 安全验证码、支付提醒和促销广告共用系统；高峰时不能让广告压住验证码。
scenario_en: Security codes, payment alerts, and promotional ads share the system; ads must not delay codes during peaks.
q: 队列还需要什么维度？
q_en: What extra queue dimension is needed?
options: 按优先级或业务类型隔离队列/配额
所有消息完全同优先级
只按模板名字排序
只按用户 ID 奇偶拆分
options_en: Separate queues or quotas by priority or business type.
Treat every message as exactly the same priority.
Sort only by template name.
Split only by odd/even user ID.
why: 不同通知价值不同，高优先级通道要有保留吞吐。代价是调度要防止低优先级永久饥饿。
why_en: Different notification classes need reserved capacity so low-value campaigns cannot block critical sends.
tradeoff: 关键通知延迟 vs 低优先级公平
whenOtherWins: 如果系统只发送一种同等重要的通知，单优先级队列更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 给某类流量保留或限制的资源份额。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quota is a reserved or capped share of capacity for a traffic class.

scenario: worker 请求供应商超时，不知道供应商是否已经发送；重试可能造成用户收到两条。
scenario_en: A worker times out calling a provider and does not know whether the provider already sent; retry may duplicate the notification.
q: 如何让 provider 调用更安全？
q_en: How can provider calls be safer?
options: 复用 event_id 作幂等 key
每次重试生成新业务 ID
关闭所有重试
只改通知文案
options_en: Reuse event_id as an idempotency key.
Generate a new business ID on every retry.
Disable all retries.
Only change the notification copy.
why: 如果供应商支持幂等 key，同一事件重试会被识别成同一次发送。否则只能靠本地去重和业务容忍重复。
why_en: If the provider supports idempotency keys, retries for the same event can map to one provider-side send.
whenOtherWins: 如果供应商不支持幂等 key，要在本地记录尝试状态并降低重复影响。

termDefinitions.meaning: 发送请求携带的唯一 key，用于让下游识别重复请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key lets a downstream service recognize duplicate requests.

scenario: 调用方传入非法手机号、空邮箱或过大的 push payload；如果直接入队会浪费 worker。
scenario_en: Callers pass an invalid phone number, empty email, or oversized push payload; enqueuing it wastes workers.
q: 入口校验要挡什么？
q_en: What should entry validation block?
options: 挡格式、缺字段、超限和越权
所有合法请求
provider 的内部网络抖动
用户是否点击
options_en: Block bad format, missing fields, oversize, unauthorized sends.
All valid requests.
Provider-side network jitter.
Whether the user clicks.
why: 入口越早拒绝无效请求，后面队列和 worker 越干净。provider 故障和用户行为则要在后续观测。
why_en: Reject invalid requests early so queues and workers only handle sendable events.

termDefinitions.meaning: 通知发送给平台或用户设备的内容体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A payload is the content body sent to a platform or user device.

scenario: 一次订单提醒优先 push；如果用户没有有效 device token，但有验证过的手机号。
scenario_en: An order alert prefers push; the user has no valid device token but has a verified phone number.
q: 多通道 fallback 怎么做？
q_en: How should multi-channel fallback work?
options: 按业务策略从 push 退到 SMS，并记录原因
同时无脑发所有通道
直接丢弃订单提醒
把手机号当 device token 用
options_en: Fallback from push to SMS by business policy and record the reason.
Blindly send every channel at once.
Drop the order alert.
Use the phone number as a device token.
why: fallback 要按通知重要性和用户设置决定，不能随便轰炸所有通道。记录原因方便之后分析 token 质量。
why_en: Fallback should follow business importance and user settings, not spam every channel blindly.
whenOtherWins: 营销消息通常不应跨通道 fallback，避免打扰用户。

termDefinitions.meaning: 主方案不可用时切到备用方案的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fallback means switching to a backup path when the primary path is unavailable.

tradeoff: 触达可靠性 vs 用户打扰和退订风险

scenario: 产品经理问一条通知现在处于 created、queued、sent、delivered、failed 中哪一步。
scenario_en: A product manager asks whether a notification is created, queued, sent, delivered, or failed.
q: 为什么要建状态机？
q_en: Why build a status state machine?
options: 用显式发送状态机
让所有状态都写在日志文本里手查
为了替代 provider
为了跳过去重
options_en: Use an explicit delivery state machine.
So every state is manually searched in log text.
To replace providers.
To skip dedupe.
why: 状态机让系统知道下一步能不能重试、是否终态、该显示什么。没有状态会让排障全靠猜。
why_en: A state machine makes retry, terminal outcomes, and user-visible status explicit.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是 fire-and-forget 低价值通知，可以只保留最少审计日志。
diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Created
  Created --> Queued
  Queued --> Sent
  Sent --> Delivered
  Sent --> Failed
  Failed --> Queued: retry

termDefinitions.meaning: 用有限状态和状态迁移描述对象生命周期的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A state machine models an object lifecycle with states and transitions.

scenario: 用户既能发帖，也能打开首页看好友动态；系统把这两个动作拆成两条主路径。
scenario_en: Users can publish posts and open the home page to read friends' updates; the system splits these into two main flows.
q: 新闻流设计的两条主路径是什么？
q_en: What are the two main flows in a news feed design?
options: 发布写入与 feed 构建/读取
DNS 解析与网页下载
短信发送与 email 发送
支付扣款与退款
options_en: Post publishing and feed building or retrieval.
DNS resolution and page downloading.
SMS sending and email sending.
Payment capture and refund.
why: 发布路径关心写入帖子和分发 post_id；读取路径关心从缓存取 ID 再补齐内容。分开讲能把写扩展和读延迟说清楚。
why_en: Separate publishing from retrieval so write fanout and read hydration can be reasoned about independently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户首页看到的动态列表，通常由关注对象或好友内容组成。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feed is the home-page list of updates from friends or followed entities.

scenario: 10M DAU 的社交产品，大多数用户好友数正常；首页刷新必须快，但少数名人有海量粉丝。
scenario_en: A social app has 10M DAU; most users have normal friend counts, home feed refresh must be fast, but a few celebrities have huge follower counts.
q: fanout 策略怎么选？
q_en: Which fanout strategy fits best?
options: 普通用户写时推，名人读时拉
所有用户都读时全量聚合
所有用户都写时推给全部粉丝
只在客户端拼接好友帖子
options_en: Push normal users, pull celebrities on read.
Aggregate everything on every read for all users.
Push every post to every follower for all users.
Assemble friends' posts only on the client.
why: 大多数用户预计算能让读很快；名人写时推送会制造巨大热 key。混合方案把读延迟和写放大分开处理。
why_en: Use push fanout for normal users to keep reads fast, but pull celebrity posts to avoid huge write amplification.
tradeoff: 读路径延迟 vs 写路径放大
whenOtherWins: 如果用户关系很小且没有名人，纯 fanout on write 更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 发帖时把 post_id 预先写入接收者 feed。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout on write prewrites a post ID into recipients' feeds when the post is created.

termDefinitions.meaning: 读首页时临时拉取关注对象的近期帖子并合并。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fanout on read pulls and merges recent posts when the feed is requested.

optionMeanings: 全量读时聚合。
普通用户预推，名人读时拉。
所有用户都写时推。
客户端本地拼接。
optionDirectness: 适合低活跃或关系很少。
适合大社交常见分布。
适合粉丝上限很低。
适合离线 demo。
optionScenarioImpacts: 首页会慢。
读快且避开名人热点。
名人会造成写爆炸。
权限和一致性失控。
optionMeanings_en: 全量读时聚合。
普通用户预推，名人读时拉。
所有用户都写时推。
客户端本地拼接。
optionDirectness_en: 适合低活跃或关系很少。
适合大社交常见分布。
适合粉丝上限很低。
适合离线 demo。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: 首页会慢。
读快且避开名人热点。
名人会造成写爆炸。
权限和一致性失控。

scenario: 一个名人发帖会触达几千万粉丝；如果写时推，fanout worker 都围着同一个作者事件跑。
scenario_en: A celebrity post reaches tens of millions of followers; with write fanout, workers all process the same author event.
q: 这个风险叫什么，怎么缓解？
q_en: What is this risk and a mitigation?
options: hotkey；名人帖子改成读时拉或分散处理
cache miss；删除所有缓存
DNS stall；缓存域名
split brain；关闭副本
options_en: Hotkey; pull celebrity posts on read or distribute processing.
Cache miss; delete all caches.
DNS stall; cache domains.
Split brain; turn off replicas.
why: 名人事件会把同一份写放大到巨量接收者，形成热点。读时拉能把成本摊到真正打开 feed 的用户身上。
why_en: A celebrity post creates a hotkey because one write fans out massively; pull it on read to spend work only for active readers.
whenOtherWins: 如果粉丝数上限很低，写时推不会形成明显热点。

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个 key 或事件承载远高于平均的读写压力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hotkey is a key or event receiving far more traffic than average.

scenario: 每个用户 feed cache 只需要支持最近几百到几千条；完整帖子、作者头像和媒体对象很大。
scenario_en: Each user's feed cache only needs recent hundreds or thousands of entries; full posts, avatars, and media objects are large.
q: feed cache 里存什么？
q_en: What should the feed cache store?
options: 只存 post_id，读取时 hydrate
存完整用户对象和全部媒体字节
只存作者名字字符串
不存任何东西，每次扫库
options_en: Store post IDs and hydrate on read.
Store full user objects and all media bytes.
Store only author-name strings.
Store nothing and scan the database every time.
why: ID 列表小，适合高命中缓存；读取时再从 user/post cache 补齐展示字段。代价是读路径多几次缓存查询。
why_en: Caching IDs keeps per-user feed entries small, then read-time hydration fills in post and user details.
tradeoff: 缓存体积 vs 读取补齐成本
whenOtherWins: 如果 feed 项极少且字段固定，缓存完整对象能减少一次 hydrate。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  FeedIDs[Feed cache post IDs] --> Service[Newsfeed service]
  Service --> Post[Post cache]
  Service --> User[User cache]
  Service --> JSON[Hydrated JSON]

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据 ID 取回完整对象字段，组装成可返回给客户端的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hydration fetches full object fields by ID to build the client response.

scenario: 发帖后 fanout 服务要快速找到作者的好友，并考虑好友关系和推荐等图查询。
scenario_en: After a post, the fanout service must quickly find the author's friends and support relationship-style graph queries.
q: 好友关系更适合哪类存储？
q_en: Which storage type fits friend relationships?
options: graph DB 或社交图服务
对象存储
CDN
只写入模板库
options_en: Use a graph DB or social graph service.
Object storage.
A CDN.
Only a template store.
why: 好友关系天然是点和边，图服务能围绕邻居查询优化。代价是它通常不负责帖子正文存储。
why_en: Friend relationships are nodes and edges, so a graph service is a natural fit for neighbor lookups.
whenOtherWins: 如果关系很简单且规模小，关系型表加索引也可以先扛住。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用节点和边建模关系的数据库，适合好友、关注和推荐查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A graph database models relationships as nodes and edges, useful for friends, follows, and recommendations.

tradeoff: 关系遍历能力 vs 通用存储和运维成本

scenario: 作者发帖后，有些好友静音了作者；帖子也可能只对部分好友可见。
scenario_en: After a user posts, some friends may have muted the author, and the post may be visible only to selected friends.
q: fanout 前要先做什么？
q_en: What should happen before fanout?
options: 读取用户设置和可见性规则，过滤接收者
把 post_id 推给所有好友再说
只按好友数量排序
删除 user cache
options_en: Read settings and visibility rules, then filter recipients.
Push the post_id to every friend first.
Sort only by friend count.
Delete the user cache.
why: 分发前过滤能避免把不该看的内容写入对方 feed cache。代价是 fanout 依赖设置缓存的新鲜度。
why_en: Filter recipients before writing feed entries so muted or unauthorized users do not receive the post ID.
whenOtherWins: 如果可见性规则很复杂，也可以先写候选集，读取时再做强校验，但读路径会变重。

termDefinitions.meaning: 决定哪些用户能看到某条内容的权限规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A visibility rule decides which users are allowed to see a piece of content.

scenario: feed 中有图片和视频；用户遍布全球，媒体对象远大于帖子文本。
scenario_en: The feed contains images and videos; users are global, and media objects are much larger than post text.
q: 媒体文件怎么分发？
q_en: How should media files be served?
options: 存对象存储，URL 走 CDN 边缘
直接放进 feed cache
每次从关系图数据库读
编码到 auth token 里
options_en: Store in object storage and serve through CDN edges.
Put media bytes directly in feed cache.
Read from the graph database each time.
Encode them inside the auth token.
why: 媒体大且读多，CDN 把字节放到离用户近的边缘。feed 服务只返回引用，不承担大文件传输。
why_en: Large read-heavy media should be served from object storage through a CDN, while the feed returns references.
whenOtherWins: 如果只支持纯文本 feed，CDN 不是主路径。

termDefinitions.meaning: Content Delivery Network，把静态内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches static content at edge locations close to users.

tradeoff: 媒体就近分发 vs feed API 轻量化

scenario: 新闻流读取要组装 feed ID、帖子、作者关系、点赞状态和计数。
scenario_en: News feed reads assemble feed IDs, posts, relationships, action state, and counters.
q: 哪些缓存层常见且有不同职责？
q_en: Which cache layers commonly have distinct responsibilities?
options: News Feed：保存用户 feed 的 post_id
Content：保存帖子正文和热门内容
Action/Counters：保存点赞回复状态和计数
Robots：保存网站抓取规则
options_en: News Feed stores post IDs for a user's feed.
Content stores post bodies and hot content.
Action/Counters store like/reply state and counts.
Robots stores website crawl rules.
why: feed 是多对象组合，分层缓存能让每类数据按自己的访问模式扩展。robots.txt 属于爬虫，不属于新闻流读取。
why_en: A feed is assembled from several object types, so cache layers should match their different access patterns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 计数器，保存点赞数、回复数、关注数等聚合值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A counter stores aggregate counts such as likes, replies, or followers.

scenario: 发帖 API 暴露给登录用户；攻击者可能用脚本高频发垃圾内容。
scenario_en: The post API is exposed to logged-in users; an attacker may script high-rate spam posts.
q: web server 层要先挡什么？
q_en: What should the web-server layer guard first?
options: 认证 auth_token，并对发帖限流
直接信任 content 参数
只加 CDN
让 fanout worker 决定是否登录
options_en: Authenticate auth_token and rate-limit posting.
Trust the content parameter directly.
Only add a CDN.
Let fanout workers decide whether the user is logged in.
why: 入口层先确认是谁，再限制单位时间发帖量。这样垃圾内容不会进入后面的存储和 fanout 管线。
why_en: Authenticate and rate-limit at the entry point so spam does not enter storage and fanout.
whenOtherWins: 内部管理脚本可以走单独高权限入口，但仍应审计和限额。

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端证明登录身份的令牌。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An auth_token is a token the client uses to prove its logged-in identity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限制某主体在时间窗口内的请求数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rate limit caps requests from an actor within a time window.

optionMeanings: 入口鉴权加限流。
信任客户端参数。
只加 CDN。
让 worker 鉴权。
optionDirectness: 适合公开写 API。
只适合可信内部脚本。
适合静态媒体。
适合补充校验。
optionScenarioImpacts: 垃圾内容进不了后端。
攻击流量会直达存储。
挡不住发帖滥用。
太晚，队列已被污染。
optionMeanings_en: 入口鉴权加限流。
信任客户端参数。
只加 CDN。
让 worker 鉴权。
optionDirectness_en: 适合公开写 API。
只适合可信内部脚本。
适合静态媒体。
适合补充校验。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: 垃圾内容进不了后端。
攻击流量会直达存储。
挡不住发帖滥用。
太晚，队列已被污染。

scenario: 发帖请求不能一直等到 5000 个好友的 feed cache 都写完；高峰时 fanout 量会抖动。
scenario_en: The publish request should not wait until feed cache writes for 5,000 friends finish; fanout volume spikes at peak times.
q: post service 和 fanout worker 之间放什么？
q_en: What belongs between the post service and fanout workers?
options: 消息队列，异步分发 post_id
同步 for 循环写所有好友
客户端轮询好友列表
DNS resolver
options_en: A message queue for asynchronous post_id fanout.
A synchronous loop writing every friend's feed.
Client polling of the friend list.
A DNS resolver.
why: 队列把发帖延迟和 fanout 工作量解耦，峰值时能缓冲。代价是好友看到新帖可能有轻微延迟。
why_en: A queue decouples publish latency from fanout work and buffers spikes, at the cost of small feed delay.
tradeoff: 发布延迟 vs 分发实时性
whenOtherWins: 如果好友数极少且必须强同步可见，同步写入可以简化一致性。

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产者写入、消费者异步读取的缓冲组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A message queue buffers jobs from producers for asynchronous consumers.

scenario: 客户端打开首页，只需要取自己的 feed；排序简化为按时间倒序。
scenario_en: The client opens the home page and only needs its own feed; ordering is simplified to reverse chronological order.
q: feed 读取 API 的核心是什么？
q_en: What is the core feed retrieval API?
options: GET /v1/me/feed，服务端用登录身份取 feed
POST /v1/all/users/delete
GET /robots.txt
PATCH /provider/sms
options_en: GET /v1/me/feed, with the server using the logged-in identity.
POST /v1/all/users/delete.
GET /robots.txt.
PATCH /provider/sms.
why: me/feed 表示读当前登录用户的首页，auth token 决定是谁。不要让客户端随便传 user_id 读别人 feed。
why_en: A me/feed endpoint uses the authenticated identity to fetch the current user's feed, avoiding arbitrary user_id reads.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 里用于读取资源的请求方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP GET is the request method used to read a resource.

scenario: 面试官为了简化需求，明确说 feed 只按发布时间倒序，不做机器学习排序。
scenario_en: The interviewer simplifies the requirement: the feed is only reverse chronological, with no ML ranking.
q: 这会简化哪块设计？
q_en: Which part of the design becomes simpler?
options: 按时间维护 post_id 列表
必须引入复杂特征平台
所有帖子都要重新训练模型
不能使用缓存
options_en: Maintain post IDs in time order.
A complex feature platform is mandatory.
Every post must retrain a model.
Caching cannot be used.
why: 时间倒序让排序键很清楚，post_id 或时间戳就能维护列表。复杂 ranking 可以作为扩展，不该抢主线。
why_en: Reverse chronological order keeps the read model simple: maintain a time-ordered list of post IDs.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品要求相关性排序，读取路径要加入 ranking service 和特征缓存。

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据特征和策略给候选内容排序的服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ranking service orders candidate content using features and policy.

tradeoff: 时间倒序简单性 vs 相关性排序能力

scenario: 用户刷新首页；feed cache 里只有 post_id，展示还需要作者、正文和媒体链接。
scenario_en: A user refreshes the home feed; the feed cache contains only post IDs, while rendering needs author, post body, and media URLs.
q: 读取链路的合理顺序是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable read path order?
steps: 返回 JSON 给客户端渲染
web server 调 newsfeed service
从 feed cache 取 post_id 列表
从 user/post cache 补齐对象
客户端带 auth_token 请求 /me/feed
why: 先鉴权进入 feed 服务，再取轻量 ID 列表，最后 hydrate 成展示对象。这样 cache 小，返回体完整。
why_en: Authenticate the request, fetch lightweight feed IDs, hydrate objects from caches, and return renderable JSON.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  C[Client] --> W[Web server]
  W --> F[Newsfeed service]
  F --> IDs[Feed cache]
  F --> Obj[User and post cache]
  Obj --> JSON[Response JSON]

scenario: 新闻流 Web 层只做鉴权、限流和路由；真实状态在缓存、数据库和队列里。
scenario_en: The news feed web tier only handles auth, rate limiting, and routing; state lives in caches, databases, and queues.
q: web tier 怎么扩展？
q_en: How should the web tier scale?
options: 保持无状态，负载均衡后水平扩容
把每个用户 feed 存本机磁盘
要求客户端固定连同一台机器
只做垂直扩容
options_en: Keep it stateless and scale horizontally behind a load balancer.
Store each user's feed on local disk.
Require clients to stick to one machine.
Only scale vertically.
why: 无状态 web server 可以随时加减实例，失败也容易重试。状态放本机会让扩容和故障恢复都变难。
why_en: A stateless web tier can be added or replaced behind a load balancer without moving user feed state.
tradeoff: 水平扩容简单 vs 本地状态访问快
whenOtherWins: 如果服务维护长连接或本地 session，才需要粘性会话或外部会话存储。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把客户端请求分发到多台后端实例的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A load balancer distributes client requests across backend instances.

scenario: 每个用户 feed cache 如果无限保存所有历史 post_id，活跃多年后内存会持续膨胀。
scenario_en: If each user's feed cache stores every historical post ID forever, memory grows indefinitely over years.
q: 为什么要设置 feed cache 长度上限？
q_en: Why set a feed cache length limit?
options: 大多数用户只看最新内容，上限能控制内存
上限能让数据库不再需要
上限能保证没有重复帖子
上限能替代隐私过滤
options_en: Most users read recent content, and a cap controls memory.
A cap means the database is no longer needed.
A cap guarantees no duplicate posts.
A cap replaces privacy filtering.
why: feed cache 是近期加速层，不是永久历史库。控制长度能省内存，老内容可以回源或用分页补查。
why_en: The feed cache should accelerate recent reads, not become permanent history storage.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品要求离线快速翻完整历史，需要额外的持久索引，而不是只靠短 cache。

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求的数据不在缓存里，需要回源读取。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cache miss means requested data is not in cache and must be fetched from the source.

scenario: 用户发帖后，系统需要可靠保存帖子正文、作者、时间和媒体引用。
scenario_en: After a user posts, the system must reliably store text, author, timestamp, and media references.
q: post service 的核心职责是什么？
q_en: What is the core role of the post service?
options: 持久化帖子并更新 post cache
计算 DNS 解析
管理 APNS token
执行好友在线 heartbeat
options_en: Persist posts and update the post cache.
Perform DNS resolution.
Manage APNS tokens.
Run friend online heartbeats.
why: post service 是内容写入的权威入口，fanout 只分发 post_id。这样内容存储和 feed 分发职责分清。
why_en: The post service owns content persistence while fanout distributes post IDs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存帖子对象或热门帖子字段的层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A post cache stores post objects or hot post fields.

scenario: 用户发帖请求已经通过鉴权；你要把内容写入存储并让好友 feed 尽快看到。
scenario_en: A publish request is authenticated; you need to store the content and make it appear in friends feeds quickly.
q: 发布链路顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the publish path order?
options: 先写 post，再异步 fanout
先通知好友，再决定是否保存帖子
客户端直接写所有好友 cache
只写 CDN
options_en: Persist post, then fan out asynchronously.
Notify friends first, then decide whether to save the post.
Let the client write every friend cache directly.
Write only to CDN.
why: 先持久化内容，后分发 ID，才能保证 feed 里引用的帖子存在。fanout 异步能保护发帖延迟。
why_en: Persist the post before distributing its ID so feed entries never point to missing content.
whenOtherWins: 如果是临时 story 且允许失败丢弃，持久化策略可以更短，但仍要先定义 source of truth。

flowchart LR
  Client --> Web[Web server]
  Web --> Post[Post service]
  Post --> DB[(Post DB)]
  Post --> Q[Fanout queue]
  Q --> W[Fanout workers]
  W --> Feed[Feed cache]

先通知再保存。

只适合弱提示。

scenario: 最初需求是时间倒序；后来产品要求亲密好友、互动概率和内容质量影响顺序。
scenario_en: The initial requirement is reverse chronological; later product wants close friends, engagement probability, and content quality to affect order.
q: 要加哪类组件？
q_en: What component should be added?
options: ranking service 给候选打分
DNS resolver
短信 gateway
robots parser
options_en: Use a ranking service to score candidates.
A DNS resolver.
An SMS gateway.
A robots parser.
why: 一旦排序不只是时间，就要把候选生成和排序打分拆开。代价是特征缓存、模型延迟和解释复杂度。
why_en: Once ordering is not purely time-based, separate candidate generation from ranking.
tradeoff: 相关性排序 vs 系统复杂度
whenOtherWins: 如果面试范围明确只要时间倒序，ranking service 可以先不画。

termDefinitions.meaning: 先找出可能展示的内容集合，再交给排序层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Candidate generation finds the set of content items that a ranking layer may order.

scenario: 用户下滑 feed，需要稳定加载下一页；新帖子可能同时插入顶部。
scenario_en: A user scrolls the feed and needs a stable next page while new posts may arrive at the top.
q: 分页参数怎么选更稳？
q_en: Which pagination parameter is more stable?
options: cursor 分页，用末条作边界
offset += limit 永远稳定
每次随机取 20 条
让客户端传好友总数
options_en: Use cursor pagination with the last item as boundary.
offset += limit is always stable.
Fetch 20 random posts each time.
Have the client send friend count.
why: feed 会不断插入新内容，offset 容易重复或跳过。cursor 用已见边界继续查，滚动体验更稳。
why_en: A live feed changes under the user, so cursor pagination is more stable than offset.
tradeoff: 分页稳定性 vs 接口状态复杂度
whenOtherWins: 静态后台列表用 offset/limit 更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用上一页边界值继续查询下一页的分页方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cursor pagination uses a boundary value from the previous page to fetch the next page.

scenario: feed cache 只保留最近 1000 条；用户一直向下翻，老 post_id 不在缓存里了。
scenario_en: The feed cache keeps only the latest 1,000 entries; a user scrolls far enough that older post IDs are no longer cached.
q: cache miss 怎么处理？
q_en: How should this cache miss be handled?
options: 回源或重建旧页
直接报 feed 永久丢失
清空用户所有缓存
让客户端猜旧帖子
options_en: Fallback to source storage or rebuild old pages.
Report the feed as permanently lost.
Clear all user caches.
Let the client guess old posts.
why: cache 是加速层，miss 时必须有慢路径。慢路径可以查持久索引或按好友历史重新合并。
why_en: A cache is an acceleration layer, so misses need a slower source-of-truth path.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品只支持有限窗口 feed，超过窗口可以明确返回无更多内容。

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统中最权威、可恢复状态的数据源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The source of truth is the authoritative data source used for recovery.

scenario: 用户刚发帖后立刻刷新自己首页；异步 fanout 可能还没把 post_id 写入她自己的 feed cache。
scenario_en: A user posts and immediately refreshes their own feed; async fanout may not have written the post ID into their feed cache yet.
q: 如何保证写后可读体验？
q_en: How can read-your-writes be preserved?
options: 合并本人新帖或同步写自己 feed
等待所有好友 fanout 完成再返回发帖
告诉用户刷新三分钟后再看
只清空 feed cache
options_en: Merge own new posts or sync-write own feed.
Wait for all friend fanout to finish before returning publish.
Tell users to refresh in three minutes.
Only clear the feed cache.
why: 用户最敏感的是自己刚写的内容能否看到，可以给自己走快路径。好友 feed 仍可异步完成。
why_en: Preserve read-your-writes for the author with a fast path while friend fanout remains asynchronous.
tradeoff: 用户一致性体验 vs 发布延迟
whenOtherWins: 如果产品允许最终一致，简单异步 fanout 也能工作，但体验差一些。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户写入后，自己的后续读取能看到刚写的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Read-your-writes means a user can read their own recent write immediately.

optionMeanings: 作者读时合并新帖。
等全量 fanout。
提示稍后刷新。
清空 feed cache。
optionDirectness: 适合写后可读。
适合强同步小关系。
只适合极弱体验。
不解决一致性。
optionScenarioImpacts: 自己立刻看得到。
发帖延迟变高。
体验很差。
还会丢候选。

optionScenarioImpacts_en: 自己立刻看得到。

scenario: 名人帖子不预推给所有粉丝；粉丝打开 feed 时还要看到名人最近内容。
scenario_en: Celebrity posts are not pre-pushed to all followers; a follower should still see recent celebrity posts when opening the feed.
q: 读取时怎么合并名人内容？
q_en: How should celebrity content be merged on read?
options: 拉名人近期帖再合并
完全隐藏名人帖子
把名人所有历史一次性写入 cache
让客户端调用名人数据库
options_en: Pull recent celebrity posts and merge.
Hide celebrity posts entirely.
Write all celebrity history into cache at once.
Let the client call the celebrity database.
why: 名人例外把成本从写时推迟到真正读的人身上。读取服务要多拉一批候选再按时间或排名合并。
why_en: The celebrity exception shifts work to active readers, who pull and merge celebrity candidates on demand.
whenOtherWins: 如果名人粉丝也很少，写时推更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个有序候选列表合成一个展示列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Merge combines multiple ordered candidate lists into one display list.

tradeoff: 写时预分发成本 vs 读时合并成本

scenario: 某用户发帖后，好友可能不在 App 内；系统想提示有新内容，但不能阻塞发帖。
scenario_en: A user posts while friends may be outside the app; the system wants to alert them without blocking publishing.
q: 通知触发放在哪里？
q_en: Where should notification triggering happen?
options: 异步事件触发 notification service
发帖 API 同步等待所有 push 完成
客户端逐个通知好友
数据库触发器直接打 APNS
options_en: Trigger notification service from async events.
Have the publish API wait for every push.
Make the client notify every friend.
Let a database trigger call APNS directly.
why: 通知是副作用，适合跟着异步事件走。否则发帖延迟会被第三方推送服务拖住。
why_en: Notifications are side effects, so trigger them asynchronously rather than blocking the publish request.
whenOtherWins: 如果是少量强事务提醒，也可以同步记录通知意图，但投递仍建议异步。

termDefinitions.meaning: 主写入之外派生出的动作，例如通知、分析或缓存更新。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A side effect is a derived action outside the main write, such as notification, analytics, or cache update.

scenario: fanout 每次都要查作者好友列表；图数据库扛不住热门用户频繁发帖。
scenario_en: Fanout must fetch the author friend list each time; the graph database cannot handle frequent posts from hot users.
q: 好友列表读取怎么优化？
q_en: How can friend-list reads be optimized?
options: 缓存好友 ID 列表，并在关系变更时失效
每次全表扫描关系表
把好友列表放在帖子正文里
关闭 fanout
options_en: Cache friend ID lists and invalidate them on relationship changes.
Scan the relationship table every time.
Put the friend list in the post body.
Disable fanout.
why: 好友列表读多写少，缓存能减少图服务压力。关系变更时要失效，否则会推给旧好友或漏新好友。
why_en: Friend lists are read-heavy, so cache them but invalidate on relationship changes.
whenOtherWins: 如果隐私规则很复杂，缓存只能存候选好友，最终可见性还要单独判断。

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户之间好友、关注、屏蔽等关系组成的图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A social graph is the network of friendships, follows, blocks, and similar relationships.

tradeoff: 图服务压力 vs 好友关系新鲜度

每次扫关系表。
写进帖子正文。

scenario: fanout worker 写 feed cache 后崩溃，队列重投同一 post_id；可能重复出现在好友 feed。
scenario_en: A fanout worker crashes after writing feed cache, and the queue redelivers the same post_id; it may appear twice in a friend feed.
q: feed 写入要怎么防重复？
q_en: How should feed writes avoid duplicates?
options: 用 (user_id, post_id) 幂等写
每次写入随机 post_id
关闭队列重试
让客户端手动删除重复
options_en: Use idempotent (user_id, post_id) writes.
Write a random post_id each time.
Disable queue retries.
Ask the client to delete duplicates manually.
why: 异步 worker 必须假设任务会重复执行，写入键要能天然去重。否则可靠重试会换来重复 feed。
why_en: Async workers must tolerate duplicate execution, so feed entries need idempotent keys.
whenOtherWins: 如果底层 cache 只支持列表 append，就要在读取或写入前做去重。

termDefinitions.meaning: 重复执行多次仍只产生一次有效结果的写入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotent write has the same final effect even if repeated.

scenario: feed cache 需要按时间倒序取最近 N 个 post_id，还要快速追加新 post_id。
scenario_en: The feed cache needs the latest N post IDs in reverse time order and fast appends for new posts.
q: 用什么结构表达更自然？
q_en: Which structure is natural?
options: list 或 sorted set
单个全局字符串
图片 CDN 目录
DNS 记录
options_en: A list or sorted set.
One global string.
An image CDN directory.
A DNS record.
why: 用户 feed 是 per-user 有序集合，追加和截断都围绕这个 key。sorted set 还能按分数范围分页。
why_en: A feed is a per-user ordered collection, so lists or sorted sets support append, trim, and pagination.
whenOtherWins: 如果 feed 完全实时计算，不维护 per-user cache，就不需要这个结构。

termDefinitions.meaning: 带分数的集合，可按分数排序和范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sorted set stores members with scores and supports ordered range queries.

tradeoff: 追加/分页效率 vs 数据结构复杂度

scenario: post cache 中保存媒体 URL，但图片和视频字节在 CDN；feed service 返回时要怎么组装？
scenario_en: The post cache stores media URLs while image and video bytes live in the CDN; the feed service must assemble a response.
q: 返回体里应放什么？
q_en: What should the response contain?
options: 返回帖子字段和 CDN URL
把视频二进制塞进 JSON
只返回 CDN 节点 IP
删除媒体字段
options_en: Return post fields and CDN URLs.
Put video binary inside JSON.
Return only CDN node IPs.
Remove media fields.
why: feed JSON 应轻量，客户端再用 URL 拉媒体。内联大文件会拖慢 API，也绕开 CDN 缓存。
why_en: Feed JSON should return media references, letting clients fetch bytes from the CDN.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端可用来下载图片或视频的地址。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A media URL is an address the client can use to fetch an image or video.

scenario: 作者删除帖子；该 post_id 可能已经被写进很多好友的 feed cache。
scenario_en: An author deletes a post; its post_id may already exist in many friends feed caches.
q: 删除怎么处理更稳？
q_en: How should deletion be handled?
options: 标 deleted，读时过滤，异步清理
只删作者本地页面
要求所有好友立即同步删除完成后才返回
让 CDN 决定权限
options_en: Mark deleted, filter on read, clean async.
Delete only the author’s local page.
Wait for every friend cache deletion before returning.
Let the CDN decide permissions.
why: 读时过滤能快速生效，不必同步扫所有 feed cache。异步清理再回收空间，代价是读取要检查状态。
